table.name: Post-Start Staged Air End Time
table.description: Time after rpm first reaches idle target when the staged air stops rising and starts to decay, by start type and coolant. Part of a timed post-start air bump.

table.name: Post-Start Staged Air Level
table.description: Peak level of the staged post-start air, by start type and coolant. Part of a timed post-start air bump.

table.name: Post-Start Staged Air Ramp Step
table.description: Rise of the staged post-start air every 40 ms between Start Time and End Time, by start type and coolant. Part of a timed post-start air bump.

table.name: Post-Start Staged Air Start Time (TGV Closed)
table.description: Time after rpm first reaches idle target when the staged air starts to rise, by start type and coolant. Part of a timed post-start air bump. TGVs-forced-closed copy; edit with the normal table.

table.name: Post-Start Staged Air End Time (TGV Closed)
table.description: Time after rpm first reaches idle target when the staged air stops rising and starts to decay, by start type and coolant. Part of a timed post-start air bump. TGVs-forced-closed copy; edit with the normal table.

table.name: Post-Start Staged Air Level (TGV Closed)
table.description: Peak level of the staged post-start air, by start type and coolant. Part of a timed post-start air bump. TGVs-forced-closed copy; edit with the normal table.

table.name: Post-Start Staged Air Ramp Step (TGV Closed)
table.description: Rise of the staged post-start air every 40 ms between Start Time and End Time, by start type and coolant. Part of a timed post-start air bump. TGVs-forced-closed copy; edit with the normal table.

table.name: Post-Start Staged Air Decay (TGV Closed)
table.description: Multiplier applied every 40 ms after End Time, by start type and coolant (smaller = faster fade). Part of a timed post-start air bump. TGVs-forced-closed copy; edit with the normal table.

Post-Start Idle Air (Stop-Start Restart)
table.description:
Post-start idle air for an automatic stop-start restart, by start type and coolant. the stop-start feature appears unable to activate in this calibration.
Details: 0x0F1270 (read; args per call in module 0x0EE338): post-start idle air B20E = max(start air, staged air 05C49C family), added to the idle air at half weight (0x0F0AF8). TGVs not forced closed. Selected instead of the cranking value only inside the engine stop-start restart window (FFF89053 bit3/bit4 with the FFF88ADA bit3 edge, before the decay delay), by start type FFF8A6E8 (read). p16 (read): 0x0F1270 runs every 10 ms; its pass counter FFF84E42 counts 10 ms passes and the decay/ramp steps apply every 4th pass (40 ms). LF9F000R: located from LF75404S 05C5E8 by the code that reads it (read). LF9F000U: same code as LF9F000R; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 06C800. Confidence: read.

EGR Target Rate Tip-Out Limit (TGV Open)
table.description:
Cap on the target EGR rate for a short time after a pedal tip-out (inferred), by rpm and load, TGVs open.
Transient cap A819 (0x0FA1F8, rpm FFF8CD54 x load FFF8A616, read): while the flag is set, the ramped target A817 = min(this, base target) for EGR Tip-Out Limit Duration passes, then ramps back up by cal 0x2D6CE per pass (0x0FA068, read). The flag is set when FFF8AF00 (pedal, per my research notes) is at or below cal 0x2D2A8 and has fallen by at least cal 0x2D2AA against a sample from cal 0x2D2AC passes earlier (read), i.e. a pedal tip-out (inferred). TGVs closed = FFF8A881 bit 4 set (read: 0x10C948 drives the TGV open fraction FFF8B3E8 to 0 while the bit is set). EGR controller task 0x0F94A8 (read). That this is external EGR is inferred: its commanded output FFF8A81B is the OBD PID 0x2C (Commanded EGR) source and FFF88A1C (actual position) feeds PID 0x2D (EGR error) (0x1717C8, 0x1715F0, read). LF9F000R: located from LF75404S 05CAB4 by the code that reads it (read). LF9F000U: same code as LF9F000R; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 06CD00. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: EGR Target Rate Tip-Out Limit (TGV Closed)
table.description:
Cap on the target EGR rate for a short time after a pedal tip-out (inferred), by rpm and load, TGVs closed.
Transient cap A819 (0x0FA1F8, rpm FFF8CD54 x load FFF8A616, read): while the flag is set, the ramped target A817 = min(this, base target) for EGR Tip-Out Limit Duration passes, then ramps back up by cal 0x2D6CE per pass (0x0FA068, read). The flag is set when FFF8AF00 (pedal, per my research notes) is at or below cal 0x2D2A8 and has fallen by at least cal 0x2D2AA against a sample from cal 0x2D2AC passes earlier (read), i.e. a pedal tip-out (inferred). TGVs closed = FFF8A881 bit 4 set (read: 0x10C948 drives the TGV open fraction FFF8B3E8 to 0 while the bit is set). EGR controller task 0x0F94A8 (read). That this is external EGR is inferred: its commanded output FFF8A81B is the OBD PID 0x2C (Commanded EGR) source and FFF88A1C (actual position) feeds PID 0x2D (EGR error) (0x1717C8, 0x1715F0, read). LF9F000R: located from LF75404S 05CADC by the code that reads it (read). LF9F000U: same code as LF9F000R; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 06CD28. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: EGR Target Rate Tip-Out Limit (TGV Open, Multi-Injection)
table.description:
Multi-injection version of the TGV-open EGR tip-out cap.
Transient cap A819 (0x0FA1F8, rpm FFF8CD54 x load FFF8A616, read): while the flag is set, the ramped target A817 = min(this, base target) for EGR Tip-Out Limit Duration passes, then ramps back up by cal 0x2D6CE per pass (0x0FA068, read). The flag is set when FFF8AF00 (pedal, per my research notes) is at or below cal 0x2D2A8 and has fallen by at least cal 0x2D2AA against a sample from cal 0x2D2AC passes earlier (read), i.e. a pedal tip-out (inferred). Multi-injection = FFF8A775 bit 1, set by 0x0FAABC when the multi-injection enable FFF8A775 bit 0 is set and all four per-injector strategy bytes FFF8A69F..A6A2 are 2 or 3 (read). TGVs closed = FFF8A881 bit 4 set (read: 0x10C948 drives the TGV open fraction FFF8B3E8 to 0 while the bit is set). EGR controller task 0x0F94A8 (read). That this is external EGR is inferred: its commanded output FFF8A81B is the OBD PID 0x2C (Commanded EGR) source and FFF88A1C (actual position) feeds PID 0x2D (EGR error) (0x1717C8, 0x1715F0, read). LF9F000R: located from LF75404S 05CAC8 by the code that reads it (read). LF9F000U: same code as LF9F000R; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 06CD14. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: EGR Target Rate Tip-Out Limit (TGV Closed, Multi-Injection)
table.description:
Multi-injection version of the TGV-closed EGR tip-out cap.
Transient cap A819 (0x0FA1F8, rpm FFF8CD54 x load FFF8A616, read): while the flag is set, the ramped target A817 = min(this, base target) for EGR Tip-Out Limit Duration passes, then ramps back up by cal 0x2D6CE per pass (0x0FA068, read). The flag is set when FFF8AF00 (pedal, per my research notes) is at or below cal 0x2D2A8 and has fallen by at least cal 0x2D2AA against a sample from cal 0x2D2AC passes earlier (read), i.e. a pedal tip-out (inferred). Multi-injection = FFF8A775 bit 1, set by 0x0FAABC when the multi-injection enable FFF8A775 bit 0 is set and all four per-injector strategy bytes FFF8A69F..A6A2 are 2 or 3 (read). TGVs closed = FFF8A881 bit 4 set (read: 0x10C948 drives the TGV open fraction FFF8B3E8 to 0 while the bit is set). EGR controller task 0x0F94A8 (read). That this is external EGR is inferred: its commanded output FFF8A81B is the OBD PID 0x2C (Commanded EGR) source and FFF88A1C (actual position) feeds PID 0x2D (EGR error) (0x1717C8, 0x1715F0, read). LF9F000R: located from LF75404S 05CAF0 by the code that reads it (read). LF9F000U: same code as LF9F000R; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 06CD3C. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: EGR Tip-Out Limit Duration
table.description:
How long, by manifold pressure, the EGR tip-out cap is held after a pedal tip-out.
0x0FA068 (read): looked up with FFF8869C (copy of MAP FFF88A34, read) on the rising edge of the tip-out flag; while the flag counter FFF8B2A8 is below it, the target is held at the tip-out limit. p16 (read): EGR module 0x0F94A8 runs every 10 ms (0x07C408 <- 0x1DFE3C). LF9F000R: located from LF75404S 05CA08 by the code that reads it (read). LF9F000U: same code as LF9F000R; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 06CC54. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Surge Damping Timing Curve (AT/CVT Gear 1)
table.description:
AT/CVT version of Surge Damping Timing Curve (Gear 1).
Details: When used: AT/CVT only (FFF88ADA bit 7 clear; it is always set on this manual coding), gear FFF88FCE = 1 (0x0DBB20, read: the AT/CVT curve branch, mirrored by the MT branch that reads Surge Damping Timing Curve (Gear 1); the MT coding flag s4 picks the MT curve). Full-scale timing correction (degrees, negative = retard) by the largest throttle-flow change FFF8B0EE since the trigger FFF8A7A1 bit 2 set (0x0DBB20 holds the maximum in FFF8B0F0 and resets it to 0 while the trigger is clear, read), before the phase, coolant, mode and cal factors (read). Surge damping term FFF8A758 (0x0DBB20, called from the 10 ms module 0x0DE0E0; stack args verified with callers.py: s0 = gear FFF88FCE, s4 = MT coding FFF88ADA bit 7, s8 = FFF8B0EE, s12 = rpm FFF8CE9C, s16 = FFF88C64 bit 5, s20 = combustion mode FFF8A85C, read): A758 = Curve(FFF8B0EE) x PhaseFactor(FFF8A75E) x CoolantFactor FFF8A75C x ModeFactor(A85C) x cal factor (MT coding: cal 0x306E5 = 254, or cal 0x306E7 = 128 once FFF88C64 bit 5 has been clear for cal 0x306E8 = 150 passes) / 255^4, in 0.5-degree units, capped at +63.5 degrees, and 0 when the trigger FFF8A7A1 bit 2 is clear or when the current swing count has lasted longer than its time cal 0x306EA..0x306FA (100/20/100/10/100/5/100/100/100 passes of 10 ms for counts 0..8) (read). A758 is added to the final timing sum in 0x0D9E40 (read), so negative values retard. Trigger (read): 0x0DC1E8 counts passes while FFF8A7A1 bit 3 is set, the throttle-flow change FFF8B0EE >= cal 0x3084E (131 = 0.4 % per 20 ms, MT; hysteresis 0x3084C) and FFF8B112 (0x0E0D14 of FFF88A3A) <= cal 0x30842; 0x0E1350 sets FFF8A7A1 bit 2 when that count exceeds a per-gear, per-rpm-band threshold (cals 0x30F62..0x30FAC); it is dropped after cal 0x30850 (90) active passes. FFF8A75E counts rpm swings (0x0DC324, see p17p_surge_phase). FFF88FCE is the gear: on the MT coding 0x08254C copies FFF8A8B6, which 0x11422C derives from the ratio gear FFF8A623 (read). Reading: a timing intervention after a throttle step that retards while rpm swings up and releases while it swings down, i.e. driveline surge (shuffle) damping. Confidence: read.

Details: When used: only with the automatic coding (FFF886AB bit 7 clear), while the debounced range state FFF8A7D9 (0x0EA0E0 from FFF8CE63, which 0x06B68C builds from the discrete inputs FFF8A2A1) is 1 or 2 (in a drive range, inferred). Never on a manual car (read). Same role as Closed-Pedal Timing Target. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Start Spark Target Base (Mode 1, AT/CVT)
table.description:
AT/CVT copy of Start Spark Target Base (Mode 1).
Details: When used: FFF8A7E2 bit 0 clear (never on the manual coding), FFF899D7 bit 0 clear. 0x108BAC (catalyst-heating module, read) writes FFF8A854, which 0x0C3200 selects as the spark target FFF8A647 in fuel mode FFF8A852 = 2 (combustion mode FFF8A85C 1 or 3, 0x108B08). A647 is the spark the torque model compensates for (0x0C2514, 0x0C1EA8) and the reference of the cold-start retard monitors (0x1CB70C, 0x132568: A72A - A854) (read); the fired spark in this mode follows FFF8A74C/FFF8A76B (0x0DA428), not A854 (read). In combustion mode 1 (A85C < 2), at <= 4000 rpm (cal 0x1CBD8), with the pedal released (FFF886AB bit 5) and speed below cal 0x2A0C1 (2 km/h): A854 = Base(rpm FFF8CD5C, coolant) + Torque Adder(FFF8A85E, coolant) + Run-Time Adder(passes since the engine state became running, coolant) + Re-Entry Adder(passes since mode 1 was re-entered from normal mode 4, coolant), saturated to a byte; the set is chosen by FFF8A7E2 bit 0 (set = the manual tables, clear = the "AT/CVT" tables; always set on the manual coding, Phase 14) and FFF899D7 bit 0 (set = the "Warm-Up Fallback" tables): a once-per-drive warm-up fallback latch set by 0x081EFC only when cal 0x59134 bit 0 is set. Otherwise in mode 1 A854 = 05D0BC x 05D0A8 / 256 + FFF8A789 - 32; in mode 3 A854 = A72A (normal target) (read). with cal 0x2996C bit 6 set A854 is forced to cal 0x2A0C0. Units: A854 is compared with A72A and final timing in 0.5 degree units (inferred). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Requested Torque (Drive Mode 1, Default, AT/CVT)
table.description:
Drive mode 1: the default set (used when no SI-Drive request is received; the only set on cars without SI-Drive). On the AT/CVT coding this is the whole requested-torque map for this drive mode (Requested Torque (Drive Mode 1, Default) is then ignored); unused on manual cars. Edit it, and its Monitor copy, when tuning an AT/CVT car.
Details: When used: whenever FFF88ADA bit 7 (manual-transmission coding) is clear, i.e. on the AT/CVT coding. The A/B weight FFF8AE26 (0x0B9C78) starts at 0 and its step cals 0x22FBE/0x22FC0 are 0, so it stays 0 and the output is this table alone; the matching non-AT/CVT table is then ignored (read). FFF88ADA bit 7 is set on the manual coding, so this table is unused on manual cars. Driver-requested torque from rpm and pedal (0x0BB670, read): FFF8AEB4 = A x FFF8AE26/32768 + B x (1 - FFF8AE26/32768), torque above the zero point, into FFF8AEB4; FFF8AE26 ramps between 0 and 32768 under a condition (0x0B9C78). Table B of map set 2 = Drive Mode 1, Default (0x0BDBD8 combines the four sets by the drive-mode byte FFF8A8C1 and per-mode scale cals 0x1FAFE-0x1FB00; SI-Drive positions: mode 4 = Sport Sharp, mode 2 = Sport, mode 3 = Intelligent (least torque for a given pedal in both images), mode 1 = the default used when no valid SI-Drive request is received, and the only set on cars without SI-Drive). KEEP Requested Torque (Drive Mode 1, Default, AT/CVT, Monitor) identical (inferred safety copy). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Requested Torque (Drive Mode 1, Default, AT/CVT, Monitor)
table.description:
Monitor copy of Requested Torque (Drive Mode 1, Default, AT/CVT): keep identical to it or expect a throttle plausibility fault. Used only on the AT/CVT coding.
Details: When used: Monitor copy; keep identical. Byte-for-byte copy of Requested Torque (Drive Mode 1, Default, AT/CVT) (data and axes) in separate storage, read by a second module (0x1873C4/0x1874BC/0x1875BC/0x1876BC, rpm x FFF88FE2, same A-then-B lookup order and weight structure, into FFF8BBAE/BBB2/BBB6/BBBA). Almost certainly the electronic-throttle torque monitor: change it together with the primary map or expect a throttle/torque plausibility fault (inferred). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Drive Mode 1, Default, AT/CVT Coding)
table.description:
AT/CVT version of Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Drive Mode 1, Default). Only used on an AT/CVT-coded car, so it has no effect on a manual.
Details: When used: drive mode other than 2/3/4 (1, default) with AT/CVT Coding. AT/CVT Coding set = FFF88ADA bit 7 clear and FFF8AE0A >= cal 0x1FC96 (5). Replaces Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Drive Mode 1, Default) (0598F8) as Step1 (read: the selection at 0x0BCB12..0x0BCC20). 0x0BB958 (read; called from the torque module 0x0BE694 at 0x0BF612 with the limited request FFF8AEC2, the previous output FFF8AEC6, gear FFF8A621, rpm FFF8CD54, drive mode FFF8A8C1, pedal FFF8AF00 and, as stack argument 11, cal 0x23704 bit 6; argument order checked in the disassembly). Main path: with prev = FFF8AEC6, if prev + Step1 < Stage 2 Torque the shaped value is max(Start Torque, prev + Step1), otherwise max(Stage 2 Torque, prev + Step2); Step2 the same with cal 0x1FCA2.. (1, 2, 5, 5, 5) and the Stage 2 Pedal Multiplier; the gear factors apply only while FFF8A63D bit 4 is set (else x1). FFF8AEBE = min(request FFF8AEC2, shaped value). No shaping (FFF8AEBE = request) while the request is below Start Torque, vehicle speed FFF88BE8 is below cal 0x1FCAC (hysteresis 0x1FCAE), or FFF88ADA bit 6 / FFF88E62 bit 0 is set. FFF8AEBE goes on through FFF8AEC6 = max(FFF8AEBE, FFF8AEA8) (0x0BD3F0) to the target torque FFF8AECA (boost target / wastegate duty axis). Its rpm axis (0x2000A) differs from the manual table's. The torque monitor 0x1877B4 reads the same data bytes through its own descriptor (05F674), so it stays consistent. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Drive Mode 4, Sport Sharp, AT/CVT Coding)
table.description:
AT/CVT version of Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Drive Mode 4, Sport Sharp). Only used on an AT/CVT-coded car, so it has no effect on a manual.
Details: When used: drive mode 4 with AT/CVT Coding. AT/CVT Coding set = FFF88ADA bit 7 clear and FFF8AE0A >= cal 0x1FC96 (5). Replaces Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Drive Mode 4, Sport Sharp) (059920) as Step1 (read: the selection at 0x0BCB12..0x0BCC20). 0x0BB958 (read; called from the torque module 0x0BE694 at 0x0BF612 with the limited request FFF8AEC2, the previous output FFF8AEC6, gear FFF8A621, rpm FFF8CD54, drive mode FFF8A8C1, pedal FFF8AF00 and, as stack argument 11, cal 0x23704 bit 6; argument order checked in the disassembly). Main path: with prev = FFF8AEC6, if prev + Step1 < Stage 2 Torque the shaped value is max(Start Torque, prev + Step1), otherwise max(Stage 2 Torque, prev + Step2); Step2 the same with cal 0x1FCA2.. (1, 2, 5, 5, 5) and the Stage 2 Pedal Multiplier; the gear factors apply only while FFF8A63D bit 4 is set (else x1). FFF8AEBE = min(request FFF8AEC2, shaped value). No shaping (FFF8AEBE = request) while the request is below Start Torque, vehicle speed FFF88BE8 is below cal 0x1FCAC (hysteresis 0x1FCAE), or FFF88ADA bit 6 / FFF88E62 bit 0 is set. FFF8AEBE goes on through FFF8AEC6 = max(FFF8AEBE, FFF8AEA8) (0x0BD3F0) to the target torque FFF8AECA (boost target / wastegate duty axis). Its rpm axis (0x2000A) differs from the manual table's. The torque monitor 0x1877B4 reads the same data bytes through its own descriptor (05F6C4), so it stays consistent. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 2 (Drive Mode 1, Default, AT/CVT Coding)
table.description:
AT/CVT version of Target Torque Rise Step Stage 2 (Drive Mode 1, Default). Only used on an AT/CVT-coded car, so it has no effect on a manual.
Details: When used: drive mode other than 2/3/4 with FFF88ADA bit 7 clear and FFF8AE0A >= cal 0x1FC96 (5). Replaces Target Torque Rise Step Stage 2. 0x0BB958 (read; called from the torque module with the limited request FFF8AEC2, the previous output FFF8AEC6, gear FFF8A621, rpm FFF8CD54, drive mode FFF8A8C1 and pedal FFF8AF00): with prev = FFF8AEC6, if prev + Step1 < Stage 2 Torque the shaped value is max(Start Torque, prev + Step1), otherwise max(Stage 2 Torque, prev + Step2); Step2 the same with cal 0x1FCA2.. (1, 2, 5, 5, 5) and the Stage 2 Pedal Multiplier; the gear factors apply only while FFF8A63D bit 4 is set (else 255 = x1). FFF8AEBE = min(request FFF8AEC2, shaped value). No shaping (FFF8AEBE = request) while the request is below Start Torque, vehicle speed FFF88BE8 is below cal 0x1FCAC (89, about 5 km/h, hysteresis 0x1FCAE), or FFF88ADA bit 6 / FFF88E62 bit 0 is set. So these limit how fast the driver's torque request may rise (tip-in), in two stages. FFF8AEBE goes on through FFF8AEC6 = max(FFF8AEBE, FFF8AEA8) (0x0BD3F0) to the target torque FFF8AECA that indexes boost target and wastegate duty (my research notes). The torque monitor (0x1877B4) reads the same bytes through its own descriptor, so it stays consistent. Drive mode = FFF8A8C1 (2, 3, 4 or other; which value is which SI-Drive position: see the Requested Torque entries, see my research notes). Same data bytes are also referenced by descriptor(s) 05F714. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Park/Neutral RPM Limit (AT/CVT)
table.description:
Automatic/CVT only: with the selector in P or N, cylinders are cut once the engine reaches this speed, so a parked car cannot be revved past it. The cut stays on until the engine drops by the hysteresis. It does nothing on a manual-coded ECU. Separate from the normal rev limit.
Details: u16 rpm x 0.1953125. Latch FFF8A63B bit 0 (0x0C07F8): set while FFF8A63B bit 1 and rpm FFF8CE9C >= this; held down to this - the hysteresis. FFF8A63B bit 1 (0x0C0850): P/N switch FFF88ADA bit 6 (or fault flag FFF88E2B bit 2), manual coding FFF88ADA bit 7 clear, TCM range code FFF8A8DC 5 or 7 (or TCM-data fault flag FFF88E2B bit 1). The latch lets the cut level FFF8A64F through to the cylinder-cut thresholds in 0x0C1AC8, as the limit states do. Addresses are LF75404S. (read; that range codes 5 and 7 are P and N is inferred: the switch input must agree) Confidence: read.

table.name: Park/Neutral RPM Limit Hysteresis (AT/CVT)
table.description:
How far below the Park/Neutral RPM Limit the engine has to fall before the cut ends.
Details: u16 rpm x 0.1953125, subtracted from the limit while the latch FFF8A63B bit 0 is set (0x0C07F8, saturating at 0). (read) Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Speed Target (Warm Idle, AT/CVT, Mode 6)
table.description:
Warm idle speed target by coolant for automatic/CVT cars only; a manual car never uses this table.
Details: When used: only with the automatic/CVT transmission coding. With the manual coding the idle mode never becomes 6 (0x0F2BCC passes the mode through unchanged while FFF88ADA bit 7 is set, and 0x0F354C produces only modes 1-5 and 7, read), so on a manual car edit Mode 5. 0x0F1BCC selects this boot-format table by idle mode FFF8A7F0 = 6 and coolant; the result B238 is ramped (0x0F1D00) and becomes the idle target FFF8B236 through the minimum-speed max() in 0x0F2274. Implicit coolant axis -40..110 degC in 10 degC steps (lookup 0x7414, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Idle Speed Target (Warm-Up Drive-Off, AT/CVT, Mode 8)
table.description:
Automatic/CVT version of Idle Speed Target (Warm-Up Drive-Off, Mode 7): idle speed by coolant once the car has moved off before the engine is warm. Never used on a manual car.
Details: When used: only with the automatic/CVT coding: mode 7 is mapped to 8 while FFF8A7E2 bit 0 is clear (read, 0x0F2BCC). Never on a manual car. 0x0F1BCC selects this boot-format table by idle mode FFF8A7F0 = 8 and coolant; the result B238 is ramped (0x0F1D00) and becomes the idle target FFF8B236 through the minimum-speed max() in 0x0F2274 (read). Implicit coolant axis -40..110 C in 10 C steps (lookup 0x7414). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Idle Speed Target (In Drive, AT/CVT)
table.description:
Idle speed target by coolant while an automatic/CVT car idles in Drive with the brake on (pedal released, slow). Never used on a manual car (inferred).
Details: When used: only with the automatic/CVT coding, while the in-Drive idle condition FFF8A7E4 bit 0 is set (see Idle Air Reduction In Drive (Coolant): automatic coding, neutral input clear, pedal released, slow) and afterwards until the in-Drive idle air reduction FFF8B160 has ramped back to its target. Never on a manual car (inferred from that chain). 0x0F2248 (read): when FFF8A7E4 bit 4 is set, B242 = this(coolant) << 6 (12.5 rpm per count) replaces the idle-mode target chain. Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Target Ramp Rate (AT/CVT, Mode 1 to 6)
table.description:
How fast the idle speed target moves (by coolant) when idle switches from mode 1 (engine stopped) to mode 6 (AT/CVT warm idle). Larger = quicker change. Automatic/CVT only: these modes never occur on a manual car, so this table has no effect there.
Details: 0x0F1DD0 (read; selection checked in the disassembly 0x0F1DD0..0x0F2148): the target ramp step B23E is chosen on a change of idle mode FFF8A7F0 (previous -> new) and kept while the mode stays the same; the target B23C (4 x B238) moves toward the new mode's Idle Speed Target by this step every pass (0x0F1D00). Coolant FFF88A44 axis. Mode 1 -> 1 uses step 0. This table: mode 1 -> 6. Modes 6/8 only occur with the AT/CVT coding: 0x0F2BCC passes A7F6 through when FFF88ADA bit7 is set and 0x0F354C itself only yields 1-5/7, so this step is never used by this MT calibration (read). p16 (read): 0x0F1D00 runs every 10 ms (module 0x0EE338), so rpm/s = shown rpm-per-pass x 100. Confidence: read.

table.description:

Details: 0x0F1DD0 (read; selection checked in the disassembly 0x0F1DD0..0x0F2148): the target ramp step B23E is chosen on a change of idle mode FFF8A7F0 (previous -> new) and kept while the mode stays the same; the target B23C (4 x B238) moves toward the new mode's Idle Speed Target by this step every pass (0x0F1D00). Used instead of the mode table when FFF899D7 bit0 rises while the idle mode is unchanged (index 98/99, 0x0F1DD0, read). FFF899D7 bit0 is the warm-up fallback latch. This one when FFF8A7E2 bit0 is clear, which happens only with the AT/CVT coding (AT state FFF8A7DD 0 or 5; 0x0EC7A4/0x0F38B0, read). p16 (read): 0x0F1D00 runs every 10 ms (module 0x0EE338), so rpm/s = shown rpm-per-pass x 100. Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Base Air (AT/CVT, Mode 6)
table.description:
Base (open-loop) idle air by coolant in warm idle on automatic/CVT cars only (never used on a manual car), used while the TGVs are commanded open. Change it together with the matching Idle Speed Target so idle feedback does not have to make up the difference. The TGV Closed table is used whenever the TGVs are commanded closed, which is the normal state at low torque, so change both together.
Details: When used: only with the automatic/CVT coding: mode 5 is mapped to 6 while FFF8A7E2 bit 0 is clear (AT state code FFF8A7DD = 0 or 5, 0x0EC7A4; physical meaning not settled). Never on a manual car (read, 0x0F2BCC). 0x0F0D24: base idle air B20C by idle mode FFF8A7F0 and coolant, this table while FFF8A881 bit 4 (TGVs closed) is clear (read). Scale as Idle Base Air (Mode 5). Raise it with this mode's idle speed target so the feedback need not cover the difference (inferred). Implicit coolant axis -40..110 C in 10 C steps (lookup 0x7414). Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Base Air (AT/CVT, Mode 6, TGV Closed)
table.description:
Base (open-loop) idle air by coolant in warm idle on automatic/CVT cars only (never used on a manual car), used while the TGVs are commanded closed (the normal state at low torque, probably including warm idle). Change it together with the matching Idle Speed Target and the normal Idle Base Air table for this mode.
Details: When used: only with the automatic/CVT coding: mode 5 is mapped to 6 while FFF8A7E2 bit 0 is clear (AT state code FFF8A7DD = 0 or 5, 0x0EC7A4; physical meaning not settled). Never on a manual car (read, 0x0F2BCC). 0x0F0D24: base idle air B20C by idle mode FFF8A7F0 and coolant, this table while FFF8A881 bit 4 (TGV close command) is set (read). Scale as Idle Base Air (Mode 5). Raise it with this mode's idle speed target so the feedback need not cover the difference (inferred). Implicit coolant axis -40..110 C in 10 C steps (lookup 0x7414). FFF8A881 bit 4 is the normal TGV-close command (0x10DEFC, set mainly by the timed close request FFF8A883 bit 5 from 0x10E180 when requested torque, coolant and air flow are below the TGV thresholds; the same bit selects every TGV-closed table), not a forced or fault state (read). At a settled warm idle the request conditions hold, so the TGVs are normally commanded closed and the TGV Closed table is probably the one in use (inferred). Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Air Reduction In Drive (AT/CVT, Coolant)
table.description:
Idle air taken away, by coolant, while an automatic/CVT car idles in Drive (pedal released, slow) to offset the load of the transmission. Never used on a manual car.
Details: When used: only while FFF8A7E4 bit 0 is set (0x0F38D0, read): automatic coding (FFF886AB bit 7 clear) and the neutral input FFF88ADA bit 6 clear, accelerator released, speed FFF99835 within cals 0x2583F..0x25841, rpm below cal 0x25842 and below @025886(coolant), no speed-sensor/CAN faults; so never on a manual car (read). 0x0EAA40 (read): FFF8B162 = this(coolant) + Idle Air Reduction In Drive (RPM Error)(rpm - target rpm FFF8B236, coolant) + a ramp term (cals 0x25838..0x2583C), >= 0, capped by @025846(coolant); FFF8B160 follows it at cal 0x25834/0x25836 (86) per pass and is subtracted at half weight from the idle air FFF8B200 (0x0F0AF8, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Idle Air Reduction In Drive (AT/CVT, RPM Error)
table.description:
Correction to Idle Air Reduction In Drive by rpm error (actual minus target) and coolant, for automatic/CVT cars idling in Drive. Never used on a manual car.
Details: When used: see Idle Air Reduction In Drive (Coolant) (automatic coding only). 0x0EAA40 (read): added to the coolant term with the rpm error FFF8CE9C - FFF8B236 (s16, rpm x 5.12) and coolant FFF88A44 as axes. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Idle Air Target-Change Feed-Forward (AT/CVT, State 0/5)
table.description:
Automatic/CVT version of Idle Air Target-Change Feed-Forward, used in two transmission states only: extra or less idle air applied immediately when the idle speed target changes, by the size of the step.
Details: 0x0ECA08 (read; call 0x0ECA88/0x0ECA94 R5 checked): while FFF88A26 bit0 (idle, inferred), engine running (FFF88A27 bit0 clear) and FFF99835 below cal 0x259C8 (255, i.e. always), B1AE = this(new target - ramped target = B236 - B23C/4, capped at cal 0x259CA = 1000 rpm); B1AE enters the idle air at half weight. A positive step (target raised) adds air ahead of the ramp. Used when FFF8A7E2 bit0 is clear (bit0 = FFF8A7DD in 1..4 or 6, 0x0F38B0). Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Converter Slip Threshold (In Gear, AT/CVT)
table.description:
Automatic/CVT only: converter slip, by coolant, needed for the ECU to treat the car as stopped in gear for idle control (probably torque-converter slip). Never used on a manual car.
Details: When used: AT/CVT codings, standstill in gear. Input FFF88A44 (coolant, read in the disassembly by the same R5). 0x0EC7A4 (read; called from 0x0EE338 with FFF886AB bit 7, neutral FFF88ADA bit 6, CAN fault FFF88E2B bit 1, FFF8A7E2 bit 1, FFF8B140, coolant FFF88A44, time since start FFF88A76, speed FFF99835): on the manual coding FFF8A7DD is always 1, so these tables are AT/CVT only. FFF8B140 = engine rpm FFF8CD54 - FFF888AC x 128/25 (0x0E9EE8, read); FFF888AC comes from the TCM frame 0x148 (signals_rates_can.md, read), so B140 is the torque-converter slip in rpm (inferred). State 4 (stopped in gear) needs slip >= Idle Converter Slip Threshold (In Gear) (hysteresis cal 0x25648), state 6 (neutral/park) needs slip > Idle Converter Slip Threshold (Neutral) (hysteresis cal 0x25646) and FFF88A76 > cal 0x25642 (read). FFF8A7DD selects the idle table sets named "(AT/CVT, State...)" through FFF8A7E2 bit 0 (0x0F38B0). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Transient Fuel Throttle-Rate Gain (AT/CVT)

table.name: Surge Damping Timing Curve (AT/CVT Gear 1)
table.description:
AT/CVT version of Surge Damping Timing Curve (Gear 1).
Details: When used: AT/CVT only (FFF88ADA bit 7 clear; it is always set on this manual coding), gear FFF88FCE = 1 (0x0DBB20, read: the AT/CVT curve branch, mirrored by the MT branch that reads Surge Damping Timing Curve (Gear 1); the MT coding flag s4 picks the MT curve). Full-scale timing correction (degrees, negative = retard) by the largest throttle-flow change FFF8B0EE since the trigger FFF8A7A1 bit 2 set (0x0DBB20 holds the maximum in FFF8B0F0 and resets it to 0 while the trigger is clear, read), before the phase, coolant, mode and cal factors (read). Surge damping term FFF8A758 (0x0DBB20, called from the 10 ms module 0x0DE0E0; stack args verified with callers.py: s0 = gear FFF88FCE, s4 = MT coding FFF88ADA bit 7, s8 = FFF8B0EE, s12 = rpm FFF8CE9C, s16 = FFF88C64 bit 5, s20 = combustion mode FFF8A85C, read): A758 = Curve(FFF8B0EE) x PhaseFactor(FFF8A75E) x CoolantFactor FFF8A75C x ModeFactor(A85C) x cal factor (MT coding: cal 0x306E5 = 254, or cal 0x306E7 = 128 once FFF88C64 bit 5 has been clear for cal 0x306E8 = 150 passes) / 255^4, in 0.5-degree units, capped at +63.5 degrees, and 0 when the trigger FFF8A7A1 bit 2 is clear or when the current swing count has lasted longer than its time cal 0x306EA..0x306FA (100/20/100/10/100/5/100/100/100 passes of 10 ms for counts 0..8) (read). A758 is added to the final timing sum in 0x0D9E40 (read), so negative values retard. Trigger (read): 0x0DC1E8 counts passes while FFF8A7A1 bit 3 is set, the throttle-flow change FFF8B0EE >= cal 0x3084E (131 = 0.4 % per 20 ms, MT; hysteresis 0x3084C) and FFF8B112 (0x0E0D14 of FFF88A3A) <= cal 0x30842; 0x0E1350 sets FFF8A7A1 bit 2 when that count exceeds a per-gear, per-rpm-band threshold (cals 0x30F62..0x30FAC); it is dropped after cal 0x30850 (90) active passes. FFF8A75E counts rpm swings (0x0DC324, see p17p_surge_phase). FFF88FCE is the gear: on the MT coding 0x08254C copies FFF8A8B6, which 0x11422C derives from the ratio gear FFF8A623 (read). Reading: a timing intervention after a throttle step that retards while rpm swings up and releases while it swings down, i.e. driveline surge (shuffle) damping. Confidence: read.

table.name: Start Spark Target Base (Mode 1, AT/CVT)
table.description:
AT/CVT copy of Start Spark Target Base (Mode 1).
Details: When used: FFF8A7E2 bit 0 clear (never on the manual coding), FFF899D7 bit 0 clear. 0x108BAC (catalyst-heating module, read) writes FFF8A854, which 0x0C3200 selects as the spark target FFF8A647 in fuel mode FFF8A852 = 2 (combustion mode FFF8A85C 1 or 3, 0x108B08). A647 is the spark the torque model compensates for (0x0C2514, 0x0C1EA8) and the reference of the cold-start retard monitors (0x1CB70C, 0x132568: A72A - A854) (read); the fired spark in this mode follows FFF8A74C/FFF8A76B (0x0DA428), not A854 (read). In combustion mode 1 (A85C < 2), at <= 4000 rpm (cal 0x1CBD8), with the pedal released (FFF886AB bit 5) and speed below cal 0x2A0C1 (2 km/h): A854 = Base(rpm FFF8CD5C, coolant) + Torque Adder(FFF8A85E, coolant) + Run-Time Adder(passes since the engine state became running, coolant) + Re-Entry Adder(passes since mode 1 was re-entered from normal mode 4, coolant), saturated to a byte; the set is chosen by FFF8A7E2 bit 0 (set = the manual tables, clear = the "AT/CVT" tables; always set on the manual coding, Phase 14) and FFF899D7 bit 0 (set = the "Warm-Up Fallback" tables): a once-per-drive warm-up fallback latch set by 0x081EFC only when cal 0x59134 bit 0 is set. Otherwise in mode 1 A854 = 05D0BC x 05D0A8 / 256 + FFF8A789 - 32; in mode 3 A854 = A72A (normal target) (read). with cal 0x2996C bit 6 set A854 is forced to cal 0x2A0C0. Units: A854 is compared with A72A and final timing in 0.5 degree units (inferred). Confidence: inferred.

Otherwise in mode 1 A854 = 05D0BC x 05D0A8 / 256 + FFF8A789 - 32; in mode 3 A854 = A72A (normal target) (read). with cal 0x2996C bit 6 set A854 is forced to cal 0x2A0C0. Units: A854 is compared with A72A and final timing in 0.5 degree units (inferred). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Requested Torque (Drive Mode 1, Default, AT/CVT)
table.description:
Drive mode 1: the default set (used when no SI-Drive request is received; the only set on cars without SI-Drive). On the AT/CVT coding this is the whole requested-torque map for this drive mode (Requested Torque (Drive Mode 1, Default) is then ignored); unused on manual cars. Edit it, and its Monitor copy, when tuning an AT/CVT car.
Details: When used: whenever FFF88ADA bit 7 (manual-transmission coding) is clear, i.e. on the AT/CVT coding. The A/B weight FFF8AE26 (0x0B9C78) starts at 0 and its step cals 0x22FBE/0x22FC0 are 0, so it stays 0 and the output is this table alone; the matching non-AT/CVT table is then ignored (read). FFF88ADA bit 7 is set on the manual coding, so this table is unused on manual cars. Driver-requested torque from rpm and pedal (0x0BB670, read): FFF8AEB4 = A x FFF8AE26/32768 + B x (1 - FFF8AE26/32768), torque above the zero point, into FFF8AEB4; FFF8AE26 ramps between 0 and 32768 under a condition (0x0B9C78). Table B of map set 2 = Drive Mode 1, Default (0x0BDBD8 combines the four sets by the drive-mode byte FFF8A8C1 and per-mode scale cals 0x1FAFE-0x1FB00; SI-Drive positions: mode 4 = Sport Sharp, mode 2 = Sport, mode 3 = Intelligent (least torque for a given pedal in both images), mode 1 = the default used when no valid SI-Drive request is received, and the only set on cars without SI-Drive). KEEP Requested Torque (Drive Mode 1, Default, AT/CVT, Monitor) identical (inferred safety copy). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Requested Torque (Drive Mode 1, Default, AT/CVT, Monitor)
table.description:
Monitor copy of Requested Torque (Drive Mode 1, Default, AT/CVT): keep identical to it or expect a throttle plausibility fault. Used only on the AT/CVT coding.
Details: When used: Monitor copy; keep identical. Byte-for-byte copy of Requested Torque (Drive Mode 1, Default, AT/CVT) (data and axes) in separate storage, read by a second module (0x1873C4/0x1874BC/0x1875BC/0x1876BC, rpm x FFF88FE2, same A-then-B lookup order and weight structure, into FFF8BBAE/BBB2/BBB6/BBBA). Almost certainly the electronic-throttle torque monitor: change it together with the primary map or expect a throttle/torque plausibility fault (inferred). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Drive Mode 1, Default, AT/CVT Coding)
table.description:
AT/CVT version of Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Drive Mode 1, Default). Only used on an AT/CVT-coded car, so it has no effect on a manual.
Details: When used: drive mode other than 2/3/4 (1, default) with AT/CVT Coding. AT/CVT Coding set = FFF88ADA bit 7 clear and FFF8AE0A >= cal 0x1FC96 (5). Replaces Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Drive Mode 1, Default) (0598F8) as Step1 (read: the selection at 0x0BCB12..0x0BCC20). 0x0BB958 (read; called from the torque module 0x0BE694 at 0x0BF612 with the limited request FFF8AEC2, the previous output FFF8AEC6, gear FFF8A621, rpm FFF8CD54, drive mode FFF8A8C1, pedal FFF8AF00 and, as stack argument 11, cal 0x23704 bit 6; argument order checked in the disassembly). Main path: with prev = FFF8AEC6, if prev + Step1 < Stage 2 Torque the shaped value is max(Start Torque, prev + Step1), otherwise max(Stage 2 Torque, prev + Step2); Step2 the same with cal 0x1FCA2.. (1, 2, 5, 5, 5) and the Stage 2 Pedal Multiplier; the gear factors apply only while FFF8A63D bit 4 is set (else x1). FFF8AEBE = min(request FFF8AEC2, shaped value). No shaping (FFF8AEBE = request) while the request is below Start Torque, vehicle speed FFF88BE8 is below cal 0x1FCAC (hysteresis 0x1FCAE), or FFF88ADA bit 6 / FFF88E62 bit 0 is set. FFF8AEBE goes on through FFF8AEC6 = max(FFF8AEBE, FFF8AEA8) (0x0BD3F0) to the target torque FFF8AECA (boost target / wastegate duty axis). Its rpm axis (0x2000A) differs from the manual table's. The torque monitor 0x1877B4 reads the same data bytes through its own descriptor (05F674), so it stays consistent. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 2 (Drive Mode 1, Default, AT/CVT Coding)
table.description:

Details: When used: drive mode other than 2/3/4 with FFF88ADA bit 7 clear and FFF8AE0A >= cal 0x1FC96 (5). Replaces Target Torque Rise Step Stage 2. 0x0BB958 (read; called from the torque module with the limited request FFF8AEC2, the previous output FFF8AEC6, gear FFF8A621, rpm FFF8CD54, drive mode FFF8A8C1 and pedal FFF8AF00): with prev = FFF8AEC6, if prev + Step1 < Stage 2 Torque the shaped value is max(Start Torque, prev + Step1), otherwise max(Stage 2 Torque, prev + Step2); Step2 the same with cal 0x1FCA2.. (1, 2, 5, 5, 5) and the Stage 2 Pedal Multiplier; the gear factors apply only while FFF8A63D bit 4 is set (else 255 = x1). FFF8AEBE = min(request FFF8AEC2, shaped value). So these limit how fast the driver's torque request may rise (tip-in), in two stages. FFF8AEBE goes on through FFF8AEC6 = max(FFF8AEBE, FFF8AEA8) (0x0BD3F0) to the target torque FFF8AECA that indexes boost target and wastegate duty (my research notes). The torque monitor (0x1877B4) reads the same bytes through its own descriptor, so it stays consistent. Drive mode = FFF8A8C1 (2, 3, 4 or other; which value is which SI-Drive position: see the Requested Torque entries, see my research notes). Same data bytes are also referenced by descriptor(s) 05F714. Confidence: inferred.

Replaces Target Torque Rise Step Stage 2. 0x0BB958 (read; called from the torque module with the limited request FFF8AEC2, the previous output FFF8AEC6, gear FFF8A621, rpm FFF8CD54, drive mode FFF8A8C1 and pedal FFF8AF00): with prev = FFF8AEC6, if prev + Step1 < Stage 2 Torque the shaped value is max(Start Torque, prev + Step1), otherwise max(Stage 2 Torque, prev + Step2); Step2 the same with cal 0x1FCA2.. (1, 2, 5, 5, 5) and the Stage 2 Pedal Multiplier; the gear factors apply only while FFF8A63D bit 4 is set (else 255 = x1). FFF8AEBE = min(request FFF8AEC2, shaped value). No shaping (FFF8AEBE = request) while the request is below Start Torque, vehicle speed FFF88BE8 is below cal 0x1FCAC (89, about 5 km/h, hysteresis 0x1FCAE), or FFF88ADA bit 6 / FFF88E62 bit 0 is set. So these limit how fast the driver's torque request may rise (tip-in), in two stages. FFF8AEBE goes on through FFF8AEC6 = max(FFF8AEBE, FFF8AEA8) (0x0BD3F0) to the target torque FFF8AECA that indexes boost target and wastegate duty (my research notes). The torque monitor (0x1877B4) reads the same bytes through its own descriptor, so it stays consistent. Drive mode = FFF8A8C1 (2, 3, 4 or other; which value is which SI-Drive position: see the Requested Torque entries, see my research notes). Same data bytes are also referenced by descriptor(s) 05F6EC. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Park/Neutral RPM Limit (AT/CVT)
table.description:
Automatic/CVT only: with the selector in P or N, cylinders are cut once the engine reaches this speed, so a parked car cannot be revved past it. The cut stays on until the engine drops by the hysteresis. It does nothing on a manual-coded ECU. Separate from the normal rev limit.
Details: u16 rpm x 0.1953125. Latch FFF8A63B bit 0 (0x0C07F8): set while FFF8A63B bit 1 and rpm FFF8CE9C >= this; held down to this - the hysteresis. FFF8A63B bit 1 (0x0C0850): P/N switch FFF88ADA bit 6 (or fault flag FFF88E2B bit 2), manual coding FFF88ADA bit 7 clear, TCM range code FFF8A8DC 5 or 7 (or TCM-data fault flag FFF88E2B bit 1). The latch lets the cut level FFF8A64F through to the cylinder-cut thresholds in 0x0C1AC8, as the limit states do. Addresses are LF75404S. (read; that range codes 5 and 7 are P and N is inferred: the switch input must agree) Confidence: read.

table.name: Park/Neutral RPM Limit Hysteresis (AT/CVT)
table.description:
How far below the Park/Neutral RPM Limit the engine has to fall before the cut ends.
Details: u16 rpm x 0.1953125, subtracted from the limit while the latch FFF8A63B bit 0 is set (0x0C07F8, saturating at 0). (read) Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Speed Target (Warm Idle, AT/CVT, Mode 6)
table.description:
Warm idle speed target by coolant for automatic/CVT cars only; a manual car never uses this table.
Details: When used: only with the automatic/CVT transmission coding. With the manual coding the idle mode never becomes 6 (0x0F2BCC passes the mode through unchanged while FFF88ADA bit 7 is set, and 0x0F354C produces only modes 1-5 and 7, read), so on a manual car edit Mode 5. 0x0F1BCC selects this boot-format table by idle mode FFF8A7F0 = 6 and coolant; the result B238 is ramped (0x0F1D00) and becomes the idle target FFF8B236 through the minimum-speed max() in 0x0F2274. Implicit coolant axis -40..110 degC in 10 degC steps (lookup 0x7414, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Idle Speed Target (In Drive, AT/CVT)
table.description:
Idle speed target by coolant while an automatic/CVT car idles in Drive with the brake on (pedal released, slow). Never used on a manual car (inferred).
Details: When used: only with the automatic/CVT coding, while the in-Drive idle condition FFF8A7E4 bit 0 is set (see Idle Air Reduction In Drive (Coolant): automatic coding, neutral input clear, pedal released, slow) and afterwards until the in-Drive idle air reduction FFF8B160 has ramped back to its target. Never on a manual car (inferred from that chain). 0x0F2248 (read): when FFF8A7E4 bit 4 is set, B242 = this(coolant) << 6 (12.5 rpm per count) replaces the idle-mode target chain. Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Target Ramp Rate (AT/CVT, Mode 1 to 6)
table.description:
How fast the idle speed target moves (by coolant) when idle switches from mode 1 (engine stopped) to mode 6 (AT/CVT warm idle). Larger = quicker change. Automatic/CVT only: these modes never occur on a manual car, so this table has no effect there.
Details: 0x0F1DD0 (read; selection checked in the disassembly 0x0F1DD0..0x0F2148): the target ramp step B23E is chosen on a change of idle mode FFF8A7F0 (previous -> new) and kept while the mode stays the same; the target B23C (4 x B238) moves toward the new mode's Idle Speed Target by this step every pass (0x0F1D00). Coolant FFF88A44 axis. Mode 1 -> 1 uses step 0. This table: mode 1 -> 6. Modes 6/8 only occur with the AT/CVT coding: 0x0F2BCC passes A7F6 through when FFF88ADA bit7 is set and 0x0F354C itself only yields 1-5/7, so this step is never used by this MT calibration (read). p16 (read): 0x0F1D00 runs every 10 ms (module 0x0EE338), so rpm/s = shown rpm-per-pass x 100. Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Base Air (AT/CVT, Mode 6)
table.description:
Base (open-loop) idle air by coolant in warm idle on automatic/CVT cars only (never used on a manual car), used while the TGVs are commanded open. Change it together with the matching Idle Speed Target so idle feedback does not have to make up the difference. The TGV Closed table is used whenever the TGVs are commanded closed, which is the normal state at low torque, so change both together.
Details: When used: only with the automatic/CVT coding: mode 5 is mapped to 6 while FFF8A7E2 bit 0 is clear (AT state code FFF8A7DD = 0 or 5, 0x0EC7A4; physical meaning not settled). Never on a manual car (read, 0x0F2BCC). 0x0F0D24: base idle air B20C by idle mode FFF8A7F0 and coolant, this table while FFF8A881 bit 4 (TGVs closed) is clear (read). Scale as Idle Base Air (Mode 5). Raise it with this mode's idle speed target so the feedback need not cover the difference (inferred). Implicit coolant axis -40..110 C in 10 C steps (lookup 0x7414). Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Base Air (AT/CVT, Mode 6, TGV Closed)

Change it together with the matching Idle Speed Target and the normal Idle Base Air table for this mode.
Details: When used: only with the automatic/CVT coding: mode 5 is mapped to 6 while FFF8A7E2 bit 0 is clear (AT state code FFF8A7DD = 0 or 5, 0x0EC7A4; physical meaning not settled). FFF8A881 bit 4 is the normal TGV-close command (0x10DEFC, set mainly by the timed close request FFF8A883 bit 5 from 0x10E180 when requested torque, coolant and air flow are below the TGV thresholds; the same bit selects every TGV-closed table), not a forced or fault state (read). At a settled warm idle the request conditions hold, so the TGVs are normally commanded closed and the TGV Closed table is probably the one in use (inferred). Confidence: read.

Details: When used: only with the automatic/CVT coding: mode 7 is mapped to 8 while FFF8A7E2 bit 0 is clear (read, 0x0F2BCC). Never on a manual car. 0x0F0D24: base idle air B20C by idle mode FFF8A7F0 and coolant, this table while FFF8A881 bit 4 (TGVs closed) is clear (read). Scale as Idle Base Air (Mode 5). Raise it with this mode's idle speed target so the feedback need not cover the difference (inferred). Implicit coolant axis -40..110 C in 10 C steps (lookup 0x7414). Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Base Air (Warm-Up Drive-Off, AT/CVT, Mode 8, TGV Closed)
table.description:
Base (open-loop) idle air by coolant after a cold-start drive-off on automatic/CVT cars only (never used on a manual car), used while the TGVs are commanded closed (the normal state at low torque, probably including warm idle). Change it together with the matching Idle Speed Target and the normal Idle Base Air table for this mode.
Details: When used: only with the automatic/CVT coding: mode 7 is mapped to 8 while FFF8A7E2 bit 0 is clear (read, 0x0F2BCC). Never on a manual car. 0x0F0D24: base idle air B20C by idle mode FFF8A7F0 and coolant, this table while FFF8A881 bit 4 (TGV close command) is set (read). Scale as Idle Base Air (Mode 5). Raise it with this mode's idle speed target so the feedback need not cover the difference (inferred). Implicit coolant axis -40..110 C in 10 C steps (lookup 0x7414). FFF8A881 bit 4 is the normal TGV-close command (0x10DEFC, set mainly by the timed close request FFF8A883 bit 5 from 0x10E180 when requested torque, coolant and air flow are below the TGV thresholds; the same bit selects every TGV-closed table), not a forced or fault state (read). At a settled warm idle the request conditions hold, so the TGVs are normally commanded closed and the TGV Closed table is probably the one in use (inferred). Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Air Reduction In Drive (AT/CVT, Coolant)
table.description:
Idle air taken away, by coolant, while an automatic/CVT car idles in Drive (pedal released, slow) to offset the load of the transmission. Never used on a manual car.
Details: When used: only while FFF8A7E4 bit 0 is set (0x0F38D0, read): automatic coding (FFF886AB bit 7 clear) and the neutral input FFF88ADA bit 6 clear, accelerator released, speed FFF99835 within cals 0x2583F..0x25841, rpm below cal 0x25842 and below @025886(coolant), no speed-sensor/CAN faults; so never on a manual car (read). 0x0EAA40 (read): FFF8B162 = this(coolant) + Idle Air Reduction In Drive (RPM Error)(rpm - target rpm FFF8B236, coolant) + a ramp term (cals 0x25838..0x2583C), >= 0, capped by @025846(coolant); FFF8B160 follows it at cal 0x25834/0x25836 (86) per pass and is subtracted at half weight from the idle air FFF8B200 (0x0F0AF8, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Idle Air Reduction In Drive (AT/CVT, RPM Error)
table.description:
Correction to Idle Air Reduction In Drive by rpm error (actual minus target) and coolant, for automatic/CVT cars idling in Drive. Never used on a manual car.
Details: When used: see Idle Air Reduction In Drive (Coolant) (automatic coding only). 0x0EAA40 (read): added to the coolant term with the rpm error FFF8CE9C - FFF8B236 (s16, rpm x 5.12) and coolant FFF88A44 as axes. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Idle Air Target-Change Feed-Forward (AT/CVT, State 0/5)
table.description:
Automatic/CVT version of Idle Air Target-Change Feed-Forward, used in two transmission states only: extra or less idle air applied immediately when the idle speed target changes, by the size of the step.
Details: 0x0ECA08 (read; call 0x0ECA88/0x0ECA94 R5 checked): while FFF88A26 bit0 (idle, inferred), engine running (FFF88A27 bit0 clear) and FFF99835 below cal 0x259C8 (255, i.e. always), B1AE = this(new target - ramped target = B236 - B23C/4, capped at cal 0x259CA = 1000 rpm); B1AE enters the idle air at half weight. A positive step (target raised) adds air ahead of the ramp. Used when FFF8A7E2 bit0 is clear (bit0 = FFF8A7DD in 1..4 or 6, 0x0F38B0). Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Converter Slip Threshold (In Gear, AT/CVT)
table.description:
Automatic/CVT only: converter slip, by coolant, needed for the ECU to treat the car as stopped in gear for idle control (probably torque-converter slip). Never used on a manual car.
Details: When used: AT/CVT codings, standstill in gear. Input FFF88A44 (coolant, read in the disassembly by the same R5). 0x0EC7A4 (read; called from 0x0EE338 with FFF886AB bit 7, neutral FFF88ADA bit 6, CAN fault FFF88E2B bit 1, FFF8A7E2 bit 1, FFF8B140, coolant FFF88A44, time since start FFF88A76, speed FFF99835): on the manual coding FFF8A7DD is always 1, so these tables are AT/CVT only. FFF8B140 = engine rpm FFF8CD54 - FFF888AC x 128/25 (0x0E9EE8, read); FFF888AC comes from the TCM frame 0x148 (signals_rates_can.md, read), so B140 is the torque-converter slip in rpm (inferred). State 4 (stopped in gear) needs slip >= Idle Converter Slip Threshold (In Gear) (hysteresis cal 0x25648), state 6 (neutral/park) needs slip > Idle Converter Slip Threshold (Neutral) (hysteresis cal 0x25646) and FFF88A76 > cal 0x25642 (read). FFF8A7DD selects the idle table sets named "(AT/CVT, State...)" through FFF8A7E2 bit 0 (0x0F38B0). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Idle Converter Slip Threshold (Neutral, AT/CVT)
table.description:
Automatic/CVT only: converter slip, by coolant, needed for the ECU to treat the car as in neutral/park for idle control (probably torque-converter slip). Never used on a manual car.
Details: When used: AT/CVT codings, in neutral/park. Input FFF88A44 (coolant). 0x0EC7A4 (read; called from 0x0EE338 with FFF886AB bit 7, neutral FFF88ADA bit 6, CAN fault FFF88E2B bit 1, FFF8A7E2 bit 1, FFF8B140, coolant FFF88A44, time since start FFF88A76, speed FFF99835): on the manual coding FFF8A7DD is always 1, so these tables are AT/CVT only. FFF8B140 = engine rpm FFF8CD54 - FFF888AC x 128/25 (0x0E9EE8, read); FFF888AC comes from the TCM frame 0x148 (signals_rates_can.md, read), so B140 is the torque-converter slip in rpm (inferred). State 4 (stopped in gear) needs slip >= Idle Converter Slip Threshold (In Gear) (hysteresis cal 0x25648), state 6 (neutral/park) needs slip > Idle Converter Slip Threshold (Neutral) (hysteresis cal 0x25646) and FFF88A76 > cal 0x25642 (read). FFF8A7DD selects the idle table sets named "(AT/CVT, State...)" through FFF8A7E2 bit 0 (0x0F38B0). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling
table.description: Base open-loop (power enrichment) AFR target by rpm and load, used once the exhaust temperature estimate is high enough. The ECU uses the richer of this and the Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV..., AVCS...) group: to lean, edit both; to richen, either. Also see Open Loop Fueling Floor (Outside Closed Loop).

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV Closed, AVCS Inactive)
table.description: Open-loop AFR target for TGVs closed with AVCS not in active control, part of a blend by TGV position and AVCS state, used above Open Loop Delay Load Threshold after a delay. The ECU uses the richer of the two systems, so leaning needs both.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV Closed, AVCS Active)
table.description: Open-loop AFR target for TGVs closed with AVCS in active control, part of a blend by TGV position and AVCS state, used above Open Loop Delay Load Threshold after a delay. The ECU uses the richer of the two systems, so leaning needs both.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV Open, AVCS Inactive)
table.description: Open-loop AFR target for TGVs open with AVCS not in active control, part of a blend by TGV position and AVCS state, used above Open Loop Delay Load Threshold after a delay. The ECU uses the richer of the two systems, so leaning needs both.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV Open, AVCS Active)
table.description: Open-loop AFR target for TGVs open with AVCS in active control, part of a blend by TGV position and AVCS state, used above Open Loop Delay Load Threshold after a delay. The ECU uses the richer of the two systems, so leaning needs both.

table.name: Open Loop Fueling Floor (Outside Closed Loop)
Primary Open Loop Fueling Additive
table.description: Extra open-loop enrichment added to Primary Open Loop Fueling, scaled by its DAM multiplier: full at DAM 0, none at DAM 1. Probably the classic knock-dependent extra fuel. Edit with Primary Open Loop Fueling Additive (TGV/AVCS Group).

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling Additive DAM Multiplier
table.description: Scales Primary Open Loop Fueling Additive by the Dynamic Advance Multiplier (DAM), so the extra fuel is added as knock history lowers DAM. Edit with the (TGV/AVCS Group) copy.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling Additive (TGV/AVCS Group)
table.description: Knock-dependent extra enrichment for the TGV/AVCS open-loop group, scaled by its DAM multiplier (full at DAM 0, none at DAM 1).

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling Additive DAM Multiplier (TGV/AVCS Group)
table.description: Scales Primary Open Loop Fueling Additive (TGV/AVCS Group) by DAM (128 = x1.0).

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling Subtractive (TGV/AVCS Group)
table.description: Fuel removed from the TGV/AVCS open-loop group, scaled by its own DAM multiplier (negative cells add fuel). Leaning only works where Primary Open Loop Fueling is not richer.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling Subtractive DAM Multiplier (TGV/AVCS Group)
table.description: Scales Primary Open Loop Fueling Subtractive (TGV/AVCS Group) by DAM (128 = x1.0).

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling Subtractive
table.description: Fuel removed from Primary Open Loop Fueling, scaled by its DAM multiplier (negative cells add fuel). It only leans the target where the TGV/AVCS group is not richer.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling Subtractive DAM Multiplier
table.description: Scales Primary Open Loop Fueling Subtractive by DAM (128 = x1.0).

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling (Alternate)
table.description:
Replacement for Primary Open Loop Fueling plus its knock additive, used only when the calibration switch 'Open Loop Fueling. Edit with Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV/AVCS Group, Alternate) if you enable it.
Details: When used: only when cal 0x2F79A bit 4 is set (read; 2017 0x36B76, 2018 0x37FF2). The bit is the first argument of 0x0CE854 (call in 0x0C589C, read). With it set, 0x0CE854 uses this table + cal 0x18DDC in place of the base table plus the DAM-scaled additive, while DAM16 FFF811AE < cal 0x18DDD; otherwise Primary Open Loop Fueling + cal 0x18DDC (read). The TGV/AVCS group has its own alternate (Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV/AVCS Group, Alternate)); edit both if you enable the switch. LF75200T: located from LF75404S 05AC80 by the code that reads it (read). LF75100D: same code as LF75200T; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 0583D4. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV/AVCS Group, Alternate)
table.description:
Replacement for the TGV/AVCS open-loop group plus its knock additive, used only with the 'Use Alternate Map' calibration switch set.
Details: When used: only with cal 0x2F79A bit 4 set and DAM16 FFF811AE < cal 0x1391C (16). Replaces the TGV/AVCS blend plus knock additive in FFF8A681. 0x0CE5E8 (read; called from 0x0C589C with rpm FFF8CD54, load FFF8A616, cal 0x2F79A bit 4, DAM FFF811AE, AVCS weight FFF8A743 and TGV open fraction FFF8B3E8): TGV-closed base = 05ABB0 x (255 - a)/255 + 05ABD8 x a/255, TGV-open base = 05ABC4 x (255 - a)/255 + 05ABEC x a/255, where a = FFF8A743 is the AVCS-active weight from 0x0D952C (255 while both cam controllers are in active control, my research notes); blend FFF8A69B = closed x (1 - FFF8B3E8) + open x FFF8B3E8. With cal 0x2F79A bit 4 clear. With the bit set: Alternate (+ cal 0x13DCD) while DAM16 < cal 0x1391C (16), else blend + cal 0x13DCD. 0x0CEA80 (read) then takes FFF8A681 (only once FFF8AFD6 >= FFF8AFE6, the open-loop delay, and when >= cal 0x13DD0 = 5), scales it by cal 0x237CA/128 (x1.0), rate-limits its rise by 05ACD4(rpm) and sets FFF8A684 = max(that, FFF8A682), FFF8A682 being Primary Open Loop Fueling from 0x0CE854. FFF8A684 is the open-loop enrichment in commanded lambda 256/(256 + B030 + A684 + AFE8) (0x171C88). So the commanded open-loop mixture is the richer of the two systems: to lean the target, lower this group as well as Primary Open Loop Fueling; to richen, raise this group (Primary Open Loop Fueling alone only takes effect while its exhaust-temperature enable holds: 0x0CE854 sets FFF8A683 to 0 unless FFF8AFD0 >= cal 0x18DD4 or FFF8C03C >= cal 0x18DD8, read). LF75200T: located from LF75404S 05AC00 by the code that reads it (read). LF75100D: same code as LF75200T; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 058354. Confidence: inferred.

table.description:
Size of what appears to be a one-shot priming injection at key-on/cranking, by coolant; the pulse is proportional to it.
Details: When used: only if cal 0x28D98 = 1 or 2. 0x0CD4AC (read): FFF8A67D = this(coolant FFF8CD65 = degC + 50) during key-on and cranking (fuel state 1/2), held afterwards. 0x0CD500 / 0x0CD5DC compute the pulses FFF8C040 / FFF8C044 = 05A8F4 / 05A908(rail pressure FFF89266, FFF8A652) x flow compensation FFF8AFEA x barometric factor FFF8A687 x FFF8A67D x 2^-18 x 1.25 + latency, and 0x1D296C fires each of them once per injector (flags FFF8C6F4-C6F7) when cal 0x28D98 = 1 or 2 (read): a one-shot priming injection at start (inferred). The pulse is proportional to this value. LF75200T: located from LF75404S 05A91C by the code that reads it (read). LF75100D: same code as LF75200T; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 058040. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: FLKC Counted-Cell Learned Value Threshold
table.description:
By DAM: a fine-knock-learning cell is counted when its learned value is at or above this, and the count sets an internal flag.
0x0E7DF8 (read): one cell per pass, it counts the FLKC cells whose flag FFF811AF[cell] is 1 and whose learned value FFF81414[cell] is at or above this(DAM FFF811AE); after all 35 cells the count goes to FFF8A792 and FFF8A7A3 bit 1 = count >= cal 0x1C699 (4). 0x0E7D0C (read) uses that bit only together with DAM inside cal 0x1C698..0x1C697 (32..48 in DAM x 16 units), which DAM (0..16) never reaches. LF75200T: located from LF75404S 05C1B0 by the code that reads it (read). LF75100D: same code as LF75200T; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 059878. Confidence: read.

table.name: Base Timing DAM Blend Alternate (DAM 0)
table.description:
Alternate DAM-blended timing offset (DAM 0 side) for base timing. 32 = no change.
Weighted (16 - DAM)/16. 0x0D9BD4 (read): FFF8A73F = ((16 - DAM) x 05B54C + DAM x 05B560) / 16 in the 32-offset half-degree frame, DAM = FFF811AE (0..16), tables by rpm FFF8CD54 x load FFF8ADE4. 0x0D9CA0: FFF8A73E = (A73F + FFF8A73B - 32) x FFF8B0D2 / 256 + 32, and FFF8A740 = A73E when FFF8A8A5 bit 4 is set, else A73D (the 05B574/05B588 path) (read). FFF8A73E/A73F have no other readers. With cal 0x32DEA = 'Z' the base timing term FFF8A73C would ramp toward A740 (cal 0x32DEC per pass) and enter the base timing sum FFF8A74B (0x0DA600). LF75200T: located from LF75404S 05B54C by the code that reads it (read). LF75100D: same code as LF75200T; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 058C14. Confidence: read.

table.name: Base Timing DAM Blend Alternate (DAM 1)
table.description:
Alternate DAM-blended timing offset (DAM 1 side) for base timing. 32 = no change.
Weighted DAM/16. 0x0D9BD4 (read): FFF8A73F = ((16 - DAM) x 05B54C + DAM x 05B560) / 16 in the 32-offset half-degree frame, DAM = FFF811AE (0..16), tables by rpm FFF8CD54 x load FFF8ADE4. 0x0D9CA0: FFF8A73E = (A73F + FFF8A73B - 32) x FFF8B0D2 / 256 + 32, and FFF8A740 = A73E when FFF8A8A5 bit 4 is set, else A73D (the 05B574/05B588 path) (read). FFF8A73E/A73F have no other readers. With cal 0x32DEA = 'Z' the base timing term FFF8A73C would ramp toward A740 (cal 0x32DEC per pass) and enter the base timing sum FFF8A74B (0x0DA600). LF75200T: located from LF75404S 05B560 by the code that reads it (read). LF75100D: same code as LF75200T; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 058C28. Confidence: read.

table.name: Knock Threshold (Event 1, Full Window)
table.description: Knock intensity (sum of the three strongest knock-channel ratios to their background, 3.0 = all at background) (by rpm and load) above which a knock event in slot 1 counts as knock and triggers feedback knock retard; used while the extended (full) knock window is in use. Higher = less sensitive. Warning: the Full / Short Window sets were renamed on 2026-10-30 (earlier names had them swapped). Which cylinder slot 1 is has not been mapped.

table.name: Knock Background Window Step (Event 4, Channel 3)
table.description: Knock signal processing for event slot 4, channel 3 (probably a frequency band of the knock sensor). For the one event where the knock window switches length, it shifts the channel's background reference so the switch does not read as knock: added when the window lengthens, subtracted when it shortens. Larger = more compensation in both directions (the lengthening event less likely to count as knock, the shortening event more likely). Leave alone unless recalibrating knock detection.

Larger = more compensation in both directions (the lengthening event less likely to count as knock, the shortening event more likely). Leave alone unless recalibrating knock detection.

table.name: Surge Damping Throttle Flow Map
table.description: Converts throttle opening and rpm into a flow fraction (probably how much the throttle limits airflow); how fast this value changes is what triggers and sizes the surge damping timing retard. Changing it changes how strongly a throttle step triggers surge damping.

table.name: Ignition Timing Per-Cylinder Trim Enable
table.description: Switches on the per-cylinder timing trim tables.

table.name: Base Timing (Pedal Released, TGV Open)
table.description: Base ignition timing map for the pedal fully released (idle and deceleration) with the TGVs open; from 1200 rpm up its rows equal Base Timing (EGR Off, TGV Open). It is only an upper limit: the ECU fires the lower of this map and Closed-Pedal Timing Target (plus its corrections).

table.name: Ignition Timing Cap (Pedal Released, TGV Closed)
table.description: Maximum timing allowed with the pedal fully released (idle and deceleration), by rpm and load, TGV-closed side; blended with Ignition Timing Cap (Pedal Released, TGV Open) by how far the TGVs are open. Never limits timing with the pedal pressed. The rpm axis ends at 4,000 rpm.

table.name: Ignition Timing Cap (Pedal Released, TGV Open)
table.description: Maximum timing allowed with the pedal fully released (idle and deceleration), by rpm and load, TGV-open side; blended with Ignition Timing Cap (Pedal Released, TGV Closed) by how far the TGVs are open. Never limits timing with the pedal pressed.

table.name: Closed-Pedal Timing Target (AT Drive Range)
table.description: AT version of Closed-Pedal Timing Target, used with the pedal released while the transmission is probably in a drive range.

Target Torque Rise Path B Coolant Rise
table.description:
Part of the condition that lets Path B tip-in smoothing act, based on how much the coolant has warmed since start.
Details: When used: only matters with Target Torque Rise: Enable Path B set. Gate of Path B (0x0BBA32..0x0BBA90, read): the warm condition is FFF80B96 >= cal 0x22A0C (16384 = 0 degC) and coolant at start FFF89224 >= cal 0x22A0A (50 = 0 degC, degC + 50 unit); while it holds, Path B stays available if clamp(FFF80B96 - FFF89224) < this(FFF89224). FFF80B96 is a copy of coolant FFF88A44 taken by 0x082F7E / 0x082FB0 under start/state conditions (read); which moment it captures is not identified. Data = coolant difference in the 409.6-per-degC unit offset by 0x4000 (40 degC) (read). 0x0BB958 (read; called from the torque module 0x0BE694 at 0x0BF612 with the limited request FFF8AEC2, the previous output FFF8AEC6, gear FFF8A621, rpm FFF8CD54, drive mode FFF8A8C1, pedal FFF8AF00 and, as stack argument 11, cal 0x23704 bit 6; argument order checked in the disassembly). Path B (read, 0x0BB958 0x0BCEFE..0x0BCF96): a second rise-shaping path evaluated after the main one. It acts only while Target Torque Rise: Enable Path B (cal 0x23704 bit 6) is set, FFF88BAA >= cal 0x22A08 (80; hysteresis 0x22A09), rpm FFF8CD54 <= cal 0x22A04, and the Path B gate is open. The gate is open unless all three hold: FFF8AE64 <= Target Torque Rise Path B Pedal-Released Low-Speed Time(FFF88BAA), FFF8AF1C <=...Path B Low-Speed Time(FFF88BAA), and (the warm condition is false or FFF80B96 - coolant at start FFF89224 >=...Path B Coolant Rise(FFF89224)). Step1B = (Path B Stage 1 table - 16000) x gear cal 0x229F0 + 2(g-1) x Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 Pedal Multiplier (Path B)(FFF8AF00) / 65025; Step2B the same with cal 0x229FA.. (1, 2, 5, 5, 5) and the Path B Stage 2 Pedal Multiplier; gear cals apply only while FFF8A63D bit 4 is set. With prev = Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Path B Low-Speed Time
table.description:
Part of the condition that lets Path B tip-in smoothing act: probably the time the car has been stopped. Its axis input is not identified (raw).
Details: When used: only matters with Target Torque Rise: Enable Path B set. Gate of Path B: Path B stays available while FFF8AF1C > this(FFF88BAA) (0x0BBA6C, read). FFF8AE5E counts 10 ms passes while vehicle speed FFF88BE8 > cal 0x229E6 (0; hysteresis 0x229E8) (0x0BA48C, read). FFF8AE64 counts passes while the pedal-released flag FFF88C64 bit 5 is set and speed <= cal 0x229EC (0; hysteresis 0x229EE) (0x0BA7E0, read); FFF8AF1C counts passes while speed <= cal 0x22A0E (0; hysteresis 0x22A10) (0x0C065C, read). So they are the time stopped (pedal released / any pedal) since the car last moved. FFF88BAA is a byte copied from FFF8CC56 / FFF8CC01 / FFF8CC3B (0x080000 segment); its meaning is not identified, so the axis is raw. 0x0BB958 (read; called from the torque module 0x0BE694 at 0x0BF612 with the limited request FFF8AEC2, the previous output FFF8AEC6, gear FFF8A621, rpm FFF8CD54, drive mode FFF8A8C1, pedal FFF8AF00 and, as stack argument 11, cal 0x23704 bit 6; argument order checked in the disassembly). It acts only while Target Torque Rise: Enable Path B (cal 0x23704 bit 6) is set, FFF88BAA >= cal 0x22A08 (80; hysteresis 0x22A09), rpm FFF8CD54 <= cal 0x22A04, and the Path B gate is open. The gate is open unless all three hold: FFF8AE64 <= Target Torque Rise Path B Pedal-Released Low-Speed Time(FFF88BAA), FFF8AF1C <=...Path B Low-Speed Time(FFF88BAA), and (the warm condition is false or FFF80B96 - coolant at start FFF89224 >=...Path B Coolant Rise(FFF89224)). Step1B = (Path B Stage 1 table - 16000) x gear cal 0x229F0 + 2(g-1) x Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 Pedal Multiplier (Path B)(FFF8AF00) / 65025; Step2B the same with cal 0x229FA.. (1, 2, 5, 5, 5) and the Path B Stage 2 Pedal Multiplier; gear cals apply only while FFF8A63D bit 4 is set. With prev = Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Start Torque (Path B, Drive Mode 1, Default)
table.description:
Path B tip-in smoothing for drive mode 1 (the default and fallback mode): requests below this pass unsmoothed and Path B's slow stage starts here.
Drive mode 1, default (no AT/CVT split). Path B Start Torque, by gear x rpm: while the cal bit is set a request below it passes unshaped, and Path B's Stage 1 ramp starts from it (FFF8AE2C/FFF8AE78). 0x0BB958 (read; called from the torque module 0x0BE694 at 0x0BF612 with the limited request FFF8AEC2, the previous output FFF8AEC6, gear FFF8A621, rpm FFF8CD54, drive mode FFF8A8C1, pedal FFF8AF00 and, as stack argument 11, cal 0x23704 bit 6; argument order checked in the disassembly). Path B (read, 0x0BB958 0x0BCEFE..0x0BCF96): a second rise-shaping path evaluated after the main one. It acts only while Target Torque Rise: Enable Path B (cal 0x23704 bit 6) is set, FFF88BAA >= cal 0x22A08 (80; hysteresis 0x22A09), rpm FFF8CD54 <= cal 0x22A04, and the Path B gate is open. The gate is open unless all three hold: FFF8AE64 <= Target Torque Rise Path B Pedal-Released Low-Speed Time(FFF88BAA), FFF8AF1C <=...Path B Low-Speed Time(FFF88BAA), and (the warm condition is false or FFF80B96 - coolant at start FFF89224 >=...Path B Coolant Rise(FFF89224)). Step1B = (Path B Stage 1 table - 16000) x gear cal 0x229F0 + 2(g-1) x Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 Pedal Multiplier (Path B)(FFF8AF00) / 65025; Step2B the same with cal 0x229FA.. (1, 2, 5, 5, 5) and the Path B Stage 2 Pedal Multiplier; gear cals apply only while FFF8A63D bit 4 is set. With prev = Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Rev Limit Full Cut Reset RPM
Maximum Torque (IAT)
table.description: Maximum target torque by rpm and intake air temperature. The ECU uses the lowest of this, Maximum Torque (DAM) and other limits, and the result drives the boost target.

table.name: Rev/Boost Limit Torque Stage 1 Reset MAP
Rev/Boost Limit Torque Stage 2 Hold MAP
Rev/Boost Limit Torque Caps Enable
table.description: Lets the rev limiter and overboost cut close the throttle (the Rev/Boost Limit Torque tables).

table.name: Park/Neutral RPM Limit (AT/CVT)
table.description: Automatic/CVT only: with the selector in P or N, cylinders are cut once the engine reaches this speed, so a parked car cannot be revved past it. The cut stays on until the engine drops by the hysteresis. It does nothing on a manual-coded ECU. Separate from the normal rev limit.

table.name: Park/Neutral RPM Limit Hysteresis (AT/CVT)
table.description: How far below the Park/Neutral RPM Limit the engine has to fall before the cut ends.

table.name: Vehicle Speed Limit Full Cut Speed
Vehicle Speed Limit Full Cut Speed Hysteresis
Vehicle Speed Limit Reset Maximum MAP
Vehicle Speed Limit Reset Maximum MAP Hysteresis
Vehicle Speed Limit (Pedal)
table.description: The speed limiter in use: the share of the driver's pedal request allowed (100 % = no limit) by vehicle speed. It works above Vehicle Speed Limit (Pedal) Minimum RPM. The other three speed tables are variants for drive mode 3 (Intelligent) and for a VDC flag: to move or remove the limit, edit all four, or turn on Pedal Limits Disable. The fuel-cut Vehicle Speed Limit set is a separate limiter.

table.name: Vehicle Speed Limit (Pedal, Drive Mode 3, Intelligent)
table.description: As Vehicle Speed Limit (Pedal), in drive mode 3 (Intelligent). Edit it together with the other three.

table.name: Rev Limit Full Cut Speed Threshold
Vehicle Speed Limit (Pedal, VDC Flag)
table.description: As Vehicle Speed Limit (Pedal), while a status flag from the VDC unit is set (its meaning is not decoded). Edit it together with the other three.

table.name: Vehicle Speed Limit (Pedal, VDC Flag, Drive Mode 3, Intelligent)
table.description: As Vehicle Speed Limit (Pedal, VDC Flag), in drive mode 3 (Intelligent). Edit it together with the other three.

table.name: Vehicle Speed Limit (Pedal, VDC Flag) Minimum RPM
Vehicle Speed Limit (Pedal) Speed Signal Fault RPM Limit
table.description: Takes over from the speed tables when the vehicle speed cannot be trusted (a speed sensor fault, or CAN messages from the transmission or VDC missing): the pedal request is then limited by engine speed. Leave it as it is unless you know you need to change it.

table.name: Rev Limit Full Cut Speed Threshold Hysteresis
Vehicle Speed Limit (Pedal, VDC Flag) Speed Signal Fault RPM Limit
table.description: As Vehicle Speed Limit (Pedal) Speed Signal Fault RPM Limit, while the VDC flag is set.

table.name: Limit-State Spark: Normal Target in Speed Limit
Limit-State Spark: Normal Target in Rev/Overboost Cut
External Torque Limit Baro Factor
table.description: Air-density correction (barometric part) applied to a torque limit received over CAN, probably from the transmission controller.

table.name: External Torque Limit IAT Factor
table.description: Air-density correction (intake temperature part) applied to a torque limit received over CAN, probably from the transmission controller.

Throttle Opening from Target Torque (TGV Closed, Monitor)

Throttle Opening from Target Torque (TGV Open, Monitor)
Throttle Opening from Target Torque (TGV Closed, EGR)

Throttle Opening from Target Torque (TGV Open, EGR, Monitor)
