table.description: Alternate minimum rpm in the next gear up, by pedal and gear, for an upshift to be advised by the gear advice function.

table.name: A/F Sensor Scaling (Wide Range)
table.description: Converts the front wideband A/F sensor signal to lambda when the reading is outside about lambda 0.90-1.37. This is the measured lambda used by closed loop fueling.

table.name: A/F Sensor Scaling (Near Stoich)
table.description: Converts the front A/F sensor signal to lambda when it reads within about lambda 0.90-1.37, at a higher gain.

table.name: Battery Temperature Sensor Scaling
table.description: Converts the battery temperature sensor voltage to degrees for the charging-voltage control. It is probably the temperature half of the battery sensor, whose current signal the ECU also reads. Leave alone unless the battery sensor is changed.

table.name: Rear O2 Sensor Ready Heater Energy Threshold
table.description: How much heater energy, by coolant temperature at start, the rear O2 sensor must have received before it is treated as warmed up and ready. Raising it delays the rear O2 sensor (and its diagnostics) becoming active.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling
table.description: Base open-loop (power enrichment) AFR target by rpm and load, used once the exhaust temperature estimate is high enough. The ECU uses the richer of this and the Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV..., AVCS...) group: to lean, edit both; to richen, either. Also see Open Loop Fueling Floor (Outside Closed Loop).

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV Closed, AVCS Inactive)
table.description: Open-loop AFR target for TGVs closed with AVCS not in active control, part of a blend by TGV position and AVCS state, used above Open Loop Delay Load Threshold after a delay. The ECU uses the richer of the two systems, so leaning needs both.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV Closed, AVCS Active)
table.description: Open-loop AFR target for TGVs closed with AVCS in active control, part of a blend by TGV position and AVCS state, used above Open Loop Delay Load Threshold after a delay. The ECU uses the richer of the two systems, so leaning needs both.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV Open, AVCS Inactive)
table.description: Open-loop AFR target for TGVs open with AVCS not in active control, part of a blend by TGV position and AVCS state, used above Open Loop Delay Load Threshold after a delay. The ECU uses the richer of the two systems, so leaning needs both.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV Open, AVCS Active)
table.description: Open-loop AFR target for TGVs open with AVCS in active control, part of a blend by TGV position and AVCS state, used above Open Loop Delay Load Threshold after a delay. The ECU uses the richer of the two systems, so leaning needs both.

table.name: Open Loop Fueling Floor (Outside Closed Loop)
Primary Open Loop Fueling Additive
table.description: Extra open-loop enrichment added to Primary Open Loop Fueling, scaled by its DAM multiplier: full at DAM 0, none at DAM 1. Probably the classic knock-dependent extra fuel. Edit with Primary Open Loop Fueling Additive (TGV/AVCS Group).

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling Additive DAM Multiplier
table.description: Scales Primary Open Loop Fueling Additive by the Dynamic Advance Multiplier (DAM), so the extra fuel is added as knock history lowers DAM. Edit with the (TGV/AVCS Group) copy.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling Additive (TGV/AVCS Group)
table.description: Knock-dependent extra enrichment for the TGV/AVCS open-loop group, scaled by its DAM multiplier (full at DAM 0, none at DAM 1).

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling Additive DAM Multiplier (TGV/AVCS Group)
table.description: Scales Primary Open Loop Fueling Additive (TGV/AVCS Group) by DAM (128 = x1.0).

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling Subtractive (TGV/AVCS Group)
table.description: Fuel removed from the TGV/AVCS open-loop group, scaled by its own DAM multiplier (negative cells add fuel). Leaning only works where Primary Open Loop Fueling is not richer.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling Subtractive DAM Multiplier (TGV/AVCS Group)
table.description: Scales Primary Open Loop Fueling Subtractive (TGV/AVCS Group) by DAM (128 = x1.0).

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling Subtractive
table.description: Fuel removed from Primary Open Loop Fueling, scaled by its DAM multiplier (negative cells add fuel). It only leans the target where the TGV/AVCS group is not richer.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling Subtractive DAM Multiplier
table.description: Scales Primary Open Loop Fueling Subtractive by DAM (128 = x1.0).

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling (Alternate)
table.description:
Replacement for Primary Open Loop Fueling plus its knock additive, used only when the calibration switch 'Open Loop Fueling. Edit with Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV/AVCS Group, Alternate) if you enable it.
Details: When used: only when cal 0x2F79A bit 4 is set (read; 2017 0x36B76, 2018 0x37FF2). The bit is the first argument of 0x0CE854 (call in 0x0C589C, read). With it set, 0x0CE854 uses this table + cal 0x18DDC in place of the base table plus the DAM-scaled additive, while DAM16 FFF811AE < cal 0x18DDD; otherwise Primary Open Loop Fueling + cal 0x18DDC (read). The TGV/AVCS group has its own alternate (Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV/AVCS Group, Alternate)); edit both if you enable the switch. LF79100P: located from LF75404S 05AC80 by the code that reads it (read). LF79110N: same code as LF79100P; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LF79120P: same code as LF79110N; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 066E18. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV/AVCS Group, Alternate)
table.description:
Replacement for the TGV/AVCS open-loop group plus its knock additive, used only with the 'Use Alternate Map' calibration switch set.
Details: When used: only with cal 0x2F79A bit 4 set and DAM16 FFF811AE < cal 0x1391C (16). Replaces the TGV/AVCS blend plus knock additive in FFF8A681. 0x0CE5E8 (read; called from 0x0C589C with rpm FFF8CD54, load FFF8A616, cal 0x2F79A bit 4, DAM FFF811AE, AVCS weight FFF8A743 and TGV open fraction FFF8B3E8): TGV-closed base = 05ABB0 x (255 - a)/255 + 05ABD8 x a/255, TGV-open base = 05ABC4 x (255 - a)/255 + 05ABEC x a/255, where a = FFF8A743 is the AVCS-active weight from 0x0D952C (255 while both cam controllers are in active control, my research notes); blend FFF8A69B = closed x (1 - FFF8B3E8) + open x FFF8B3E8. With cal 0x2F79A bit 4 clear. With the bit set: Alternate (+ cal 0x13DCD) while DAM16 < cal 0x1391C (16), else blend + cal 0x13DCD. 0x0CEA80 (read) then takes FFF8A681 (only once FFF8AFD6 >= FFF8AFE6, the open-loop delay, and when >= cal 0x13DD0 = 5), scales it by cal 0x237CA/128 (x1.0), rate-limits its rise by 05ACD4(rpm) and sets FFF8A684 = max(that, FFF8A682), FFF8A682 being Primary Open Loop Fueling from 0x0CE854. FFF8A684 is the open-loop enrichment in commanded lambda 256/(256 + B030 + A684 + AFE8) (0x171C88). So the commanded open-loop mixture is the richer of the two systems: to lean the target, lower this group as well as Primary Open Loop Fueling; to richen, raise this group (Primary Open Loop Fueling alone only takes effect while its exhaust-temperature enable holds: 0x0CE854 sets FFF8A683 to 0 unless FFF8AFD0 >= cal 0x18DD4 or FFF8C03C >= cal 0x18DD8, read). LF79100P: located from LF75404S 05AC00 by the code that reads it (read). LF79110N: same code as LF79100P; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LF79120P: same code as LF79110N; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 066BB8. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Additional Enrichment A
table.description:
Extra enrichment added to the open-loop enrichment at higher coolant and lower rpm.
Details: When used: A applies when coolant >= cal 0x13E18 and rpm < cal 0x13E0E, B when coolant < 0x13E1A or rpm >= 0x13E0C (in between the last value is held); the whole term needs FFF8A654 bit 1, whose thresholds (cal 0x13E08, 0x13E14) are 65535, and both tables are zero. Source of FFF8AFE8 (0x0CAF70, with B), a term of the commanded lambda and of the fuel factor FFF8AFBC, where it is added to the open-loop enrichment (0x0C558C, read). LF79100P: located from LF75404S 05A804 by the code that reads it (read). LF79110N: same code as LF79100P; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LF79120P: same code as LF79110N; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 06675C. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Additional Enrichment B
table.description:
Second table of the additional enrichment, used at low coolant or high rpm.
Details: When used: see Additional Enrichment A: B applies when coolant < cal 0x13E1A or rpm >= cal 0x13E0C (A when coolant >= cal 0x13E18 and rpm < cal 0x13E0E; in between the last value is held), and the whole term needs FFF8A654 bit 1. Second source table of FFF8AFE8. LF79100P: located from LF75404S 05A818 by the code that reads it (read). LF79110N: same code as LF79100P; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LF79120P: same code as LF79110N; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 066770. Confidence: inferred.

Cranking Prime Pulse Coolant Multiplier
table.description:
Size of what appears to be a one-shot priming injection at key-on/cranking, by coolant; the pulse is proportional to it.
Details: When used: only if cal 0x28D98 = 1 or 2. 0x0CD4AC (read): FFF8A67D = this(coolant FFF8CD65 = degC + 50) during key-on and cranking (fuel state 1/2), held afterwards. 0x0CD500 / 0x0CD5DC compute the pulses FFF8C040 / FFF8C044 = 05A8F4 / 05A908(rail pressure FFF89266, FFF8A652) x flow compensation FFF8AFEA x barometric factor FFF8A687 x FFF8A67D x 2^-18 x 1.25 + latency, and 0x1D296C fires each of them once per injector (flags FFF8C6F4-C6F7) when cal 0x28D98 = 1 or 2 (read): a one-shot priming injection at start (inferred). The pulse is proportional to this value. LF79100P: located from LF75404S 05A91C by the code that reads it (read). LF79110N: same code as LF79100P; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LF79120P: same code as LF79110N; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 0668D4. Confidence: inferred.

table.description: Watches for ignition timing pulled down to a floor that depends on DAM; when it trips, the knock-event torque limit applies.

table.name: Knock Event Detector: Knocking Cylinders

table.name: Knock Event Low Timing Hysteresis

table.name: Knock Event Feedback Correction Hysteresis

table.name: Knock Event Cylinder Count Limit (Fine Learning)

table.name: Knock Event Fine Learning Correction Hysteresis

table.name: Base Timing DAM Blend (DAM 1)

table.name: Base Timing DAM Blend B (DAM 0)

table.name: Base Timing DAM Blend B (DAM 1)

table.name: FLKC Counted-Cell Learned Value Threshold
table.description:
By DAM: a fine-knock-learning cell is counted when its learned value is at or above this, and the count sets an internal flag.
0x0E7DF8 (read): one cell per pass, it counts the FLKC cells whose flag FFF811AF[cell] is 1 and whose learned value FFF81414[cell] is at or above this(DAM FFF811AE); after all 35 cells the count goes to FFF8A792 and FFF8A7A3 bit 1 = count >= cal 0x1C699 (4). 0x0E7D0C (read) uses that bit only together with DAM inside cal 0x1C698..0x1C697 (32..48 in DAM x 16 units), which DAM (0..16) never reaches. LF79100P: located from LF75404S 05C1B0 by the code that reads it (read). LF79110N: same code as LF79100P; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LF79120P: same code as LF79110N; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 068524. Confidence: read.

table.name: Base Timing DAM Blend Alternate (DAM 0)
table.description:
Alternate DAM-blended timing offset (DAM 0 side) for base timing. 32 = no change.
Weighted (16 - DAM)/16. 0x0D9BD4 (read): FFF8A73F = ((16 - DAM) x 05B54C + DAM x 05B560) / 16 in the 32-offset half-degree frame, DAM = FFF811AE (0..16), tables by rpm FFF8CD54 x load FFF8ADE4. 0x0D9CA0: FFF8A73E = (A73F + FFF8A73B - 32) x FFF8B0D2 / 256 + 32, and FFF8A740 = A73E when FFF8A8A5 bit 4 is set, else A73D (the 05B574/05B588 path) (read). FFF8A73E/A73F have no other readers. With cal 0x32DEA = 'Z' the base timing term FFF8A73C would ramp toward A740 (cal 0x32DEC per pass) and enter the base timing sum FFF8A74B (0x0DA600). LF79100P: located from LF75404S 05B54C by its caller in the decompiled code (read). LF79110N: same code as LF79100P; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LF79120P: same code as LF79110N; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 06788C. Confidence: read.

table.name: Base Timing DAM Blend Alternate (DAM 1)
table.description:
Alternate DAM-blended timing offset (DAM 1 side) for base timing. 32 = no change.
Weighted DAM/16. 0x0D9BD4 (read): FFF8A73F = ((16 - DAM) x 05B54C + DAM x 05B560) / 16 in the 32-offset half-degree frame, DAM = FFF811AE (0..16), tables by rpm FFF8CD54 x load FFF8ADE4. 0x0D9CA0: FFF8A73E = (A73F + FFF8A73B - 32) x FFF8B0D2 / 256 + 32, and FFF8A740 = A73E when FFF8A8A5 bit 4 is set, else A73D (the 05B574/05B588 path) (read). FFF8A73E/A73F have no other readers. With cal 0x32DEA = 'Z' the base timing term FFF8A73C would ramp toward A740 (cal 0x32DEC per pass) and enter the base timing sum FFF8A74B (0x0DA600). LF79100P: located from LF75404S 05B560 by its caller in the decompiled code (read). LF79110N: same code as LF79100P; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LF79120P: same code as LF79110N; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 0678A0. Confidence: read.

table.name: Knock Threshold (Event 1, Full Window)
table.description: Knock intensity (sum of the three strongest knock-channel ratios to their background, 3.0 = all at background) (by rpm and load) above which a knock event in slot 1 counts as knock and triggers feedback knock retard; used while the extended (full) knock window is in use. Higher = less sensitive. Warning: the Full / Short Window sets were renamed on 2026-10-30 (earlier names had them swapped). Which cylinder slot 1 is has not been mapped.

table.name: Knock Background Window Step (Event 4, Channel 3)
table.description: Knock signal processing for event slot 4, channel 3 (probably a frequency band of the knock sensor). For the one event where the knock window switches length, it shifts the channel's background reference so the switch does not read as knock: added when the window lengthens, subtracted when it shortens. Larger = more compensation in both directions (the lengthening event less likely to count as knock, the shortening event more likely). Leave alone unless recalibrating knock detection.

table.name: Knock Background Window Step (Event 4, Channel 4)

For the one event where the knock window switches length, it shifts the channel's background reference so the switch does not read as knock: added when the window lengthens, subtracted when it shortens. Larger = more compensation in both directions (the lengthening event less likely to count as knock, the shortening event more likely). Leave alone unless recalibrating knock detection.

table.name: Surge Damping Timing Curve (AT/CVT Gear 1)
table.description:

table.name: Surge Damping Timing Combustion Mode Factor
table.description: Scales the surge damping timing correction by combustion mode (0 = off, 1.0 = full).

table.name: Surge Damping Throttle Flow Map
table.description: Converts throttle opening and rpm into a flow fraction (probably how much the throttle limits airflow); how fast this value changes is what triggers and sizes the surge damping timing retard. Changing it changes how strongly a throttle step triggers surge damping.

table.name: A/C Cut Timing Retard Step (Alternate Logic)
Ignition Timing Per-Cylinder Trim Enable
table.description: Switches on the per-cylinder timing trim tables.

table.name: Base Timing (Pedal Released, TGV Open)
table.description: Base ignition timing map for the pedal fully released (idle and deceleration) with the TGVs open; from 1200 rpm up its rows equal Base Timing (EGR Off, TGV Open). It is only an upper limit: the ECU fires the lower of this map and Closed-Pedal Timing Target (plus its corrections).

table.name: Base Timing (Pedal Released, TGV Closed)
table.description: Base ignition timing map for the pedal fully released (idle and deceleration) with the TGVs closed. It is only an upper limit: the ECU fires the lower of this map and Closed-Pedal Timing Target (plus its corrections).

table.name: Ignition Timing Cap (Pedal Released, TGV Closed)
table.description: Maximum timing allowed with the pedal fully released (idle and deceleration), by rpm and load, TGV-closed side; blended with Ignition Timing Cap (Pedal Released, TGV Open) by how far the TGVs are open. Never limits timing with the pedal pressed. The rpm axis ends at 4,000 rpm.

table.name: Ignition Timing Cap (Pedal Released, TGV Open)
table.description: Maximum timing allowed with the pedal fully released (idle and deceleration), by rpm and load, TGV-open side; blended with Ignition Timing Cap (Pedal Released, TGV Closed) by how far the TGVs are open. Never limits timing with the pedal pressed.

table.name: Closed-Pedal Timing Coolant Compensation RPM Multiplier
Post-Start Closed-Pedal Timing Advance (Coolant at Start)
Start Spark Target Base (Mode 1)
table.description: Base spark target by rpm and coolant for the cold-start / catalyst-heating mode (pedal released, car stopped, below 4000 rpm); the manual-car set. Torque, run-time and re-entry adders go on top. It feeds the torque model and cold-start monitors; the fired spark probably follows other paths.

table.name: Start Spark Target Base (Mode 1, AT/CVT)
table.description:
AT/CVT copy of Start Spark Target Base (Mode 1).
Details: When used: FFF8A7E2 bit 0 clear (never on the manual coding), FFF899D7 bit 0 clear. 0x108BAC (catalyst-heating module, read) writes FFF8A854, which 0x0C3200 selects as the spark target FFF8A647 in fuel mode FFF8A852 = 2 (combustion mode FFF8A85C 1 or 3, 0x108B08). A647 is the spark the torque model compensates for (0x0C2514, 0x0C1EA8) and the reference of the cold-start retard monitors (0x1CB70C, 0x132568: A72A - A854) (read); the fired spark in this mode follows FFF8A74C/FFF8A76B (0x0DA428), not A854 (read). In combustion mode 1 (A85C < 2), at <= 4000 rpm (cal 0x1CBD8), with the pedal released (FFF886AB bit 5) and speed below cal 0x2A0C1 (2 km/h): A854 = Base(rpm FFF8CD5C, coolant) + Torque Adder(FFF8A85E, coolant) + Run-Time Adder(passes since the engine state became running, coolant) + Re-Entry Adder(passes since mode 1 was re-entered from normal mode 4, coolant), saturated to a byte; the set is chosen by FFF8A7E2 bit 0 (set = the manual tables, clear = the "AT/CVT" tables; always set on the manual coding, Phase 14) and FFF899D7 bit 0 (set = the "Warm-Up Fallback" tables): a once-per-drive warm-up fallback latch set by 0x081EFC only when cal 0x59134 bit 0 is set. Otherwise in mode 1 A854 = 05D0BC x 05D0A8 / 256 + FFF8A789 - 32; in mode 3 A854 = A72A (normal target) (read). with cal 0x2996C bit 6 set A854 is forced to cal 0x2A0C0. Units: A854 is compared with A72A and final timing in 0.5 degree units (inferred). LF79100P: located from LF75404S 05D030 by the code that reads it (read). LF79110N: same code as LF79100P; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LF79120P: same code as LF79110N; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 069488. Confidence: inferred.

Part of the condition that lets Path B tip-in smoothing act, based on how much the coolant has warmed since start.
Details: When used: only matters with Target Torque Rise: Enable Path B set. Gate of Path B (0x0BBA32..0x0BBA90, read): the warm condition is FFF80B96 >= cal 0x22A0C (16384 = 0 degC) and coolant at start FFF89224 >= cal 0x22A0A (50 = 0 degC, degC + 50 unit); while it holds, Path B stays available if clamp(FFF80B96 - FFF89224) < this(FFF89224). FFF80B96 is a copy of coolant FFF88A44 taken by 0x082F7E / 0x082FB0 under start/state conditions (read); which moment it captures is not identified. Data = coolant difference in the 409.6-per-degC unit offset by 0x4000 (40 degC) (read). 0x0BB958 (read; called from the torque module 0x0BE694 at 0x0BF612 with the limited request FFF8AEC2, the previous output FFF8AEC6, gear FFF8A621, rpm FFF8CD54, drive mode FFF8A8C1, pedal FFF8AF00 and, as stack argument 11, cal 0x23704 bit 6; argument order checked in the disassembly). table.name: Primary Ignition (TGV Closed, AVCS Active)
table.description: Knock-limited ignition timing by rpm and load for TGVs closed while the cams are under AVCS control. With the knock correction advance and fine learning added it forms one side of the timing limit: the ECU fires the lower of this sum and the Base Timing map.

table.name: Primary Ignition (TGV Closed, AVCS Inactive)
table.description: Knock-limited ignition timing by rpm and load for TGVs closed while AVCS is not controlling (start-up, hold or fault), blended in when AVCS drops out. With knock correction advance and fine learning added it forms one side of the timing limit; the ECU fires the lower of this sum and the Base Timing map.

table.name: Primary Ignition (TGV Open, AVCS Active)
table.description: Knock-limited ignition timing by rpm and load for TGVs open while the cams are under AVCS control. With the knock correction advance and fine learning added it forms one side of the timing limit: the ECU fires the lower of this sum and the Base Timing map.

table.name: Primary Ignition (TGV Open, AVCS Inactive)
table.description: Knock-limited ignition timing by rpm and load for TGVs open while AVCS is not controlling (start-up, hold or fault), blended in when AVCS drops out. With knock correction advance and fine learning added it forms one side of the timing limit; the ECU fires the lower of this sum and the Base Timing map.

Manifold Model Start Correction MAF Gain
Throttle Flow Coefficient (Reverse Flow)
table.description:
Coefficient of the throttle airflow model when the manifold is above the pre-throttle pressure. Leave alone.
Details: When used: every model pass while r > 1.0 (manifold above the pre-throttle pressure; the ratio is inverted). 0x11DD04 (read), enabled by FFF8A8FB bit 0 (0x11E43C): modelled throttle flow FFF8C24C [g/min] = (P_up/101325) x Throttle Flow Function(r) x FFF8ADEC (Throttle Area from Throttle Position, 0.05 mm^2) x Throttle Flow Temperature Correction x this x 60000 x 2.98e-15, which feeds the manifold/airflow observer 0x11DB50 / 0x11D938. Normally leave alone. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Map A (No Enrichment)
table.description: Exhaust temperature estimate (inferred) that decides when Primary Open Loop Fueling kicks in. Map A is the fast-reacting part, by rpm and load, used while no open loop enrichment is active. Raising it brings enrichment in earlier; lowering it delays it.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Map A (Enriched)
table.description: Exhaust temperature estimate (inferred) that decides when Primary Open Loop Fueling kicks in. Map A is the fast-reacting part, by rpm and load, used while open loop enrichment is active. Raising it brings enrichment in earlier; lowering it delays it.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Map A (Standstill High Load)
table.description: Exhaust temperature estimate (inferred) that decides when Primary Open Loop Fueling kicks in. Map A is the fast-reacting part, by rpm and load, used instead of the other Map A tables while the car is at a standstill under high load (speed 5 km/h or less, pedal 80 % or more, load 40 % or more, for 1 s). Raising it brings enrichment in earlier; lowering it delays it.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Map B (No Enrichment)
table.description: Exhaust temperature estimate (inferred) that decides when Primary Open Loop Fueling kicks in. Map B is the steady-state value the estimate settles to, by rpm and load, used while no open loop enrichment is active. Raising it brings enrichment in earlier; lowering it delays it.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Map B (Enriched)
table.description: Exhaust temperature estimate (inferred) that decides when Primary Open Loop Fueling kicks in. Map B is the steady-state value the estimate settles to, by rpm and load, used while open loop enrichment is active. Raising it brings enrichment in earlier; lowering it delays it.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Map B (Standstill High Load)
table.description: Exhaust temperature estimate (inferred) that decides when Primary Open Loop Fueling kicks in. Map B is the steady-state value the estimate settles to, by rpm and load, used while an unidentified speed/pedal/load flag is set. Raising it brings enrichment in earlier; lowering it delays it.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Retard Multiplier A (No Enrichment)
table.description: Exhaust temperature estimate (inferred) that decides when Primary Open Loop Fueling kicks in. Multiplies Exhaust Temperature Model Map A (No Enrichment) by timing retard. The Map A part only shapes how the estimate moves while conditions change: it is added through Filter A and taken off again through Filter B, so the settled value depends only on Map B x Retard Multiplier B.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Retard Multiplier A (Enriched)
table.description: Exhaust temperature estimate (inferred) that decides when Primary Open Loop Fueling kicks in. Multiplies Exhaust Temperature Model Map A (Enriched) by timing retard. The Map A part only shapes how the estimate moves while conditions change: it is added through Filter A and taken off again through Filter B, so the settled value depends only on Map B x Retard Multiplier B.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Retard Multiplier B (No Enrichment)
table.description: Exhaust temperature estimate (inferred) that decides when Primary Open Loop Fueling kicks in. Multiplies Exhaust Temperature Model Map B (No Enrichment) by timing retard: more retard, hotter estimate.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Retard Multiplier B (Enriched)
table.description: Exhaust temperature estimate (inferred) that decides when Primary Open Loop Fueling kicks in. Multiplies Exhaust Temperature Model Map B (Enriched) by timing retard: more retard, hotter estimate.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Filter A (Rising)
table.description: Exhaust temperature estimate (inferred) that decides when Primary Open Loop Fueling kicks in. How quickly the Map A part of the estimate follows a rising value (higher = faster).

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Filter A (Falling)
table.description: Exhaust temperature estimate (inferred) that decides when Primary Open Loop Fueling kicks in. How quickly the Map A part of the estimate follows a falling value (higher = faster).

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Filter B (Rising)
table.description: Exhaust temperature estimate (inferred) that decides when Primary Open Loop Fueling kicks in. How quickly the Map B part of the estimate follows a rising value (higher = faster).

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Filter B (Falling)
table.description: Exhaust temperature estimate (inferred) that decides when Primary Open Loop Fueling kicks in. How quickly the Map B part of the estimate follows a falling value (higher = faster).

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Fuel Cut Step
table.description: Exhaust temperature estimate (inferred): an amount added to the estimate at the start of each fuel cut, by air quantity, which then decays away by Exhaust Temperature Model Fuel Cut Decay.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Fuel Cut Decay
table.description: Exhaust temperature estimate (inferred): how fast the fuel-cut term from Exhaust Temperature Model Fuel Cut Step decays, by air quantity (1.0 = no decay).

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Estimate 2 Map (Standstill High Load)
A/F Sensor Exhaust Temp Model Base
A/F Sensor Exhaust Temp Model Timing Factor
A/F Sensor Exhaust Temp Model Retard Factor
A/F Sensor Exhaust Temp Model Filter
A/F Sensor Exhaust Model Condensate at Start
A/F Sensor Exhaust Model Condensation Flow Factor
A/F Sensor Exhaust Model Saturation Vapour Pressure
A/F Sensor Exhaust Temp Model Hot Restart Factor (2D)
table.description: Later-software version of A/F Sensor Exhaust Temp Model Hot Restart Factor: on a hot restart the exhaust model starts from the stored pipe temperature times this factor, by stored temperature and coolant drop. Normally leave alone.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Map A Enrichment Adder
table.description:
2017+ only: extra amount added to Exhaust Temperature Model Map A (Enriched) while open loop enrichment is active, scaled by how far the enrichment has progressed (inferred).
Details: When used: while open-loop enrichment is active (FFF8ABF4 != 0). 2017+ only. The LF79002P exhaust temperature model adds a signed term in the enriched branch (read, LF79002P decompilation): value = enriched map x retard multiplier / 256 + FFF8ABEE x this(rpm FFF8D3D4, load FFF8AB76)/256. FFF8ABEE = (enrichment FFF8ABF4 - FFF8ABF5) x 256 / (FFF8ABED - FFF8ABF5), clamped 0..255 (0x0DFB18, read), where FFF8ABED comes from 0x0DFA88, the Primary Open Loop Fueling style lookup on the 24 x 20 open-loop grid (0655F8 + 065620 x 065640(DAM) - 065634 x 06560C) - i.e. how far the enrichment has come towards the open-loop target (inferred). The table uses that same 24 x 20 grid (400-9200 rpm x 0.91-2.97 g/rev (70-230 % load)). Same data address in all three images; descriptors placed from the call sites (LF79100P / LF9C100P callsite maps and decompilations, read). LF79002P 0x0D9F80 (counterpart of LF75404S 0x0C9878): added to S = Exhaust Temperature Model Map A (Enriched) 064D64 x Retard Multiplier A (Enriched) 064E78 / 256 (unless FFF8AE27 bit 4 selects the Standstill High Load map). LF79100P: a table LF75404S does not have. LF79110N: same code as LF79100P; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LF79120P: same code as LF79110N; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 066448. Confidence: read.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Map B Enrichment Adder
table.description:
2017+ only: extra amount added to Exhaust Temperature Model Map B (Enriched) while open loop enrichment is active, scaled by how far the enrichment has progressed (inferred).
Details: When used: while open-loop enrichment is active (FFF8ABF4 != 0). 2017+ only. The LF79002P exhaust temperature model adds a signed term in the enriched branch (read, LF79002P decompilation): value = enriched map x retard multiplier / 256 + FFF8ABEE x this(rpm FFF8D3D4, load FFF8AB76)/256. FFF8ABEE = (enrichment FFF8ABF4 - FFF8ABF5) x 256 / (FFF8ABED - FFF8ABF5), clamped 0..255 (0x0DFB18, read), where FFF8ABED comes from 0x0DFA88, the Primary Open Loop Fueling style lookup on the 24 x 20 open-loop grid (0655F8 + 065620 x 065640(DAM) - 065634 x 06560C) - i.e. how far the enrichment has come towards the open-loop target (inferred). The table uses that same 24 x 20 grid (400-9200 rpm x 0.91-2.97 g/rev (70-230 % load)). Same data address in all three images; descriptors placed from the call sites (LF79100P / LF9C100P callsite maps and decompilations, read). LF79002P 0x0D9F80: added to U = Exhaust Temperature Model Map B (Enriched) 064E04 x Retard Multiplier B (Enriched) 064E54 / 256 (unless FFF8AE27 bit 4 selects the Standstill High Load map). LF79100P: a table LF75404S does not have. LF79110N: same code as LF79100P; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LF79120P: same code as LF79110N; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 0664E8. Confidence: read.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Estimate 2 Enrichment Adder
table.description:
2017+ only: extra amount added to the second exhaust temperature estimate while open loop enrichment is active, scaled by how far the enrichment has progressed (inferred).
Details: When used: while open-loop enrichment is active (FFF8ABF4 != 0) and FFF8AE27 bit 4 is clear. 2017+ only. The LF79002P exhaust temperature model adds a signed term in the enriched branch (read, LF79002P decompilation): value = enriched map x retard multiplier / 256 + FFF8ABEE x this(rpm FFF8D3D4, load FFF8AB76)/256. FFF8ABEE = (enrichment FFF8ABF4 - FFF8ABF5) x 256 / (FFF8ABED - FFF8ABF5), clamped 0..255 (0x0DFB18, read), where FFF8ABED comes from 0x0DFA88, the Primary Open Loop Fueling style lookup on the 24 x 20 open-loop grid (0655F8 + 065620 x 065640(DAM) - 065634 x 06560C) - i.e. how far the enrichment has come towards the open-loop target (inferred). The table uses that same 24 x 20 grid (400-9200 rpm x 0.91-2.97 g/rev (70-230 % load)). Same data address in all three images; descriptors placed from the call sites (LF79100P / LF9C100P callsite maps and decompilations, read). LF79002P 0x0D8F60 (counterpart of LF75404S 0x0C965C): added to Exhaust Temperature Estimate 2 Map (Enriched) 064A0C x Retard Multiplier 064AAC / 256. LF79100P: a table LF75404S does not have. LF79110N: same code as LF79100P; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LF79120P: same code as LF79110N; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 066140. Confidence: read.

table.name: Intake Cam Target 1A (TGV Open, Normal, Altitude)
table.description: Intake cam advance target (degrees from the fully retarded rest position) by rpm and load for normal driving with the TGVs open, used at altitude (blended in by AVCS Barometric Blend; near sea level the 1B table is used instead). Higher = earlier intake valve timing. The normal vs high-pedal split is inferred from the switching conditions.

table.name: Intake Cam Target 1B (TGV Open, Normal, Sea Level)
table.description: Main intake cam advance target (degrees from rest) by rpm and load for normal driving with the TGVs open near sea level: above light part throttle, above about 5200 rpm, or cold. Higher = earlier intake timing. At light part throttle the TGVs close and Intake Cam Target 3B is used instead. Normal vs high-pedal split is inferred.

table.name: Intake Cam Target 2A (TGV Open, High Pedal, Altitude)
table.description: Intake cam advance target (degrees from rest) by rpm and load used when the pedal is near wide open (about 90 % or more), TGVs open, at altitude. Higher = earlier intake timing. The high-pedal meaning is inferred from the switching conditions.

table.name: Intake Cam Target 2B (TGV Open, High Pedal, Sea Level)
table.description: Intake cam advance target (degrees from rest) by rpm and load used when the pedal is near wide open (about 90 % or more), TGVs open, near sea level. This, not 1B, sets wide-open-throttle intake timing near sea level. Higher = earlier intake timing. The high-pedal meaning is inferred from the switching conditions.

table.name: Intake Cam Target 3A (TGV Closed, Altitude)
table.description: Intake cam advance target (degrees from rest) by rpm and load used while the TGVs are closed (light part throttle), at altitude. Higher = earlier intake timing. Near sea level Intake Cam Target 3B is used instead.

table.name: Intake Cam Target 3B (TGV Closed, Sea Level)
table.description: Intake cam advance target (degrees from rest) by rpm and load used while the TGVs are closed (light part throttle, cruising) near sea level. Higher = earlier intake timing. This is the table that sets light-load intake timing on most cars.

table.name: Intake Cam Coolant Offset 2A (High Pedal, Altitude)
table.description: Extra intake cam advance (degrees, scaled by the intake coolant factor) added to the high-pedal (near wide-open) TGV-open target at altitude. Not present in the 2015/2016 builds.

table.name: Intake Cam Coolant Offset 3A (TGV Closed, Altitude)
table.description: Extra intake cam advance (degrees, scaled by the intake coolant factor) added to the TGV-closed target at altitude. Not present in the 2015/2016 builds.

table.name: Intake Cam Coolant Offset B (Sea Level)
table.description: Extra intake cam advance (degrees) added to the final intake cam target near sea level (whatever the TGV state; with the TGVs closed it adds on top of Intake Cam Coolant Offset 3B), scaled by Intake Cam Coolant Factor so it can act only when cold. Positive = more advance.

table.name: Intake Cam Coolant Offset 2B (High Pedal, Sea Level)
table.description: Extra intake cam advance (degrees, scaled by the intake coolant factor) added to the high-pedal (near wide-open) TGV-open target at sea level. Not present in the 2015/2016 builds.

table.name: Intake Cam Coolant Offset 3B
table.description: Extra intake cam advance (degrees) added to Intake Cam Target 3B (TGVs closed, sea level), scaled by Intake Cam Coolant Factor 3 so it can act only when cold. Positive = more advance.

table.name: Exhaust Cam Target 1A (TGV Open, Normal, Altitude)
table.description: Exhaust cam retard target (degrees from the fully advanced rest position) by rpm and load for normal driving with the TGVs open, at altitude (near sea level 1B is used). Higher = later exhaust closing and more overlap. The normal vs high-pedal split is inferred.

table.name: Exhaust Cam Target 1B (TGV Open, Normal, Sea Level)
table.description: Main exhaust cam retard target (degrees from rest) by rpm and load for normal driving with the TGVs open near sea level. Higher = later exhaust closing and more valve overlap. At light part throttle the TGVs close and Exhaust Cam Target 3B is used instead. Normal vs high-pedal split is inferred.

table.name: Exhaust Cam Target 2A (TGV Open, High Pedal, Altitude)
table.description: Exhaust cam retard target (degrees from rest) by rpm and load used when the pedal is near wide open (about 90 % or more), TGVs open, at altitude. Higher = more overlap. The high-pedal meaning is inferred from the switching conditions.

table.name: Exhaust Cam Target 2B (TGV Open, High Pedal, Sea Level)
table.description: Exhaust cam retard target (degrees from rest) by rpm and load used when the pedal is near wide open (about 90 % or more), TGVs open, near sea level. Higher = more overlap. High-pedal meaning inferred.

table.name: Exhaust Cam Target 3B (TGV Closed, Sea Level)
table.description: Exhaust cam retard target (degrees from rest) by rpm and load while the TGVs are closed (light part throttle, cruising) near sea level. Higher = later exhaust closing and more overlap (internal EGR).

table.name: Exhaust Cam Coolant Offset A (Altitude)
table.description: Cold-engine correction (degrees of exhaust retard) added to the final exhaust cam target at altitude (whatever the TGV state), scaled by Exhaust Cam Coolant Factor. Positive = more retard.

table.name: Exhaust Cam Coolant Offset 2A (High Pedal, Altitude)
table.description: Extra exhaust cam retard (degrees, scaled by the exhaust coolant factor) added to the high-pedal (near wide-open) TGV-open target at altitude. Not present in the 2015/2016 builds.

table.name: Exhaust Cam Coolant Offset 3A (TGV Closed, Altitude)
table.description: Extra exhaust cam retard (degrees, scaled by the exhaust coolant factor) added to the TGV-closed target at altitude. Not present in the 2015/2016 builds.

table.name: Exhaust Cam Coolant Offset B (Sea Level)
table.description: Cold-engine correction (degrees of exhaust retard) added to the final exhaust cam target near sea level, scaled by Exhaust Cam Coolant Factor. It applies whatever the TGV state: with the TGVs closed it adds on top of Exhaust Cam Coolant Offset 3B.

table.name: Exhaust Cam Coolant Offset 2B (High Pedal, Sea Level)
table.description: Extra exhaust cam retard (degrees, scaled by the exhaust coolant factor) added to the high-pedal (near wide-open) TGV-open target at sea level. Not present in the 2015/2016 builds.

table.name: Exhaust Cam Coolant Offset 3B
table.description: Cold-engine correction (degrees of exhaust retard) added to Exhaust Cam Target 3B (TGVs closed, sea level), scaled by Exhaust Cam Coolant Factor 3. Exhaust Cam Coolant Offset B is added on top of it in all TGV states, so with the TGVs closed both act.

table.name: AVCS Barometric Blend
table.description: Share (0-100 %) of the altitude (A) cam target tables versus the sea-level (B) tables, by barometric pressure.

table.name: Intake AVCS Enable Delay After Start
table.description: Intake AVCS closed-loop control waits this long after start, by how long the engine was off and the oil temperature when it stopped.

table.name: Exhaust AVCS Enable Delay After Start
table.description: Exhaust AVCS closed-loop control waits this long after start, by how long the engine was off and the oil temperature when it stopped.

Idle Speed Target (Warm Idle, Mode 5)
table.description: Main idle speed target by coolant in normal running; this is the table to edit to change idle speed on a manual car. Automatic/CVT cars use Mode 6 instead.

table.name: Idle Speed Target (Warm Idle, AT/CVT, Mode 6)
table.description:
Warm idle speed target by coolant for automatic/CVT cars only; a manual car never uses this table.
Details: When used: only with the automatic/CVT transmission coding. With the manual coding the idle mode never becomes 6 (0x0F2BCC passes the mode through unchanged while FFF88ADA bit 7 is set, and 0x0F354C produces only modes 1-5 and 7, read), so on a manual car edit Mode 5. 0x0F1BCC selects this boot-format table by idle mode FFF8A7F0 = 6 and coolant; the result B238 is ramped (0x0F1D00) and becomes the idle target FFF8B236 through the minimum-speed max() in 0x0F2274. Implicit coolant axis -40..110 degC in 10 degC steps (lookup 0x7414, read). LF79100P: located from LF75404S 024B30 by its caller in the decompiled code (read). LF79110N: same code as LF79100P; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LF79120P: same code as LF79110N; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Data at 02BD0C. Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Speed Target (Post-Start, Modes 1/2)
table.description: Idle speed target by coolant right after a start (below 75 degC coolant) until the car moves or the engine warms to 50 degC, and while the engine is stopped. Raise for a higher fast-idle after cold starts.

table.name: Idle Speed Target (Warm Start, Mode 3)
table.description: Idle speed target by coolant after a hot restart (coolant at or above 75 degC at start), until the car moves. Raise for a higher idle right after hot starts.

table.name: Idle Speed Target (Warm-Up Drive-Off, Mode 7)
table.description: Idle speed target by coolant once the car has driven off after a cold start but the engine is still warming up (until coolant is above about 75 degC); then idle returns to Mode 5. Used on manual cars.

table.name: Idle Speed Target (Warm-Up Drive-Off, AT/CVT, Mode 8)
table.description:
Automatic/CVT version of Idle Speed Target (Warm-Up Drive-Off, Mode 7): idle speed by coolant once the car has moved off before the engine is warm. Never used on a manual car.
Details: When used: only with the automatic/CVT coding: mode 7 is mapped to 8 while FFF8A7E2 bit 0 is clear (read, 0x0F2BCC). Never on a manual car. 0x0F1BCC selects this boot-format table by idle mode FFF8A7F0 = 8 and coolant; the result B238 is ramped (0x0F1D00) and becomes the idle target FFF8B236 through the minimum-speed max() in 0x0F2274 (read). Implicit coolant axis -40..110 C in 10 C steps (lookup 0x7414). LF79100P: located from LF75404S 024B70 by the calibration block offset of its neighbours (inferred). LF79110N: same code as LF79100P; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LF79120P: same code as LF79110N; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Data at 02BD4C. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Idle Target Ramp Rate (Mode 1 to 2)
table.description: How fast the idle speed target moves (by coolant) when idle switches from mode 1 (engine stopped) to mode 2 (cold post-start). Larger = quicker change towards the new idle target; smaller = a gentler fade.

table.name: Idle Target Ramp Rate (Mode 1 to 3)
table.description: How fast the idle speed target moves (by coolant) when idle switches from mode 1 (engine stopped) to mode 3 (warm-start). Larger = quicker change towards the new idle target; smaller = a gentler fade.

table.name: Idle Target Ramp Rate (Mode 1 to 5)
table.description: How fast the idle speed target moves (by coolant) when idle switches from mode 1 (engine stopped) to mode 5 (warm idle). Larger = quicker change towards the new idle target; smaller = a gentler fade.

table.name: Idle Target Ramp Rate (AT/CVT, Mode 1 to 6)
table.description:
How fast the idle speed target moves (by coolant) when idle switches from mode 1 (engine stopped) to mode 6 (AT/CVT warm idle). Larger = quicker change. Automatic/CVT only: these modes never occur on a manual car, so this table has no effect there.
Details: 0x0F1DD0 (read; selection checked in the disassembly 0x0F1DD0..0x0F2148): the target ramp step B23E is chosen on a change of idle mode FFF8A7F0 (previous -> new) and kept while the mode stays the same; the target B23C (4 x B238) moves toward the new mode's Idle Speed Target by this step every pass (0x0F1D00). Coolant FFF88A44 axis. Mode 1 -> 1 uses step 0. This table: mode 1 -> 6. Modes 6/8 only occur with the AT/CVT coding: 0x0F2BCC passes A7F6 through when FFF88ADA bit7 is set and 0x0F354C itself only yields 1-5/7, so this step is never used by this MT calibration (read). p16 (read): 0x0F1D00 runs every 10 ms (module 0x0EE338), so rpm/s = shown rpm-per-pass x 100. LF79100P: located from LF75404S 05C6F4 by the code that reads it (read). LF79110N: same code as LF79100P; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LF79120P: same code as LF79110N; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 068B40. Confidence: read.

Idle Speed Target (Cold Idle, Mode 4)
table.description:
Idle speed target by coolant for a cold-idle mode used when stopped below a coolant threshold.
Details: When used: idle mode 4, entered from mode 5 when stopped with coolant below cal 0x24E94 for cal 0x24E96 passes. 0x0F1BCC selects this boot-format table by idle mode FFF8A7F0 = 4 and coolant; the result B238 is ramped (0x0F1D00) and becomes the idle target FFF8B236 through the minimum-speed max() in 0x0F2274 (read). Implicit coolant axis -40..110 C in 10 C steps (lookup 0x7414). LF79100P: located from LF75404S 024AF0 by the calibration block offset of its neighbours (inferred). LF79110N: same code as LF79100P; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LF79120P: same code as LF79110N; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Data at 02BCCC. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Idle Target Ramp Rate (Fallback Latch)
table.description:
Idle target ramp rate (by coolant) used when a warm-up fallback flag is set (manual-car version).
Details: 0x0F1DD0 (read; selection checked in the disassembly 0x0F1DD0..0x0F2148): the target ramp step B23E is chosen on a change of idle mode FFF8A7F0 (previous -> new) and kept while the mode stays the same; the target B23C (4 x B238) moves toward the new mode's Idle Speed Target by this step every pass (0x0F1D00). Used instead of the mode table when FFF899D7 bit0 rises while the idle mode is unchanged (index 98/99, 0x0F1DD0, read). FFF899D7 bit0 is the warm-up fallback latch. This one when FFF8A7E2 bit0 is set, which is always the case with the manual coding (0x0EC7A4/0x0F38B0, read). p16 (read): 0x0F1D00 runs every 10 ms (module 0x0EE338), so rpm/s = shown rpm-per-pass x 100. LF79100P: located from LF75404S 05C760 by the code that reads it (read). LF79110N: same code as LF79100P; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LF79120P: same code as LF79110N; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 068BAC. Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Target Ramp Rate (Fallback Latch, AT/CVT)
table.description:
Idle target ramp rate (by coolant) used when a warm-up fallback flag is set, on automatic/CVT cars.
Details: 0x0F1DD0 (read; selection checked in the disassembly 0x0F1DD0..0x0F2148): the target ramp step B23E is chosen on a change of idle mode FFF8A7F0 (previous -> new) and kept while the mode stays the same; the target B23C (4 x B238) moves toward the new mode's Idle Speed Target by this step every pass (0x0F1D00). Used instead of the mode table when FFF899D7 bit0 rises while the idle mode is unchanged (index 98/99, 0x0F1DD0, read). FFF899D7 bit0 is the warm-up fallback latch. This one when FFF8A7E2 bit0 is clear, which happens only with the AT/CVT coding (AT state FFF8A7DD 0 or 5; 0x0EC7A4/0x0F38B0, read). p16 (read): 0x0F1D00 runs every 10 ms (module 0x0EE338), so rpm/s = shown rpm-per-pass x 100. LF79100P: located from LF75404S 05C754 by the code that reads it (read). LF79110N: same code as LF79100P; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LF79120P: same code as LF79110N; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 068BA0. Confidence: read.

Idle Base Air (Warm Start, Mode 3, TGV Closed)
Idle Base Air (AT/CVT, Mode 6)
table.description:
Base (open-loop) idle air by coolant in warm idle on automatic/CVT cars only (never used on a manual car), used while the TGVs are commanded open. Change it together with the matching Idle Speed Target so idle feedback does not have to make up the difference. The TGV Closed table is used whenever the TGVs are commanded closed, which is the normal state at low torque, so change both together.
Details: When used: only with the automatic/CVT coding: mode 5 is mapped to 6 while FFF8A7E2 bit 0 is clear (AT state code FFF8A7DD = 0 or 5, 0x0EC7A4; physical meaning not settled). Never on a manual car (read, 0x0F2BCC). 0x0F0D24: base idle air B20C by idle mode FFF8A7F0 and coolant, this table while FFF8A881 bit 4 (TGVs closed) is clear (read). Scale as Idle Base Air (Mode 5). Raise it with this mode's idle speed target so the feedback need not cover the difference (inferred). Implicit coolant axis -40..110 C in 10 C steps (lookup 0x7414). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Idle Base Air (AT/CVT, Mode 6, TGV Closed)
table.description:
Base (open-loop) idle air by coolant in warm idle on automatic/CVT cars only (never used on a manual car), used while the TGVs are commanded closed (the normal state at low torque, probably including warm idle). Change it together with the matching Idle Speed Target and the normal Idle Base Air table for this mode.
Details: When used: only with the automatic/CVT coding: mode 5 is mapped to 6 while FFF8A7E2 bit 0 is clear (AT state code FFF8A7DD = 0 or 5, 0x0EC7A4; physical meaning not settled). Never on a manual car (read, 0x0F2BCC). 0x0F0D24: base idle air B20C by idle mode FFF8A7F0 and coolant, this table while FFF8A881 bit 4 (TGV close command) is set (read). Scale as Idle Base Air (Mode 5). Raise it with this mode's idle speed target so the feedback need not cover the difference (inferred). Implicit coolant axis -40..110 C in 10 C steps (lookup 0x7414). FFF8A881 bit 4 is the normal TGV-close command (0x10DEFC, set mainly by the timed close request FFF8A883 bit 5 from 0x10E180 when requested torque, coolant and air flow are below the TGV thresholds; the same bit selects every TGV-closed table), not a forced or fault state (read). At a settled warm idle the request conditions hold, so the TGVs are normally commanded closed and the TGV Closed table is probably the one in use (inferred). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Idle Base Air (Warm-Up Drive-Off, Mode 7, TGV Closed)
Idle Base Air (Warm-Up Drive-Off, AT/CVT, Mode 8)
table.description:
Base (open-loop) idle air by coolant after a cold-start drive-off on automatic/CVT cars only (never used on a manual car), used while the TGVs are commanded open. Change it together with the matching Idle Speed Target so idle feedback does not have to make up the difference. The TGV Closed table is used whenever the TGVs are commanded closed, which is the normal state at low torque, so change both together.
Details: When used: only with the automatic/CVT coding: mode 7 is mapped to 8 while FFF8A7E2 bit 0 is clear (read, 0x0F2BCC). Never on a manual car. 0x0F0D24: base idle air B20C by idle mode FFF8A7F0 and coolant, this table while FFF8A881 bit 4 (TGVs closed) is clear (read). Scale as Idle Base Air (Mode 5). Raise it with this mode's idle speed target so the feedback need not cover the difference (inferred). Implicit coolant axis -40..110 C in 10 C steps (lookup 0x7414). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Idle Base Air (Warm-Up Drive-Off, AT/CVT, Mode 8, TGV Closed)
table.description:
Base (open-loop) idle air by coolant after a cold-start drive-off on automatic/CVT cars only (never used on a manual car), used while the TGVs are commanded closed (the normal state at low torque, probably including warm idle). Change it together with the matching Idle Speed Target and the normal Idle Base Air table for this mode.
Details: When used: only with the automatic/CVT coding: mode 7 is mapped to 8 while FFF8A7E2 bit 0 is clear (read, 0x0F2BCC). Never on a manual car. 0x0F0D24: base idle air B20C by idle mode FFF8A7F0 and coolant, this table while FFF8A881 bit 4 (TGV close command) is set (read). Scale as Idle Base Air (Mode 5). Raise it with this mode's idle speed target so the feedback need not cover the difference (inferred). Implicit coolant axis -40..110 C in 10 C steps (lookup 0x7414). FFF8A881 bit 4 is the normal TGV-close command (0x10DEFC, set mainly by the timed close request FFF8A883 bit 5 from 0x10E180 when requested torque, coolant and air flow are below the TGV thresholds; the same bit selects every TGV-closed table), not a forced or fault state (read). At a settled warm idle the request conditions hold, so the TGVs are normally commanded closed and the TGV Closed table is probably the one in use (inferred). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Post-Start Idle Air Decay Delay (TGV Closed)
table.description: TGV-forced-closed version of Post-Start Idle Air Decay Delay: time after start before the post-start idle air starts to decay. Its coolant input is inferred from the sibling table.

table.name: Post-Start Staged Air Start Time
table.description: Time after rpm first reaches idle target when the staged air starts to rise, by start type and coolant. Part of a timed post-start air bump.

table.name: Post-Start Staged Air End Time
table.description: Time after rpm first reaches idle target when the staged air stops rising and starts to decay, by start type and coolant. Part of a timed post-start air bump.

table.name: Post-Start Staged Air Level
table.description: Peak level of the staged post-start air, by start type and coolant. Part of a timed post-start air bump.

table.name: Post-Start Staged Air Ramp Step
table.description: Rise of the staged post-start air every 40 ms between Start Time and End Time, by start type and coolant. Part of a timed post-start air bump.

table.name: Post-Start Staged Air Start Time (TGV Closed)
table.description: Time after rpm first reaches idle target when the staged air starts to rise, by start type and coolant. Part of a timed post-start air bump. TGVs-forced-closed copy; edit with the normal table.

Idle Base Air (Cold Idle, Mode 4)
table.description:
Base idle air by coolant for the cold-idle mode 4.
Details: When used: idle mode 4, entered from mode 5 when stopped with coolant below cal 0x24E94 for cal 0x24E96 passes. 0x0F0D24: base idle air B20C by idle mode FFF8A7F0 and coolant, this table while FFF8A881 bit 4 (TGVs closed) is clear (read). Scale as Idle Base Air (Mode 5). Raise it with this mode's idle speed target so the feedback need not cover the difference (inferred). Implicit coolant axis -40..110 C in 10 C steps (lookup 0x7414). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Idle Base Air (Cold Idle, Mode 4, TGV Closed)
table.description:
Base idle air by coolant for the cold-idle mode 4 with the TGVs commanded closed.
Details: When used: idle mode 4, entered from mode 5 when stopped with coolant below cal 0x24E94 for cal 0x24E96 passes. 0x0F0D24: base idle air B20C by idle mode FFF8A7F0 and coolant, this table while FFF8A881 bit 4 (TGV close command) is set (read). Scale as Idle Base Air (Mode 5). Raise it with this mode's idle speed target so the feedback need not cover the difference (inferred). Implicit coolant axis -40..110 C in 10 C steps (lookup 0x7414). FFF8A881 bit 4 is the normal TGV-close command (0x10DEFC, set mainly by the timed close request FFF8A883 bit 5 from 0x10E180 when requested torque, coolant and air flow are below the TGV thresholds; the same bit selects every TGV-closed table), not a forced or fault state (read). At a settled warm idle the request conditions hold, so the TGVs are normally commanded closed and the TGV Closed table is probably the one in use (inferred). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Post-Start Idle Air (Stop-Start Restart)
table.description:
Post-start idle air for an automatic stop-start restart, by start type and coolant. the stop-start feature appears unable to activate in this calibration.
Details: 0x0F1270 (read; args per call in module 0x0EE338): post-start idle air B20E = max(start air, staged air 05C49C family), added to the idle air at half weight (0x0F0AF8). TGVs not forced closed. Selected instead of the cranking value only inside the engine stop-start restart window (FFF89053 bit3/bit4 with the FFF88ADA bit3 edge, before the decay delay), by start type FFF8A6E8 (read). p16 (read): 0x0F1270 runs every 10 ms; its pass counter FFF84E42 counts 10 ms passes and the decay/ramp steps apply every 4th pass (40 ms). LF79100P: located from LF75404S 05C5E8 by the code that reads it (read). LF79110N: same code as LF79100P; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LF79120P: same code as LF79110N; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 068A0C. Confidence: read.

EGR Target Rate Tip-Out Limit (TGV Open)
table.description:
Cap on the target EGR rate for a short time after a pedal tip-out (inferred), by rpm and load, TGVs open.
Transient cap A819 (0x0FA1F8, rpm FFF8CD54 x load FFF8A616, read): while the flag is set, the ramped target A817 = min(this, base target) for EGR Tip-Out Limit Duration passes, then ramps back up by cal 0x2D6CE per pass (0x0FA068, read). The flag is set when FFF8AF00 (pedal, per my research notes) is at or below cal 0x2D2A8 and has fallen by at least cal 0x2D2AA against a sample from cal 0x2D2AC passes earlier (read), i.e. a pedal tip-out (inferred). TGVs closed = FFF8A881 bit 4 set (read: 0x10C948 drives the TGV open fraction FFF8B3E8 to 0 while the bit is set). EGR controller task 0x0F94A8 (read). That this is external EGR is inferred: its commanded output FFF8A81B is the OBD PID 0x2C (Commanded EGR) source and FFF88A1C (actual position) feeds PID 0x2D (EGR error) (0x1717C8, 0x1715F0, read). LF79100P: located from LF75404S 05CAB4 by the code that reads it (read). LF79110N: same code as LF79100P; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LF79120P: same code as LF79110N; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 068F0C. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: TGV Coolant Minimum (Warm-Up Fallback)
table.description:
Minimum coolant for TGV closing used only while a warm-up fallback flag is set.
TGV request logic 0x10D93C (read): the request byte FFF8A888 is 3 unless all of these hold: coolant FFF88A44 at or above TGV Coolant Minimum, requested torque FFF8AEE2 (0x0BA868, Nm = x/80 - 200) below the rpm-based TGV Torque Threshold (it must fall below the Enter table and then rise above the Exit table to clear), air quantity FFF8B4D6 below TGV Air Quantity Maximum (Enter 0x37A4A, Exit 0x37A48), and FFF8A88D = 0. When they hold, FFF8A888 = 1, or 2 if the intake air temperature FFF88A48 is below TGV IAT Threshold (vehicle speed) or FFF88E28 bit 0/2 is set; FFF8A888 = 2 also while combustion mode FFF8A85C is below cal 0x37B48. State 1 requests TGV close: it runs the timer FFF8B3E0 (0x10C3D0) and FFF8A881 bit 4 (TGVs closed) is set once the timer reaches TGV Close Delay. States 2 (close blocked: cold intake air, FFF88E28 bit 0/2, or combustion mode below cal 0x37B48) and 3 (close conditions not met) reset the timer, so the TGVs stay open (read). Which threshold pair is used depends on FFF8A8C1 (1, 2, 3 or other) and FFF8A8A2 bit 5 (not identified). Each threshold is table(rpm FFF8CE9C) + TGV Torque Threshold Offset(rpm, FFF88AE6) - 16000, so the offset table is centred on 16000 (0 ft-lb). Used while FFF899D7 bit 0 is set. LF79100P: located from LF75404S 037A46 by the code that reads it (read). LF79110N: same code as LF79100P; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LF79120P: same code as LF79110N; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Address 0404FE. Confidence: read.

table.description:
Upper limit, by barometric pressure, of a modelled brake-booster vacuum.
Brake override module 0x181B38 (10 ms task 0x1DFE3C, read): it limits the accelerator pedal that feeds the torque request, FFF88A5E = min(pedal FFF88EE6, limit FFF8BAFA) (0x09E800, read), when the brake is applied while the accelerator is held. Brake detection: VDC CAN frame 0x0D1 byte 2 (FFF88DF9, slew-limited 8/pass into FFF8AC94; brake pressure, inferred) against a threshold, or discrete input FFF88E2F bit 3 (pin PF10; brake switch, inferred) when the pressure signal is not valid (FFF8AC8F bit 4 clear). Vehicle speed FFF8AC95 = km/h from the wheel speeds or FFF88BE8 x 9/160 (0x182E34, read). The module sets no DTC (no DTC monitor record points at its RAM, read). 0x182B28 (read, all stack args checked in the assembly) has three sources for the booster vacuum Confidence: read.

table.description:
Road speed per 1000 rpm for each gear, used only by the gear advice function. The values do not match the 6MT and probably belong to another transmission.
Same data block as descriptor 05D468 (one entry). Road speed per 1000 rpm for gear index 1-8. 0x11031C (read; called at seg_0x110000.c:1175 with cal 0x57585 bit 3, gear FFF8A8BA, speed FFF88BE8, selector FFF8A8C3): only when cal 0x57585 bit 3 is set, FFF8558A = this(gear) (the Alternate table when FFF8A8C3 = 2) and FFF85588 = speed x 28800 / FFF8558A -> FFF8B434. 0x110398 does the same with the second gear index FFF8A8BC (0x1143CC) through the shared descriptors -> FFF8B436. 0x116A0C (gear advice, gated by the same bit) uses B436/B434 as rpm x 0.1953125 to convert the current power to torque at those engine speeds (read). The values (11.3 to 53.9 km/h per 1000 rpm over 6 steps here, 11.0 to 53.9 over 8 in the Alternate table) do not fit the 6MT, so this belongs to another transmission (inferred). table.name: Gear Advice Consumption Map
table.description:
Fuel consumption map by torque and rpm (probably g/kWh) for a gear-shift advice function that picks the most economical gear. One table edits all three copies.
Gear advice module 0x116A0C. With the bit set it takes the current power (torque x rpm / 9549.3), the engine speed in the gear below (FFF8B434, gear FFF8A8BA = gear - 1, 0x114360) and in the gear above (FFF8B436, gear FFF8A8BC = gear + 1, 0x1143CC), looks up the consumption map at the three points and advises the gear with the lowest value (FFF85678 / FFF85679, biases cal 0x36E4E/0x36E50 = 3 %). 'Alternate' tables are used when FFF8A8C3 = 2. Descriptors 05D4D8, 05D504 and 05D518 share this data block (037352): 05D4D8 at the current torque FFF8B468 = DAM-blended torque FFF8B48A - FFF8A8CC x 128 (0x1161DC) and rpm, 05D504 / 05D518 at the torque needed for the same power in the lower / upper gear (read). One entry edits all three. LF79100P: located from LF75404S 05D4D8 by the code that reads it (read). LF79110N: same code as LF79100P; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LF79120P: same code as LF79110N; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 0699EC. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Gear Advice Downshift Maximum RPM (Alternate)
table.description:
Alternate rpm limit, by gear, below which a downshift may be advised by the gear advice function.
Details: When used: instead of 05D5B8 when FFF8A8C3 = 2. Gear advice module 0x116A0C. With the bit set it takes the current power (torque x rpm / 9549.3), the engine speed in the gear below (FFF8B434, gear FFF8A8BA = gear - 1, 0x114360) and in the gear above (FFF8B436, gear FFF8A8BC = gear + 1, 0x1143CC), looks up the consumption map at the three points and advises the gear with the lowest value (FFF85678 / FFF85679, biases cal 0x36E4E/0x36E50 = 3 %). 'Alternate' tables are used when FFF8A8C3 = 2. 0x116A0C (read): FFF85648 = this(lower gear FFF8A8BA); the lower gear is advised (FFF85679 = 1) only if its engine speed FFF8B434 <= FFF85648. 05D5B8 (normal) is 31232 = 6100 rpm for every gear. LF79100P: located from LF75404S 05D5C4 by the code that reads it (read). LF79110N: same code as LF79100P; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LF79120P: same code as LF79110N; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 069AD8. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Gear Advice Upshift Minimum RPM
table.description:
Minimum rpm in the next gear up, by pedal and gear, for an upshift to be advised by the gear advice function.
Details: When used: 05D5E4 replaces it when FFF8A8C3 = 2. Gear advice module 0x116A0C. With the bit set it takes the current power (torque x rpm / 9549.3), the engine speed in the gear below (FFF8B434, gear FFF8A8BA = gear - 1, 0x114360) and in the gear above (FFF8B436, gear FFF8A8BC = gear + 1, 0x1143CC), looks up the consumption map at the three points and advises the gear with the lowest value (FFF85678 / FFF85679, biases cal 0x36E4E/0x36E50 = 3 %). 'Alternate' tables are used when FFF8A8C3 = 2. 0x116A0C (read, lookup by pedal FFF88A5E and upper gear FFF8A8BC): FFF85646 = this; the upper gear is advised only if its engine speed FFF8B436 >= FFF85646. LF79100P: located from LF75404S 05D5D0 by the code that reads it (read). LF79110N: same code as LF79100P; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LF79120P: same code as LF79110N; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 069AE4. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Gear Advice Upshift Minimum RPM (Alternate)
table.description:
Alternate minimum rpm in the next gear up, by pedal and gear, for an upshift to be advised by the gear advice function.
Details: When used: instead of 05D5D0 when FFF8A8C3 = 2. Gear advice module 0x116A0C. With the bit set it takes the current power (torque x rpm / 9549.3), the engine speed in the gear below (FFF8B434, gear FFF8A8BA = gear - 1, 0x114360) and in the gear above (FFF8B436, gear FFF8A8BC = gear + 1, 0x1143CC), looks up the consumption map at the three points and advises the gear with the lowest value (FFF85678 / FFF85679, biases cal 0x36E4E/0x36E50 = 3 %). 'Alternate' tables are used when FFF8A8C3 = 2. 0x116A0C (read): FFF85646 = this(pedal FFF88A5E, upper gear FFF8A8BC); the upper gear is advised only if its engine speed FFF8B436 >= FFF85646. LF79100P: located from LF75404S 05D5E4 by the code that reads it (read). LF79110N: same code as LF79100P; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LF79120P: same code as LF79110N; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 069AF8. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: A/F Sensor Scaling (Wide Range)
table.description: Converts the front wideband A/F sensor signal to lambda when the reading is outside about lambda 0.90-1.37. This is the measured lambda used by closed loop fueling.

table.name: A/F Sensor Scaling (Near Stoich)
table.description: Converts the front A/F sensor signal to lambda when it reads within about lambda 0.90-1.37, at a higher gain.

table.name: Battery Temperature Sensor Scaling
table.description: Converts the battery temperature sensor voltage to degrees for the charging-voltage control. It is probably the temperature half of the battery sensor, whose current signal the ECU also reads. Leave alone unless the battery sensor is changed.

table.name: Rear O2 Sensor Ready Heater Energy Threshold
table.description: How much heater energy, by coolant temperature at start, the rear O2 sensor must have received before it is treated as warmed up and ready. Raising it delays the rear O2 sensor (and its diagnostics) becoming active.

A/F Imbalance Monitor Crank Roughness Threshold 1
table.description: Crankshaft roughness level, by rpm and load, that confirms channel 1 of the P219A A/F imbalance monitor. It sets no code by itself; P219A needs both this and A/F Imbalance Monitor Swing Threshold 1 exceeded. Raising cells makes a fault harder (the maximum value = never).

table.name: A/F Imbalance Monitor Crank Roughness Threshold 2
table.description: Crankshaft roughness level that confirms channel 2 of the P219A monitor (paired with A/F Imbalance Monitor Swing Threshold 2). Lower than Threshold 1, so more sensitive. Sets no code by itself; raising cells makes a fault harder (the maximum value = never).

table.name: Target Rail Pressure (Combustion Mode 1, AT/CVT Coding)
table.description:
AT/CVT version of Target Rail Pressure (Combustion Mode 1). Only used with the automatic/CVT transmission coding; no effect on a manual car.
Details: When used: Only with the automatic/CVT transmission coding (Cal Switches: Transmission Coding: Automatic/CVT); unused on a manual car (read). LF9C100P: a table LF75404S does not have; scaling and axes as Target Rail Pressure (Combustion Mode 1). LF9C200N: same code as LF9C100P; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LF9C300P: same code as LF9C200N; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 00DCFC. Confidence: read.

table.name: Target Rail Pressure (Catalyst Heating)

table.name: Target Rail Pressure (Combustion Mode 1, Fallback)
table.description:
Rail pressure target in combustion mode 1 after a warm-up fallback has latched.
Details: When used: Used only while FFF899D7 bit 0 is set, a once-per-drive warm-up fallback latch (0x081EFC) gated by cal 0x59134 bit 0. 0x165180 (read): target in combustion mode FFF8A85C = 1 while FFF899D7 bit 0 is set (else Target Rail Pressure (Combustion Mode 1)); coolant FFF88A44. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05EB84 by its caller in the decompiled code (read). LF9C200N: same code as LF9C100P; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LF9C300P: same code as LF9C200N; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 00DCE4. Confidence: read.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling
table.description: Base open-loop (power enrichment) AFR target by rpm and load, used once the exhaust temperature estimate is high enough. The ECU uses the richer of this and the Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV..., AVCS...) group: to lean, edit both; to richen, either. Also see Open Loop Fueling Floor (Outside Closed Loop).

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV Closed, AVCS Inactive)
table.description: Open-loop AFR target for TGVs closed with AVCS not in active control, part of a blend by TGV position and AVCS state, used above Open Loop Delay Load Threshold after a delay. The ECU uses the richer of the two systems, so leaning needs both.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV Closed, AVCS Active)
table.description: Open-loop AFR target for TGVs closed with AVCS in active control, part of a blend by TGV position and AVCS state, used above Open Loop Delay Load Threshold after a delay. The ECU uses the richer of the two systems, so leaning needs both.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV Open, AVCS Inactive)
table.description: Open-loop AFR target for TGVs open with AVCS not in active control, part of a blend by TGV position and AVCS state, used above Open Loop Delay Load Threshold after a delay. The ECU uses the richer of the two systems, so leaning needs both.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV Open, AVCS Active)
table.description: Open-loop AFR target for TGVs open with AVCS in active control, part of a blend by TGV position and AVCS state, used above Open Loop Delay Load Threshold after a delay. The ECU uses the richer of the two systems, so leaning needs both.

table.name: Open Loop Fueling Floor (Outside Closed Loop)
Primary Open Loop Fueling Additive
table.description: Extra open-loop enrichment added to Primary Open Loop Fueling, scaled by its DAM multiplier: full at DAM 0, none at DAM 1. Probably the classic knock-dependent extra fuel. Edit with Primary Open Loop Fueling Additive (TGV/AVCS Group).

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling Additive DAM Multiplier
table.description: Scales Primary Open Loop Fueling Additive by the Dynamic Advance Multiplier (DAM), so the extra fuel is added as knock history lowers DAM. Edit with the (TGV/AVCS Group) copy.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling Additive (TGV/AVCS Group)
table.description: Knock-dependent extra enrichment for the TGV/AVCS open-loop group, scaled by its DAM multiplier (full at DAM 0, none at DAM 1).

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling Additive DAM Multiplier (TGV/AVCS Group)
table.description: Scales Primary Open Loop Fueling Additive (TGV/AVCS Group) by DAM (128 = x1.0).

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling Subtractive (TGV/AVCS Group)
table.description: Fuel removed from the TGV/AVCS open-loop group, scaled by its own DAM multiplier (negative cells add fuel). Leaning only works where Primary Open Loop Fueling is not richer.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling Subtractive DAM Multiplier (TGV/AVCS Group)
table.description: Scales Primary Open Loop Fueling Subtractive (TGV/AVCS Group) by DAM (128 = x1.0).

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling Subtractive
table.description: Fuel removed from Primary Open Loop Fueling, scaled by its DAM multiplier (negative cells add fuel). It only leans the target where the TGV/AVCS group is not richer.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling Subtractive DAM Multiplier
table.description: Scales Primary Open Loop Fueling Subtractive by DAM (128 = x1.0).

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling (Alternate)
table.description:
Replacement for Primary Open Loop Fueling plus its knock additive, used only when the calibration switch 'Open Loop Fueling. Edit with Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV/AVCS Group, Alternate) if you enable it.
Details: When used: only when cal 0x2F79A bit 4 is set (read; 2017 0x36B76, 2018 0x37FF2). The bit is the first argument of 0x0CE854 (call in 0x0C589C, read). With it set, 0x0CE854 uses this table + cal 0x18DDC in place of the base table plus the DAM-scaled additive, while DAM16 FFF811AE < cal 0x18DDD; otherwise Primary Open Loop Fueling + cal 0x18DDC (read). The TGV/AVCS group has its own alternate (Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV/AVCS Group, Alternate)); edit both if you enable the switch. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05AC80 by the code that reads it (read). LF9C200N: same code as LF9C100P; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LF9C300P: same code as LF9C200N; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 00973C. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV/AVCS Group, Alternate)
table.description:
Replacement for the TGV/AVCS open-loop group plus its knock additive, used only with the 'Use Alternate Map' calibration switch set.
Details: When used: only with cal 0x2F79A bit 4 set and DAM16 FFF811AE < cal 0x1391C (16). Replaces the TGV/AVCS blend plus knock additive in FFF8A681. 0x0CE5E8 (read; called from 0x0C589C with rpm FFF8CD54, load FFF8A616, cal 0x2F79A bit 4, DAM FFF811AE, AVCS weight FFF8A743 and TGV open fraction FFF8B3E8): TGV-closed base = 05ABB0 x (255 - a)/255 + 05ABD8 x a/255, TGV-open base = 05ABC4 x (255 - a)/255 + 05ABEC x a/255, where a = FFF8A743 is the AVCS-active weight from 0x0D952C (255 while both cam controllers are in active control, my research notes); blend FFF8A69B = closed x (1 - FFF8B3E8) + open x FFF8B3E8. With cal 0x2F79A bit 4 clear. With the bit set: Alternate (+ cal 0x13DCD) while DAM16 < cal 0x1391C (16), else blend + cal 0x13DCD. 0x0CEA80 (read) then takes FFF8A681 (only once FFF8AFD6 >= FFF8AFE6, the open-loop delay, and when >= cal 0x13DD0 = 5), scales it by cal 0x237CA/128 (x1.0), rate-limits its rise by 05ACD4(rpm) and sets FFF8A684 = max(that, FFF8A682), FFF8A682 being Primary Open Loop Fueling from 0x0CE854. FFF8A684 is the open-loop enrichment in commanded lambda 256/(256 + B030 + A684 + AFE8) (0x171C88). So the commanded open-loop mixture is the richer of the two systems: to lean the target, lower this group as well as Primary Open Loop Fueling; to richen, raise this group (Primary Open Loop Fueling alone only takes effect while its exhaust-temperature enable holds: 0x0CE854 sets FFF8A683 to 0 unless FFF8AFD0 >= cal 0x18DD4 or FFF8C03C >= cal 0x18DD8, read). LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05AC00 by the code that reads it (read). LF9C200N: same code as LF9C100P; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LF9C300P: same code as LF9C200N; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 0094DC. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Additional Enrichment A
table.description:
Extra enrichment added to the open-loop enrichment at higher coolant and lower rpm.
Details: When used: A applies when coolant >= cal 0x13E18 and rpm < cal 0x13E0E, B when coolant < 0x13E1A or rpm >= 0x13E0C (in between the last value is held); the whole term needs FFF8A654 bit 1, whose thresholds (cal 0x13E08, 0x13E14) are 65535, and both tables are zero. Source of FFF8AFE8 (0x0CAF70, with B), a term of the commanded lambda and of the fuel factor FFF8AFBC, where it is added to the open-loop enrichment (0x0C558C, read). LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05A804 by the code that reads it (read). LF9C200N: same code as LF9C100P; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LF9C300P: same code as LF9C200N; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 009080. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Additional Enrichment B
table.description:
Second table of the additional enrichment, used at low coolant or high rpm.
Details: When used: see Additional Enrichment A: B applies when coolant < cal 0x13E1A or rpm >= cal 0x13E0C (A when coolant >= cal 0x13E18 and rpm < cal 0x13E0E; in between the last value is held), and the whole term needs FFF8A654 bit 1. Second source table of FFF8AFE8. LF9C100P: located from LF75404S 05A818 by the code that reads it (read). LF9C200N: same code as LF9C100P; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LF9C300P: same code as LF9C200N; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 009094. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Knock Event Detector: Knocking Cylinders
table.description: Counts cylinders whose knock signal is above the knock threshold while knock correction is already deep; when the count runs up, the knock-event torque limit applies until the learned values are reset.

table.name: Knock Event Latch

table.name: Knock Event Feedback Correction Hysteresis

table.name: Knock Event Cylinder Count Limit (Fine Learning)

table.name: Knock Event Fine Learning Correction Hysteresis

table.name: Base Timing DAM Blend (DAM 1)

table.name: Base Timing DAM Blend B (DAM 0)

table.name: Base Timing DAM Blend B (DAM 1)
