table.name: Per-Injector Fuel Trim 1
table.description: Fuel multiplier for cylinder 1 only, by fuel quantity and rpm (128 = no change), applied before the pulse is split into injections. Use it to balance individual cylinders.

table.name: Per-Injector Fuel Trim 2
table.description: Fuel multiplier for cylinder 2 only, by fuel quantity and rpm (128 = no change), applied before the pulse is split into injections. Use it to balance individual cylinders.

table.name: Per-Injector Fuel Trim 3
table.description: Fuel multiplier for cylinder 3 only, by fuel quantity and rpm (128 = no change), applied before the pulse is split into injections. Use it to balance individual cylinders.

table.name: Per-Injector Fuel Trim 4
table.description: Fuel multiplier for cylinder 4 only, by fuel quantity and rpm (128 = no change), applied before the pulse is split into injections. Use it to balance individual cylinders.

table.name: Per-Injector Fuel Multiplier 1 (Single Injection)
table.description: Fuel multiplier for injector 1 when it fires once per cycle.

table.name: Per-Injector Fuel Multiplier 2 (Single Injection)
table.description: Fuel multiplier for injector 2 when it fires once per cycle.

table.name: Per-Injector Fuel Multiplier 3 (Single Injection)
table.description: Fuel multiplier for injector 3 when it fires once per cycle.

table.name: Per-Injector Fuel Multiplier 4 (Single Injection)
table.description: Fuel multiplier for injector 4 when it fires once per cycle.

table.name: Injector 2/4 Rail Pressure Offset
table.description: Pressure offset added to measured rail pressure before looking up Injector Flow Compensation (Injectors 2/4), by rpm and load; probably the pressure difference of the rail without the sensor.

table.name: Target Rail Pressure
table.description: Main fuel rail pressure target in normal warm running, by load and rpm. Higher pressure = better atomisation and more injector flow at the cost of pump load. Replaced by Target Rail Pressure (Pedal Released) with the pedal released.

table.name: Target Rail Pressure Additive
table.description: Extra rail pressure added to Target Rail Pressure, scaled by Target Rail Pressure Additive Multiplier, only with no rail-pressure sensor faults.

table.name: Target Rail Pressure (Catalyst Heating)
table.description: Fixed rail pressure target during stratified catalyst heating (combustion mode 2).

table.name: Per-Injector Fuel Multiplier 1 (Double Injection)
table.description: Fuel multiplier for injector 1 when it fires twice per cycle (128 = x1.0).

table.name: Per-Injector Fuel Multiplier 1 (Triple Injection)
table.description: Fuel multiplier for injector 1 when it fires three times per cycle (128 = x1.0).

table.name: Per-Injector Fuel Multiplier 2 (Double Injection)
table.description: Fuel multiplier for injector 2 when it fires twice per cycle (128 = x1.0).

table.name: Per-Injector Fuel Multiplier 2 (Triple Injection)
table.description: Fuel multiplier for injector 2 when it fires three times per cycle (128 = x1.0).

table.name: Per-Injector Fuel Multiplier 3 (Double Injection)
table.description: Fuel multiplier for injector 3 when it fires twice per cycle (128 = x1.0).

table.name: Per-Injector Fuel Multiplier 3 (Triple Injection)
table.description: Fuel multiplier for injector 3 when it fires three times per cycle (128 = x1.0).

table.name: Per-Injector Fuel Multiplier 4 (Double Injection)
table.description: Fuel multiplier for injector 4 when it fires twice per cycle (128 = x1.0).

table.name: Per-Injector Fuel Multiplier 4 (Triple Injection)
table.description: Fuel multiplier for injector 4 when it fires three times per cycle (128 = x1.0).

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling
table.description: Base open-loop (power enrichment) AFR target by rpm and load, used once the exhaust temperature estimate is high enough. The ECU uses the richer of this and the Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV..., AVCS...) group: to lean, edit both; to richen, either. Also see Open Loop Fueling Floor (Outside Closed Loop).

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV Closed, AVCS Inactive)
table.description: Open-loop AFR target for TGVs closed with AVCS not in active control, part of a blend by TGV position and AVCS state, used above Open Loop Delay Load Threshold after a delay. The ECU uses the richer of the two systems, so leaning needs both.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV Closed, AVCS Active)
table.description: Open-loop AFR target for TGVs closed with AVCS in active control, part of a blend by TGV position and AVCS state, used above Open Loop Delay Load Threshold after a delay. The ECU uses the richer of the two systems, so leaning needs both.

table.name: Knock Event Enrichment (Trigger A)
table.description: Extra fuel added while the knock torque cap's trigger a trigger is set, by engine speed and load; it fades out afterwards.

table.name: Knock Event Enrichment (Trigger B)
table.description: Extra fuel added while the knock torque cap's trigger b trigger is set, by engine speed and load; it fades out afterwards.

table.name: Knock Event Enrichment (Margin)
table.description: Extra fuel added while the knock torque cap's margin trigger is set, by engine speed and load.

table.name: Knock Event Enrichment Decay
table.description: How fast the Trigger A / B knock event enrichment fades once the trigger clears, per pass, by engine speed and load.

table.name: Knock Event Enrichment Ramp (Margin)
table.description: How fast the margin-trigger knock event enrichment moves toward its target and back, per pass, by engine speed and load.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV Open, AVCS Inactive)
table.description: Open-loop AFR target for TGVs open with AVCS not in active control, part of a blend by TGV position and AVCS state, used above Open Loop Delay Load Threshold after a delay. The ECU uses the richer of the two systems, so leaning needs both.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV Open, AVCS Active)
table.description: Open-loop AFR target for TGVs open with AVCS in active control, part of a blend by TGV position and AVCS state, used above Open Loop Delay Load Threshold after a delay. The ECU uses the richer of the two systems, so leaning needs both.

table.name: Open Loop Fueling Floor (Outside Closed Loop)
table.description: Minimum enrichment whenever the engine is out of closed loop for any reason: the mixture is at least this rich. Check it as well as Primary Open Loop Fueling when leaning the open-loop target.

table.name: Open Loop Delay Load Threshold
table.description: Load, by rpm, above which the Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV..., AVCS...) group takes effect after a delay; below it that group is off.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling Additive
table.description: Extra open-loop enrichment added to Primary Open Loop Fueling, scaled by its DAM multiplier: full at DAM 0, none at DAM 1. Probably the classic knock-dependent extra fuel. Edit with Primary Open Loop Fueling Additive (TGV/AVCS Group).

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling Additive DAM Multiplier
table.description: Scales Primary Open Loop Fueling Additive by the Dynamic Advance Multiplier (DAM), so the extra fuel is added as knock history lowers DAM. Edit with the (TGV/AVCS Group) copy.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling Additive (TGV/AVCS Group)
table.description: Knock-dependent extra enrichment for the TGV/AVCS open-loop group, scaled by its DAM multiplier (full at DAM 0, none at DAM 1).

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling Additive DAM Multiplier (TGV/AVCS Group)
table.description: Scales Primary Open Loop Fueling Additive (TGV/AVCS Group) by DAM (128 = x1.0).

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling Subtractive (TGV/AVCS Group)
table.description: Fuel removed from the TGV/AVCS open-loop group, scaled by its own DAM multiplier (negative cells add fuel). Leaning only works where Primary Open Loop Fueling is not richer.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling Subtractive DAM Multiplier (TGV/AVCS Group)
table.description: Scales Primary Open Loop Fueling Subtractive (TGV/AVCS Group) by DAM (128 = x1.0).

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling Subtractive
table.description: Fuel removed from Primary Open Loop Fueling, scaled by its DAM multiplier (negative cells add fuel). It only leans the target where the TGV/AVCS group is not richer.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling Subtractive DAM Multiplier
table.description: Scales Primary Open Loop Fueling Subtractive by DAM (128 = x1.0).

table.name: Low-DAM Enrichment
table.description: Extra fuel, by rpm and load, that richens the closed-loop target, the closed-loop override and the open-loop floor, scaled up as DAM falls (Low-DAM Enrichment DAM Multiplier). Probably a knock-history safety enrichment.

table.name: Warm-Up Enrichment (TGV Open)
table.description: Coolant-based warm-up enrichment with the TGVs open, blended with Warm-Up Enrichment (TGV Closed) by TGV position and scaled by Warm-Up Enrichment RPM Multiplier. Raising it adds fuel while cold. Warm-up role inferred from the coolant axis.

table.name: Warm-Up Enrichment (TGV Closed)
table.description: Coolant-based warm-up enrichment with the TGVs closed, blended with Warm-Up Enrichment (TGV Open) by TGV position. Raising it adds fuel while cold.

table.name: Fuel Factor Correction (RPM x Load)
table.description: General fuel correction by rpm and load in open and closed loop (128 = no change, each count about 0.4 %). Probably a light-load base-fuel correction.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling (Alternate)
table.description: Replacement for Primary Open Loop Fueling plus its knock additive, used only when the calibration switch 'Open Loop Fueling. Edit with Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV/AVCS Group, Alternate) if you enable it.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV/AVCS Group, Alternate)
table.description: Replacement for the TGV/AVCS open-loop group plus its knock additive, used only with the 'Use Alternate Map' calibration switch set.

table.name: Additional Enrichment A
table.description: Extra enrichment added to the open-loop enrichment at higher coolant and lower rpm.

table.name: Additional Enrichment B
table.description: Second table of the additional enrichment, used at low coolant or high rpm.

table.name: Additional Enrichment Throttle Threshold
table.description: Throttle opening above idle, by rpm, needed to enable Additional Enrichment A/B.

table.name: Closed Loop Target (TGVs Open, EGR Off)
table.description: Closed-loop lambda target with the TGVs open and little or no EGR. Picked by TGV state and estimated EGR flow, then limited by the Closed Loop Target Lean Limit tables. Targets richer than lambda 0.80 drop the ECU into open loop (Closed Loop Minimum Target).

table.name: Closed Loop Target (TGVs Closed, EGR Active)
table.description: Closed-loop lambda target with the TGVs closed and EGR flowing. Picked by TGV state and estimated EGR flow, then limited by the Closed Loop Target Lean Limit tables. Targets richer than lambda 0.80 drop the ECU into open loop (Closed Loop Minimum Target).

table.name: Closed Loop Target (TGVs Closed, EGR Off)
table.description: Closed-loop lambda target with the TGVs closed and EGR closed or nearly closed. Picked by TGV state and estimated EGR flow, then limited by the Closed Loop Target Lean Limit tables. Targets richer than lambda 0.80 drop the ECU into open loop (Closed Loop Minimum Target).

table.name: Closed Loop Target (TGVs Open, EGR Active)
table.description: Closed-loop lambda target with the TGVs open and EGR flowing. Picked by TGV state and estimated EGR flow, then limited by the Closed Loop Target Lean Limit tables. Targets richer than lambda 0.80 drop the ECU into open loop (Closed Loop Minimum Target).

table.name: Closed Loop Target Lean Limit (TGVs Closed, Other Modes)
table.description: Caps the closed-loop target at no leaner than this, by coolant and load; values below neutral force a richer target when cold. Used with TGVs closed outside normal combustion mode.

table.name: Closed Loop Target Lean Limit (TGVs Closed, Normal Mode)
table.description: Caps the closed-loop target at no leaner than this, by coolant and load; values below neutral force a richer target when cold. Used with TGVs closed in normal combustion mode.

table.name: Closed Loop Target Lean Limit (TGVs Open, Other Modes)
table.description: Caps the closed-loop target at no leaner than this, by coolant and load; values below neutral force a richer target when cold. Used with TGVs open outside normal combustion mode.

table.name: Closed Loop Target Lean Limit (TGVs Open, Normal Mode)
table.description: Caps the closed-loop target at no leaner than this, by coolant and load; values below neutral force a richer target when cold. Used with TGVs open in normal combustion mode.

table.name: Closed Loop Target Override
table.description: Alternate closed-loop target (plus Low-DAM Enrichment) that replaces the final target under a fuel-routine condition that has not been identified.

table.name: Closed Loop Integral Gain (Negative Error)
table.description: How fast closed-loop fuel trim corrects when the error is negative, by rpm and load. Larger = faster correction, too large can make the trims oscillate.

table.name: Closed Loop Integral Gain (Positive Error)
table.description: How fast closed-loop fuel trim corrects when the error is positive, by rpm and load. Larger = faster correction, too large can make the trims oscillate.

table.name: Closed Loop Learning Averaging Passes
table.description: Number of passes the closed-loop correction is averaged over before each long-term trim learning update, by rpm and load; probably the learning window.

table.name: LTFT Load Range Boundary 1
table.description: Load boundary 1 of the 10 long-term fuel trim cells (5 load ranges x 2 rpm ranges); load range 1 is below this value.

table.name: LTFT Load Range Boundary 2
table.description: Load boundary 2 of the 10 long-term fuel trim cells (5 load ranges x 2 rpm ranges); load range 2 is below this value.

table.name: LTFT Load Range Boundary 3
table.description: Load boundary 3 of the 10 long-term fuel trim cells (5 load ranges x 2 rpm ranges); load range 3 is below this value.

table.name: LTFT Load Range Boundary 4
table.description: Load boundary 4 of the 10 long-term fuel trim cells (5 load ranges x 2 rpm ranges); load range 4 is below this value.

table.name: Transient Fuel Throttle-Rate Gain (AT/CVT)
table.description: AT/CVT version of Transient Fuel Throttle-Rate Gain; only used with an automatic/CVT coding, no effect on a manual car.

table.name: Transient Fuel Film Target
table.description: Fuel film mass target (mg) by load and rpm; when it rises, the difference is added to the following injections and then decays, compensating fuel film build-up (inferred). The values are fuel mass, but the load axis is fuel-based and scales with Injector Scaling: after changing Injector Scaling, multiply the load axis by new raw / 2918 to keep the same real loads.

table.name: TGV Transition Enrichment (Closing)
table.description: Short fuel adder after the TGVs start to move, below 3600 rpm and only when cold (TGV Transition Enrichment Coolant Multiplier). Initial amount after a closing event, by rpm and load.

table.name: TGV Transition Enrichment (Closing, Alternate)
table.description: Alternate version of TGV Transition Enrichment (Closing), used under an unidentified condition.

table.name: Transient Fuel Throttle-Rate Gain (MT Coding)
table.description: Alternate version of Transient Fuel Throttle-Rate Gain used only when a transmission-coding switch is changed.

table.name: Tip-In Extra Pulse Angle
table.description: Part of an extra fuel pulse on fast tip-in. Probably the injection angle of that extra pulse, by rpm.

table.name: Tip-In Extra Pulse RPM Multiplier
table.description: Part of an extra fuel pulse on fast tip-in. Scales the extra pulse by rpm (128 = x1.0).

table.name: Tip-In Extra Pulse Coolant Multiplier
table.description: Part of an extra fuel pulse on fast tip-in. Scales the extra pulse by coolant (64 = x1.0), out of neutral.

table.name: Tip-In Extra Pulse Coolant Multiplier (Neutral)
table.description: Part of an extra fuel pulse on fast tip-in. Scales the extra pulse by coolant (64 = x1.0) while in neutral.

table.name: Start Enrichment (Load, TGV Open)
table.description: Start-path enrichment by load and coolant with the TGVs open, blended with the TGV Closed table by TGV position. Raising it adds fuel during start-up.

table.name: Start Enrichment (Load, TGV Closed)
table.description: Start-path enrichment by load and coolant with the TGVs closed, blended with the TGV Open table by TGV position and scaled by Start Enrichment (Load) RPM Multiplier.

table.name: Start Enrichment Additive (Load, TGV Closed)
table.description: Extra start enrichment by load and coolant, added on top of Start Enrichment (Load) only while a start condition flag is set (depends on start coolant, pedal and speed; not fully decoded). TGVs closed side of a TGV blend.

table.name: Start Enrichment Additive (Load, TGV Open)
table.description: Extra start enrichment by load and coolant, added on top of Start Enrichment (Load) only while a start condition flag is set (depends on start coolant, pedal and speed; not fully decoded). TGVs open side of a TGV blend.

table.name: After-Start Enrichment Coolant Multiplier (Repeat Start)
table.description: Computed after a repeat crank but never used by the fuel calculation, so editing it does nothing.

table.name: Cranking Fuel (Stall Window, First Attempt)
table.description: Cranking fuel pulse by coolant for a restart after a stop inside a calibrated coolant window, first attempt.

table.name: Cranking Fuel (Stall Window, Repeat Attempt, Special Start)
table.description: Cranking fuel pulse by coolant for a stall-window restart, repeat attempt, special start type.

table.name: Cranking Fuel (Stall Window, Repeat Attempt)
table.description: Cranking fuel pulse by coolant for a stall-window restart, repeat attempt.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Coolant Multiplier (Unused Routine, Restart after Key-Off)
table.description: Belongs to a third cranking-fuel routine whose results nothing reads, so editing it has no effect. Its coolant axis is shared with the live coolant multipliers; edit that axis only there.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Coolant Multiplier (Unused Routine, Restart after Stall)
table.description: Belongs to a third cranking-fuel routine whose results nothing reads, so editing it has no effect. Its coolant axis is shared with the live coolant multipliers; edit that axis only there.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Coolant Multiplier (Unused Routine, Special Start)
table.description: Belongs to a third cranking-fuel routine whose results nothing reads, so editing it has no effect. Its coolant axis is shared with the live coolant multipliers; edit that axis only there.

table.name: Cranking Fuel RPM Multiplier (Unused Routine)
table.description: Belongs to a third cranking-fuel routine whose results nothing reads, so editing it has no effect. Its coolant axis is shared with the live RPM multipliers.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Decay (Stall Window, First Attempt)
table.description: Post-start fade of cranking fuel for a stall-window restart, first attempt.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Decay (Stall Window, Repeat Attempt)
table.description: Post-start fade of cranking fuel for a stall-window restart, repeat attempt.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Decay by Start Type (First Start)
table.description: Post-start fade of cranking fuel by start coolant, chosen by start type. Start type: first start.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Decay by Start Type (Restart after Key-Off)
table.description: Post-start fade of cranking fuel by start coolant, chosen by start type. Start type: restart after key-off.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Decay by Start Type (Restart after Stall)
table.description: Post-start fade of cranking fuel by start coolant, chosen by start type. Start type: restart after stall.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Decay by Start Type (Special Start)
table.description: Post-start fade of cranking fuel by start coolant, chosen by start type. Start type: special start.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Decay by Start Type (Special Start, Initial)
table.description: Post-start fade of cranking fuel by start coolant, chosen by start type. Start type: special start, initial.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Decay by Start Type (Stall Window, First Start)
table.description: Post-start fade of cranking fuel by start coolant, chosen by start type. Stall-window restart, start type: first start.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Decay by Start Type (Stall Window, Restart after Key-Off)
table.description: Post-start fade of cranking fuel by start coolant, chosen by start type. Stall-window restart, start type: restart after key-off.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Decay by Start Type (Stall Window, Restart after Stall)
table.description: Post-start fade of cranking fuel by start coolant, chosen by start type. Stall-window restart, start type: restart after stall.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Decay by Start Type (Stall Window, Special Start)
table.description: Post-start fade of cranking fuel by start coolant, chosen by start type. Stall-window restart, start type: special start.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Decay by Start Type (Stall Window, Special Start, Initial)
table.description: Post-start fade of cranking fuel by start coolant, chosen by start type. Stall-window restart, start type: special start, initial.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Decay (Unused Routine)
table.description: Belongs to a third cranking-fuel routine whose results nothing reads, so editing it has no effect. Its axis is shared with the start-type decay tables.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Decay (Unused Routine, Repeat Crank)
table.description: Belongs to a third cranking-fuel routine whose results nothing reads, so editing it has no effect. Its axis is shared with the start-type decay tables.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Base (Unused Routine)
table.description: Belongs to a third cranking-fuel routine whose results nothing reads, so editing it has no effect. Its coolant axis is shared with the live cranking tables.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Secondary (Repeat Attempt, Special Start)
table.description: Secondary cranking fuel pulse for a repeat attempt in the special start type.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Secondary (Stall Window, First Attempt)
table.description: Secondary cranking fuel pulse for a stall-window restart, first attempt.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Secondary (Stall Window, Repeat Attempt, Special Start)
table.description: Secondary cranking fuel pulse for a stall-window restart, repeat attempt, special start type.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Secondary (Stall Window, Repeat Attempt)
table.description: Secondary cranking fuel pulse for a stall-window restart, repeat attempt.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Secondary Coolant Multiplier (Special Start)
table.description: Secondary-path cranking fuel multiplier by coolant for the special start type, which is disabled by calibration.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Secondary Decay (Stall Window, First Attempt)
table.description: Post-start fade of the secondary cranking fuel for a stall-window restart, first attempt.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Secondary Decay (Stall Window, Repeat Attempt)
table.description: Post-start fade of the secondary cranking fuel for a stall-window restart, repeat attempt.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Secondary Decay by Start Type (First Start)
table.description: Secondary-path copy of Cranking Fuel Decay by Start Type (First Start).

table.name: Cranking Fuel Secondary Decay by Start Type (Restart after Key-Off)
table.description: Secondary-path copy of Cranking Fuel Decay by Start Type (Restart after Key-Off).

table.name: Cranking Fuel Secondary Decay by Start Type (Restart after Stall)
table.description: Secondary-path copy of Cranking Fuel Decay by Start Type (Restart after Stall).

table.name: Cranking Fuel Secondary Decay by Start Type (Special Start)
table.description: Secondary-path copy of Cranking Fuel Decay by Start Type (Special Start).

table.name: Cranking Fuel Secondary Decay by Start Type (Special Start, Initial)
table.description: Secondary-path copy of Cranking Fuel Decay by Start Type (Special Start, Initial).

table.name: Cranking Fuel Secondary Decay by Start Type (Stall Window, First Start)
table.description: Secondary-path copy of Cranking Fuel Decay by Start Type (Stall Window, First Start).

table.name: Cranking Fuel Secondary Decay by Start Type (Stall Window, Restart after Key-Off)
table.description: Secondary-path copy of Cranking Fuel Decay by Start Type (Stall Window, Restart after Key-Off).

table.name: Cranking Fuel Secondary Decay by Start Type (Stall Window, Restart after Stall)
table.description: Secondary-path copy of Cranking Fuel Decay by Start Type (Stall Window, Restart after Stall).

table.name: Cranking Fuel Secondary Decay by Start Type (Stall Window, Special Start)
table.description: Secondary-path copy of Cranking Fuel Decay by Start Type (Stall Window, Special Start).

table.name: Cranking Fuel Secondary Decay by Start Type (Stall Window, Special Start, Initial)
table.description: Secondary-path copy of Cranking Fuel Decay by Start Type (Stall Window, Special Start, Initial).

table.name: Cranking Prime Pulse Coolant Multiplier
table.description:
Size of what appears to be a one-shot priming injection at key-on/cranking, by coolant; the pulse is proportional to it.
Details: When used: only if cal 0x28D98 = 1 or 2. 0x0CD4AC (read): FFF8A67D = this(coolant FFF8CD65 = degC + 50) during key-on and cranking (fuel state 1/2), held afterwards. 0x0CD500 / 0x0CD5DC compute the pulses FFF8C040 / FFF8C044 = 05A8F4 / 05A908(rail pressure FFF89266, FFF8A652) x flow compensation FFF8AFEA x barometric factor FFF8A687 x FFF8A67D x 2^-18 x 1.25 + latency, and 0x1D296C fires each of them once per injector (flags FFF8C6F4-C6F7) when cal 0x28D98 = 1 or 2 (read): a one-shot priming injection at start (inferred). The pulse is proportional to this value. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Running After-Start Enrichment 1 (Special Start)
table.description:
Running After-Start Enrichment 1 for the special start type, which is disabled by calibration.
Details: When used: start type FFF8A6E7 = 3 or above, in fuel states 2 (cranking) and 3 (running). Amount E1 (1/256 of fuel) for this start type, on coolant FFF88A44. 0x0CDD8C (read) builds Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Running After-Start Enrichment 2 (Special Start)
table.description:
Running After-Start Enrichment 2 for the special start type, which is disabled by calibration.
Details: When used: start type FFF8A6E7 = 3 or above, in fuel states 2 (cranking) and 3 (running). Amount E2 (1/256 of fuel) for this start type, on coolant FFF88A44. 0x0CDD8C (read) builds Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Running After-Start Enrichment 3 (Special Start)
table.description:
Running After-Start Enrichment 3 for the special start type, which is disabled by calibration.
Details: When used: start type FFF8A6E7 = 3 or above, in fuel states 2 (cranking) and 3 (running). Amount E3 (1/256 of fuel) for this start type, on coolant FFF88A44. 0x0CDD8C (read) builds Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Running After-Start Enrichment Decay 1 (Special Start)
table.description:
Fade time of Running After-Start Enrichment 1 (Special Start). That start type is disabled by calibration.
Details: When used: start type FFF8A6E7 = 3 or above, in fuel states 2 (cranking) and 3 (running). Decay time D1, applied to E1 (8 x value passes of FFF8B06A to fade out) for this start type, on coolant FFF88A44. 0x0CDD8C (read) builds Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Running After-Start Enrichment Decay 2 (Special Start)
table.description:
Fade time of Running After-Start Enrichment 2 (Special Start). That start type is disabled by calibration.
Details: When used: start type FFF8A6E7 = 3 or above, in fuel states 2 (cranking) and 3 (running). Decay time D2, applied to E2 (8 x value passes of FFF8B06A to fade out) for this start type, on coolant FFF88A44. 0x0CDD8C (read) builds Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Running After-Start Enrichment Decay 3 (Special Start)
table.description:
Fade time of Running After-Start Enrichment 3 (Special Start). That start type is disabled by calibration.
Details: When used: start type FFF8A6E7 = 3 or above, in fuel states 2 (cranking) and 3 (running). Decay time D3, applied to E3 (8 x value passes of FFF8B06A to fade out) for this start type, on coolant FFF88A44. 0x0CDD8C (read) builds Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Injection Timing (Single Injection)
table.description: Main injection angle in normal running (degrees BTDC of compression TDC, larger = earlier), by rpm and load, with one injection per cycle. Replaced by Injection Timing (High Pedal) at high pedal.

table.name: Injection Timing (High Pedal)
table.description: Injection angle used instead of Injection Timing (Single Injection) and its additive while the pedal is at 90 % or more (released below 85 %).

table.name: Injection Timing Additive
table.description: Retard (degrees later) applied to Injection Timing (Single Injection), scaled by Injection Timing Additive Multiplier.

table.name: Double Injection Split
table.description:
Share of the fuel in the first of two injections; the second gets the rest.
Details: Share of the fuel in the first of two injections (0x0D05D8 -> FFF8B068 -> FFF8A6D1, read); the second gets the rest (0x0D0D50). Limited by FFF8A6DA (read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Triple Injection Split 1
table.description:
Share of the fuel in the first of three injections (the third gets what the first two leave).
Details: Share of the fuel in the first of three injections (0x0D06EC -> FFF8A6C9 -> FFF8A6D3, read); the third gets 128 minus the first two (0x0D0DC0). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Triple Injection Split 2
table.description:
Share of the fuel in the second of three injections.
Details: Share of the fuel in the second of three injections (0x0D06EC -> FFF8A6CA -> FFF8A6D4, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Injection Angle 2
table.description: Angle of the second (late, after top dead centre) pulse during stratified catalyst heating, by spark target; negative = after TDC.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Injection Angle (TGV Normal, AT/CVT Coding)
table.description: AT/CVT version of Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Injection Angle (TGV Normal). Only used with the automatic/CVT transmission coding; no effect on a manual car.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Injection Angle (TGV Closed)
table.description: Second-pulse injection angle in catalyst-heating phase 2, by rpm and spark target; compression stroke, limited to 10.5-180 BTDC. Used when the TGVs are closed.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Injection Angle (TGV Closed, AT/CVT Coding)
table.description: AT/CVT version of Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Injection Angle (TGV Closed). Only used with the automatic/CVT transmission coding; no effect on a manual car.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Injection Angle Adder (TGV Normal)
table.description: Correction to Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Injection Angle (TGV Normal), the second pulse; positive = later. Edit with that table.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Injection Angle Adder (TGV Closed)
table.description: Correction to the phase 2 second-pulse angle with the TGVs closed; positive = later.

table.name: Start Split Injection Second Share
table.description: Share of fuel moved into the second (compression-stroke) pulse during the start / catalyst-heating phase 2, by rpm and coolant (0 = single injection). Used with the pedal pressed or the car moving.

table.name: Start Split Injection Second Share (Idle, Alternate)
table.description: Share of fuel moved into the second (compression-stroke) pulse during the start / catalyst-heating phase 2, by rpm and coolant (0 = single injection).

table.name: Decel Fuel Cut Resume RPM Adder (A/C, Alternate)
table.description: Alternate A/C resume-rpm adder for the decel fuel cut, by an unidentified CAN-derived value.

table.name: Decel Fuel Cut Staging Time (Alternate Set, A/C Off)
table.description: Alternate decel fuel cut staging (A/C off).

table.name: Decel Fuel Cut Staging Time (Alternate Set, A/C On)
table.description: Alternate decel fuel cut staging (A/C on).

table.name: Decel Fuel Cut Full-Cut Shortcut Hold
table.description: Time, by rpm, after which all cylinders would be cut at once under unidentified conditions.

table.name: Purge Rate Limit (Fallback)
table.description: Purge capacity by rpm and load used instead of the vacuum-based capacity when one of several unidentified fault/status flags is set.

table.name: Base Timing (EGR Off, TGV Open)
table.description: Base (upper-limit) ignition timing map for pedal pressed, EGR off and TGVs open, which covers wide-open throttle and high rpm. The ECU fires the lower of this map and Primary Ignition plus knock correction advance and fine learning.

table.name: Base Timing (EGR Off, TGV Closed)
table.description: Base (upper-limit) ignition timing map used while the pedal is pressed, EGR is off (or only a few percent) and the TGVs are closed (typically cold or light-load running). The ECU fires the lower of this map and Primary Ignition plus knock correction advance and fine learning, so raising cells adds timing only where this map is the lower one.

table.name: Base Timing (EGR Active, TGV Open)
table.description: Base (upper-limit) ignition timing map used while the pedal is pressed, EGR is active and the TGVs are open (part-throttle cruising). The ECU fires the lower of this map and Primary Ignition plus EGR advance, knock correction advance and fine learning, so raising cells adds timing only where this map is the lower one. One of four base maps selected by EGR and TGV state.

table.name: Base Timing (EGR Active, TGV Closed)
table.description: Base (upper-limit) ignition timing map used while the pedal is pressed, EGR is active and the TGVs are closed. The ECU fires the lower of this map and Primary Ignition plus knock correction advance and fine learning (then feedback knock correction and retards apply), so raising cells adds timing only where this map is the lower one. One of four base maps selected by EGR and TGV state; that the switching module is EGR is inferred.

table.name: Ignition Dwell Time
table.description: Coil charge (dwell) time in milliseconds by rpm and battery voltage, used whenever the engine runs. More dwell gives a stronger spark but heats the coils.

table.name: Base Timing IAT Compensation Multiplier
table.description: Scales Base Timing IAT Compensation by rpm and load: 0 = no intake-temperature timing correction, 1.0 = the full amount.

table.name: Base Timing Coolant Compensation Weight (TGV Open)
table.description: Percentage (by rpm and load) of Base Timing Coolant Compensation (TGV Open) actually applied. Lower values reduce the cold-engine timing correction in that area.

table.name: Base Timing Coolant Compensation Weight (TGV Closed)
table.description: Share of the TGV-closed coolant timing compensation that applies, by engine speed and load.

table.name: Timing Request Enrichment Retard
table.description: Retard ramped into the timing request while open-loop power enrichment is active, by load and rpm. The ECU fires the lower of Base Timing and request + knock advance.

table.name: Base Timing Coolant Compensation (Alternate, Below 5000 RPM)
table.description: Alternate cold-engine timing correction by coolant temperature, used below 5000 rpm only when a calibration switch selects the alternate tables.

table.name: Base Timing Coolant Compensation (Alternate, Above 5000 RPM)
table.description: Alternate cold-engine timing correction by coolant temperature, used above 5000 rpm only when a calibration switch selects the alternate tables.

table.name: Filtered RPM Rate Timing Term
table.description: Timing added or removed according to how fast engine speed is changing, which looks like an rpm-oscillation (surge) damper.

table.name: Knock Correction Advance Max A (TGV Open)
table.description: First part of the knock correction advance (timing added as DAM rises), by rpm and load, for TGVs open; blended with the TGV Closed table and scaled by KCA DAM Curve A. It is added to the Primary Ignition request, not to the Base Timing map: the ECU fires the lower of Base Timing and Primary + knock advance + fine learning, so raising it adds timing only where that sum is still below Base Timing.

table.name: Knock Correction Advance Max A (TGV Closed)
table.description: First part of the knock correction advance (timing added as DAM rises), by rpm and load, for TGVs closed; blended with the TGV Open table and scaled by KCA DAM Curve A. It is added to the Primary Ignition request, not to the Base Timing map: the ECU fires the lower of Base Timing and Primary + knock advance + fine learning, so raising it adds timing only where that sum is still below Base Timing.

table.name: Knock Correction Advance Max B (TGV Open)
table.description: Second part of the knock correction advance, by rpm and load, for TGVs open. The total available advance is Max A plus Max B; it raises the Primary Ignition side of the timing limit and can never push fired timing above the Base Timing map.

table.name: Knock Correction Advance Max B (TGV Closed)
table.description: Second part of the knock correction advance, by rpm and load, for TGVs closed. Like part A it raises the Primary Ignition side of the timing limit and can never push fired timing above the Base Timing map.

table.name: FLKC Range Boundary Load 1
table.description: One of the four load boundaries that split fine learning knock correction (FLKC) into load ranges; each learning cell covers one rpm range by one load range. Moving it changes which conditions share a learned correction. Keep them in increasing order.

table.name: FLKC Range Boundary Load 2
table.description: One of the four load boundaries that split fine learning knock correction (FLKC) into load ranges; each learning cell covers one rpm range by one load range. Moving it changes which conditions share a learned correction. Keep them in increasing order.

table.name: FLKC Range Boundary Load 3
table.description: One of the four load boundaries that split fine learning knock correction (FLKC) into load ranges; each learning cell covers one rpm range by one load range. Moving it changes which conditions share a learned correction. Keep them in increasing order.

table.name: FLKC Range Boundary Load 4
table.description: One of the four load boundaries that split fine learning knock correction (FLKC) into load ranges; each learning cell covers one rpm range by one load range. Moving it changes which conditions share a learned correction. Keep them in increasing order.

table.name: Knock Event Detector: Knocking Cylinders
table.description: Counts cylinders whose knock signal is above the knock threshold while knock correction is already deep; when the count runs up, the knock-event torque limit applies until the learned values are reset.

table.name: Knock Event Cylinder Count Limit (Feedback)
table.description: Knocking cylinders, summed while feedback knock correction is at or below its threshold, that trip the detector.

table.name: Knock Event Feedback Correction Threshold
table.description: Knocking cylinders are summed while feedback knock correction is at or below this.

table.name: Knock Event Feedback Correction Hysteresis
table.description: Once summing, feedback knock correction must recover this far above the threshold to stop.

table.name: Knock Event Cylinder Count Limit (Fine Learning)
table.description: Knocking cylinders, summed while fine learning knock correction is at or below its threshold, that trip the detector.

table.name: Knock Event Fine Learning Correction Threshold
table.description: Knocking cylinders are summed while fine learning knock correction is at or below this.

table.name: Knock Event Fine Learning Correction Hysteresis
table.description: Once summing, fine learning knock correction must recover this far above the threshold to stop.

table.name: FLKC Range Load Hysteresis
table.description: Load hysteresis used when switching between fine learning knock correction load ranges, to stop flicking between cells at a boundary.

table.name: Base Timing DAM Blend (DAM 0)
table.description: Timing offset added to base timing only at high pedal, blended by DAM with Base Timing DAM Blend (DAM 1); this table applies at DAM 0. 32 = no change, 0.5-degree steps. Not the knock correction advance (renamed from Knock Correction Advance DAM 0/1).

table.name: Base Timing DAM Blend (DAM 1)
table.description: Timing offset added to base timing only at high pedal, blended by DAM with Base Timing DAM Blend (DAM 0); this table applies at DAM 1. 32 = no change, 0.5-degree steps. Not the knock correction advance (renamed from Knock Correction Advance DAM 0/1).

table.name: Base Timing DAM Blend B (DAM 0)
table.description: Timing offset added to base timing in a high-pedal, enrichment-limited condition in one combustion mode, blended with Base Timing DAM Blend B (DAM 1) by DAM; this table applies at DAM 0. 32 = no change, 0.5-degree steps.

table.name: Base Timing DAM Blend B (DAM 1)
table.description: Timing offset added to base timing in a high-pedal, enrichment-limited condition in one combustion mode, blended with Base Timing DAM Blend B (DAM 0) by DAM; this table applies at DAM 1. 32 = no change, 0.5-degree steps.

table.name: FBKC Retard Step (Secondary Knock, State 0x0D)
table.description: Timing pulled per event by feedback knock correction when the secondary knock detector fires.

table.name: FBKC Retard Step (Secondary Knock, State 6)
table.description: Timing pulled per event by feedback knock correction when the secondary knock detector fires (variant with an extra internal condition set).

table.name: FLKC Counted-Cell Learned Value Threshold
table.description: By DAM: a fine-knock-learning cell is counted when its learned value is at or above this, and the count sets an internal flag.

table.name: Base Timing DAM Blend Alternate (DAM 0)
table.description: Alternate DAM-blended timing offset (DAM 0 side) for base timing. 32 = no change.

table.name: Base Timing DAM Blend Alternate (DAM 1)
table.description: Alternate DAM-blended timing offset (DAM 1 side) for base timing. 32 = no change.

table.name: Knock Threshold (Event 1, Full Window)
table.description: Knock intensity (sum of the three strongest knock-channel ratios to their background, 3.0 = all at background) (by rpm and load) above which a knock event in slot 1 counts as knock and triggers feedback knock retard; used while the extended (full) knock window is in use. Higher = less sensitive. Warning: the Full / Short Window sets were renamed on 2026-10-30 (earlier names had them swapped). Which cylinder slot 1 is has not been mapped.

table.name: Knock Threshold (Event 1, Short Window)
table.description: Knock intensity (sum of the three strongest knock-channel ratios to their background, 3.0 = all at background) (by rpm and load) above which a knock event in slot 1 counts as knock and triggers feedback knock retard; used while the nominal (short) knock window is in use. Higher = less sensitive. Warning: the Full / Short Window sets were renamed on 2026-10-30 (earlier names had them swapped). Which cylinder slot 1 is has not been mapped.

table.name: Knock Background Window Step (Event 1, Channel 2)
table.description: Knock signal processing for event slot 1, channel 2 (probably a frequency band of the knock sensor). For the one event where the knock window switches length, it shifts the channel's background reference so the switch does not read as knock. Larger = that event less likely to count as knock. Leave alone unless recalibrating knock detection.

table.name: Knock Background Window Step (Event 1, Channel 3)
table.description: Knock signal processing for event slot 1, channel 3 (probably a frequency band of the knock sensor). For the one event where the knock window switches length, it shifts the channel's background reference so the switch does not read as knock: added when the window lengthens, subtracted when it shortens. Larger = more compensation in both directions (the lengthening event less likely to count as knock, the shortening event more likely). Leave alone unless recalibrating knock detection.

table.name: Timing Retard High Load (1st Gear)
table.description: Timing pulled at high load in 1st gear (by rpm and load), used only above about 2800 rpm and 0.84 g/rev (65 % load) and not in neutral. Raising values adds retard. Not used if knock control is switched off.

table.name: Timing Retard High Load (2nd Gear)
table.description: Timing pulled at high load in 2nd gear (by rpm and load), used only above about 2800 rpm and 0.84 g/rev (65 % load) and not in neutral. Raising values adds retard. Not used if knock control is switched off.

table.name: Timing Retard High Load (3rd Gear / Fault)
table.description: Timing pulled at high load in 3rd gear (by rpm and load), used above about 2800 rpm and 0.84 g/rev (65 % load) and not in neutral. Also used for every gear, rpm and load when CAN communication or vehicle speed faults are present. Not used if knock control is switched off.

table.name: Timing Retard High Load (4th Gear)
table.description: Timing pulled at high load in 4th gear (by rpm and load), used only above about 2800 rpm and 0.84 g/rev (65 % load) and not in neutral. Raising values adds retard. Not used if knock control is switched off.

table.name: Timing Retard High Load (5th Gear)
table.description: Timing pulled at high load in 5th gear (by rpm and load), used only above about 2800 rpm and 0.84 g/rev (65 % load) and not in neutral. Raising values adds retard. Not used if knock control is switched off.

table.name: Tip-In Timing Retard Start (Below 200 km/h)
table.description: Delay, in 10 ms steps after a sudden throttle opening (tip-in), before the tip-in timing retard starts, by rpm; used below 200 km/h.

table.name: Tip-In Timing Retard Start (From 200 km/h)
table.description: Delay, in 10 ms steps after a sudden throttle opening (tip-in), before the tip-in timing retard starts, by rpm; used at 200 km/h and above.

table.name: Tip-In Timing Retard Decay (Below 200 km/h)
table.description: How fast the tip-in timing retard is removed once its window ends, in degrees per combustion event by rpm; used below 200 km/h. Larger values give timing back faster.

table.name: Tip-In Timing Retard Decay (From 200 km/h)
table.description: How fast the tip-in timing retard is removed once its window ends, in degrees per combustion event by rpm; used at 200 km/h and above. Larger values give timing back faster.

table.name: Tip-In Timing Retard End (Below 200 km/h)
table.description: How long the tip-in timing retard lasts after a sudden throttle opening, in 10 ms steps by rpm; used below 200 km/h between about 3900 and 6375 rpm.

table.name: Tip-In Timing Retard End (From 200 km/h)
table.description: How long the tip-in timing retard lasts after a sudden throttle opening, in 10 ms steps by rpm; used from 200 to 250 km/h, between about 3900 and 6375 rpm.

table.name: Timing Request Recovery Rate After Tip-Out
table.description: Limits how fast the timing request may climb back to the closed-pedal target just after the pedal is released, by rpm. Lower values give a softer return.

table.name: Surge Damping Timing Curve (Gear 1)
table.description: Manual transmission, gear 1: timing correction (negative = retard) by the size of the throttle-flow change after a throttle step, scaled by the surge phase, coolant and mode factors. Appears to damp driveline surge (shuffle) by retarding while rpm swings up.

table.name: Surge Damping Timing Curve (Gear 2)
