table.name: Ignition Timing Per-Cylinder Trim (Cylinder 4)
table.description: Timing added to (or, negative, taken from) cylinder 4 only, by engine speed and load.

table.name: Base Timing (Pedal Released, TGV Open)
table.description: Base ignition timing map for the pedal fully released (idle and deceleration) with the TGVs open; from 1200 rpm up its rows equal Base Timing (EGR Off, TGV Open). It is only an upper limit: the ECU fires the lower of this map and Closed-Pedal Timing Target (plus its corrections).

table.name: Ignition Timing Cap (Pedal Released, TGV Closed)
table.description: Maximum timing allowed with the pedal fully released (idle and deceleration), by rpm and load, TGV-closed side; blended with Ignition Timing Cap (Pedal Released, TGV Open) by how far the TGVs are open. Never limits timing with the pedal pressed. The rpm axis ends at 4,000 rpm.

table.name: Ignition Timing Cap (Pedal Released, TGV Open)
table.description: Maximum timing allowed with the pedal fully released (idle and deceleration), by rpm and load, TGV-open side; blended with Ignition Timing Cap (Pedal Released, TGV Closed) by how far the TGVs are open. Never limits timing with the pedal pressed.

table.name: Closed-Pedal Timing Target (AT Drive Range)
table.description: AT version of Closed-Pedal Timing Target, used with the pedal released while the transmission is probably in a drive range.

table.name: Start Spark Target Base (Mode 1, AT/CVT, Warm-Up Fallback)
table.description: AT/CVT warm-up fallback copy of Start Spark Target Base (Mode 1).

table.name: Start Spark Target Run-Time Adder (Mode 1)
table.description: Added to Start Spark Target Base (Mode 1) by time since the engine started running and coolant, in the cold-start / catalyst-heating mode; manual-car set.

table.name: Start Spark Target Run-Time Adder (Mode 1, AT/CVT, Warm-Up Fallback)
table.description: AT/CVT warm-up fallback copy of Start Spark Target Run-Time Adder (Mode 1).

table.name: Start Spark Target Re-Entry Adder (Mode 1, AT/CVT, Warm-Up Fallback)
table.description: AT/CVT warm-up fallback copy of Start Spark Target Re-Entry Adder (Mode 1).

table.name: Start Spark Target Base (Mode 1, Warm-Up Fallback)
table.description: Warm-up fallback copy of Start Spark Target Base (Mode 1) for the manual car.

table.name: Start Spark Target Torque Adder (Mode 1, Warm-Up Fallback)
table.description: Warm-up fallback copy of Start Spark Target Torque Adder (Mode 1) for the manual car.

table.name: Target Boost (Electronic Wastegate)
table.description: Boost target by engine speed and target torque. This is the main boost target table.

table.name: Target Boost IAT Multiplier
table.description: Multiplies the boost target by intake air temperature (1.00 = no change).

table.name: Target Boost Baro Multiplier
table.description: Multiplies the boost target by engine speed and barometric pressure (1.00 = no change).

table.name: Target Boost Torque Correction (Coolant) 1
table.description: Added to the target torque the boost target is looked up with, by coolant temperature. Zero everywhere on the reference ROM.

table.name: Target Boost Torque Correction (Coolant) 2
table.description: Second coolant-temperature correction to the target torque the boost target is looked up with.

table.name: Target Boost Cap (Electronic Wastegate)
table.description: Upper limit on the final boost target. The highest value means no cap.

table.name: Wastegate Position Feed-Forward
table.description: Base wastegate position by engine speed and boost target, before feedback. 0% is closed on its seat; larger is more open.

table.name: Wastegate Position IAT Compensation
table.description: Scales the feed-forward opening by engine speed and intake air temperature (1.00 = no change).

table.name: Wastegate Position Baro Compensation
table.description: Scales the feed-forward opening by engine speed and barometric pressure (1.00 = no change).

table.name: Wastegate Position Feed-Forward Compensation
table.description: Scales the feed-forward opening by engine speed and the feed-forward position itself (1.00 = no change).

table.name: Wastegate Open Below RPM
table.description: Below this engine speed (by coolant temperature) the wastegate is held open.

table.name: Wastegate Actuator Target Speed
table.description: How fast the actuator is asked to move, by how far it is from the commanded position (raw units).

table.name: Wastegate Motor Feed-Forward Duty
table.description: Motor drive for the requested actuator speed, before the position feedback. Positive opens the wastegate.

table.name: Wastegate Motor Voltage Compensation
table.description: Scales the wastegate motor drive by supply voltage (1.00 = no change).

table.name: Wastegate Motor Holding Duty
table.description:
Motor drive used while the actuator holds still; negative is a closing force.
Details: On FFF89940 (not identified) (0x0C9B64, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Wastegate Position Command Minimum
table.description: Lowest position the boost control may command.

table.name: Wastegate Position Command Maximum
table.description: Highest position the boost control may command.

table.name: Wastegate Position (Low RPM Open)
table.description: Position used below the open-below engine speed.

table.name: Wastegate Position (Forced Closed)
table.description: Position used when another function asks for the wastegate to close.

table.name: Wastegate Position (Engine Stopped)
table.description: Position used while the engine is not running.

table.name: Wastegate Position (Service Open)
table.description:
Position used when the open-for-service switch in the calibration is set.
Details: Mode 5 (0x0C8C18, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Wastegate Position Deadband
table.description: Position error the actuator loop ignores.

table.name: Wastegate Learned Seat Maximum
table.description: Highest value the learned closed (seat) position may take.

table.name: Wastegate Learned Seat Minimum
table.description: Lowest value the learned closed (seat) position may take.

table.name: Wastegate Motor Duty Maximum
table.description: Largest opening drive to the wastegate motor.

table.name: Wastegate Motor Duty Minimum
table.description: Largest closing drive to the wastegate motor.

table.name: P0244 Wastegate Position Error Limit
table.description: Position error (commanded minus measured) that counts towards the wastegate actuator fault.

table.name: P0244 Wastegate Position Error Passes
table.description: How long the position error must last before the wastegate actuator fault is set (passes).

table.name: Boost Proportional (Wastegate Position)
table.description: Wastegate position change in proportion to boost error (target minus actual). Negative closes the wastegate.

table.name: Boost Integral Step (Wastegate Position)
table.description: Amount the boost integral changes each pass, by engine speed and boost error.

table.name: Boost Feed-Forward-Only Threshold
table.description: Above this boost target the wastegate runs on the feed-forward position alone, without boost feedback.

table.name: Boost Feed-Forward-Only Threshold Baro Factor
table.description: Scales the feed-forward-only threshold by engine speed and barometric pressure (1.00 = no change).

table.name: Boost Feed-Forward-Only Threshold IAT Factor
table.description: Scales the feed-forward-only threshold by engine speed and intake air temperature (1.00 = no change).

table.name: Boost Integral Maximum (Wastegate Position)
table.description: Largest opening the boost integral can add.

table.name: Boost Integral Minimum (Wastegate Position)
table.description: Largest closing the boost integral can add.

table.name: Boost Feedback Maximum (Wastegate Position)
table.description: Largest opening proportional and integral together can add.

table.name: Boost Feedback Minimum (Wastegate Position)
table.description: Largest closing proportional and integral together can add.

table.name: P0234 Overboost Error Threshold
table.description: P0234 (overboost) counts while actual boost is above target by more than this (shown negative).

table.name: P0234 Overboost Time
table.description: How long overboost must last before P0234 sets (passes).

table.name: Requested Torque (Drive Mode 1, Default, AT/CVT)
table.description: Drive mode 1: the default set (used when no SI-Drive request is received; the only set on cars without SI-Drive). On the AT/CVT coding this is the whole requested-torque map for this drive mode (Requested Torque (Drive Mode 1, Default) is then ignored); unused on manual cars. Edit it, and its Monitor copy, when tuning an AT/CVT car.

table.name: Requested Torque (Drive Mode 1, Default, AT/CVT, Monitor)
table.description: Monitor copy of Requested Torque (Drive Mode 1, Default, AT/CVT): keep identical to it or expect a throttle plausibility fault. Used only on the AT/CVT coding.

table.name: Requested Torque (Drive Mode 2, Sport, AT/CVT)
table.description: Drive mode 2: SI-Drive Sport (S). On the AT/CVT coding this is the whole requested-torque map for this drive mode (Requested Torque (Drive Mode 2, Sport) is then ignored); unused on manual cars. Edit it, and its Monitor copy, when tuning an AT/CVT car.

table.name: Requested Torque (Drive Mode 2, Sport, AT/CVT, Monitor)
table.description: Monitor copy of Requested Torque (Drive Mode 2, Sport, AT/CVT): keep identical to it or expect a throttle plausibility fault. Used only on the AT/CVT coding.

table.name: Requested Torque (Drive Mode 3, Intelligent, AT/CVT)
table.description: Drive mode 3: SI-Drive Intelligent (I). On the AT/CVT coding this is the whole requested-torque map for this drive mode (Requested Torque (Drive Mode 3, Intelligent) is then ignored); unused on manual cars. Edit it, and its Monitor copy, when tuning an AT/CVT car.

table.name: Requested Torque (Drive Mode 3, Intelligent, AT/CVT, Monitor)
table.description: Monitor copy of Requested Torque (Drive Mode 3, Intelligent, AT/CVT): keep identical to it or expect a throttle plausibility fault. Used only on the AT/CVT coding.

table.name: Requested Torque (Drive Mode 4, Sport Sharp, AT/CVT)
table.description: Drive mode 4: SI-Drive Sport Sharp (S#). On the AT/CVT coding this is the whole requested-torque map for this drive mode (Requested Torque (Drive Mode 4, Sport Sharp) is then ignored); unused on manual cars. Edit it, and its Monitor copy, when tuning an AT/CVT car.

table.name: Requested Torque (Drive Mode 4, Sport Sharp, AT/CVT, Monitor)
table.description: Monitor copy of Requested Torque (Drive Mode 4, Sport Sharp, AT/CVT): keep identical to it or expect a throttle plausibility fault. Used only on the AT/CVT coding.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Drive Mode 1, Default, AT/CVT Coding)
table.description: AT/CVT version of Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Drive Mode 1, Default). Only used on an AT/CVT-coded car, so it has no effect on a manual.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Drive Mode 2, Sport, AT/CVT Coding)
table.description: AT/CVT version of Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Drive Mode 2, Sport). Only used on an AT/CVT-coded car, so it has no effect on a manual.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Drive Mode 3, Intelligent, AT/CVT Coding)
table.description: AT/CVT version of Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Drive Mode 3, Intelligent). Only used on an AT/CVT-coded car, so it has no effect on a manual.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Drive Mode 4, Sport Sharp, AT/CVT Coding)
table.description: AT/CVT version of Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Drive Mode 4, Sport Sharp). Only used on an AT/CVT-coded car, so it has no effect on a manual.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 2 (Drive Mode 1, Default, AT/CVT Coding)
table.description: AT/CVT version of Target Torque Rise Step Stage 2 (Drive Mode 1, Default). Only used on an AT/CVT-coded car, so it has no effect on a manual.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 2 (Drive Mode 2, Sport, AT/CVT Coding)
table.description: AT/CVT version of Target Torque Rise Step Stage 2 (Drive Mode 2, Sport). Only used on an AT/CVT-coded car, so it has no effect on a manual.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 2 (Drive Mode 3, Intelligent, AT/CVT Coding)
table.description: AT/CVT version of Target Torque Rise Step Stage 2 (Drive Mode 3, Intelligent). Only used on an AT/CVT-coded car, so it has no effect on a manual.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 2 (Drive Mode 4, Sport Sharp, AT/CVT Coding)
table.description: AT/CVT version of Target Torque Rise Step Stage 2 (Drive Mode 4, Sport Sharp). Only used on an AT/CVT-coded car, so it has no effect on a manual.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Path B Coolant Rise
table.description: Part of the condition that lets Path B tip-in smoothing act, based on how much the coolant has warmed since start.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Path B Low-Speed Time
table.description: Part of the condition that lets Path B tip-in smoothing act: probably the time the car has been stopped. Its axis input is not identified (raw).

table.name: Target Torque Rise Path B Pedal-Released Low-Speed Time
table.description: Part of the condition that lets Path B tip-in smoothing act: probably the time stopped with the pedal released. Its axis input is not identified (raw).

table.name: Target Torque Rise Stage 2 Torque (Path B, Drive Mode 1, Default)
table.description: Path B tip-in smoothing for drive mode 1 (the default and fallback mode): the torque where Path B's slow stage hands over to its fast stage.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Stage 2 Torque (Path B, Drive Mode 2, Sport)
table.description: Path B tip-in smoothing for drive mode 2: the torque where Path B's slow stage hands over to its fast stage.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Stage 2 Torque (Path B, Drive Mode 3, Intelligent)
table.description: Path B tip-in smoothing for drive mode 3: the torque where Path B's slow stage hands over to its fast stage.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Stage 2 Torque (Path B, Drive Mode 4, Sport Sharp)
table.description: Path B tip-in smoothing for drive mode 4: the torque where Path B's slow stage hands over to its fast stage.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Start Torque (Path B, Drive Mode 1, Default)
table.description: Path B tip-in smoothing for drive mode 1 (the default and fallback mode): requests below this pass unsmoothed and Path B's slow stage starts here.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Start Torque (Path B, Drive Mode 2, Sport)
table.description: Path B tip-in smoothing for drive mode 2: requests below this pass unsmoothed and Path B's slow stage starts here.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Start Torque (Path B, Drive Mode 3, Intelligent)
table.description: Path B tip-in smoothing for drive mode 3: requests below this pass unsmoothed and Path B's slow stage starts here.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Start Torque (Path B, Drive Mode 4, Sport Sharp)
table.description: Path B tip-in smoothing for drive mode 4: requests below this pass unsmoothed and Path B's slow stage starts here.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Path B, Drive Mode 1, Default)
table.description: Path B tip-in smoothing for drive mode 1 (the default and fallback mode) with manual coding: allowed torque rise per 10 ms in Path B's slow stage.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Path B, Drive Mode 2, Sport)
table.description: Path B tip-in smoothing for drive mode 2 with manual coding: allowed torque rise per 10 ms in Path B's slow stage.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Path B, Drive Mode 3, Intelligent)
table.description: Path B tip-in smoothing for drive mode 3 with manual coding: allowed torque rise per 10 ms in Path B's slow stage.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Path B, Drive Mode 4, Sport Sharp)
table.description: Path B tip-in smoothing for drive mode 4 with manual coding: allowed torque rise per 10 ms in Path B's slow stage.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 Pedal Multiplier (Path B)
table.description: Pedal-based multiplier on Path B's slow-stage rise rate.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 2 (Path B, Drive Mode 1, Default)
table.description: Path B tip-in smoothing for drive mode 1 (the default and fallback mode) with manual coding: allowed torque rise per 10 ms in Path B's fast stage.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 2 (Path B, Drive Mode 3, Intelligent)
table.description: Path B tip-in smoothing for drive mode 3 with manual coding: allowed torque rise per 10 ms in Path B's fast stage.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 2 (Path B, Drive Mode 4, Sport Sharp)
table.description: Path B tip-in smoothing for drive mode 4 with manual coding: allowed torque rise per 10 ms in Path B's fast stage.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 2 Pedal Multiplier (Path B)
table.description: Pedal-based multiplier on Path B's fast-stage rise rate.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Path B, Drive Mode 1, Default, AT/CVT Coding)
table.description: Path B tip-in smoothing for drive mode 1 (the default and fallback mode) with AT/CVT coding: allowed torque rise per 10 ms in Path B's slow stage.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Path B, Drive Mode 2, Sport, AT/CVT Coding)
table.description: Path B tip-in smoothing for drive mode 2 with AT/CVT coding: allowed torque rise per 10 ms in Path B's slow stage.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Path B, Drive Mode 3, Intelligent, AT/CVT Coding)
table.description: Path B tip-in smoothing for drive mode 3 with AT/CVT coding: allowed torque rise per 10 ms in Path B's slow stage.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Path B, Drive Mode 4, Sport Sharp, AT/CVT Coding)
table.description: Path B tip-in smoothing for drive mode 4 with AT/CVT coding: allowed torque rise per 10 ms in Path B's slow stage.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 2 (Path B, Drive Mode 1, Default, AT/CVT Coding)
table.description: Path B tip-in smoothing for drive mode 1 (the default and fallback mode) with AT/CVT coding: allowed torque rise per 10 ms in Path B's fast stage.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 2 (Path B, Drive Mode 2, Sport, AT/CVT Coding)
table.description: Path B tip-in smoothing for drive mode 2 with AT/CVT coding: allowed torque rise per 10 ms in Path B's fast stage.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 2 (Path B, Drive Mode 3, Intelligent, AT/CVT Coding)
table.description: Path B tip-in smoothing for drive mode 3 with AT/CVT coding: allowed torque rise per 10 ms in Path B's fast stage.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 2 (Path B, Drive Mode 4, Sport Sharp, AT/CVT Coding)
table.description: Path B tip-in smoothing for drive mode 4 with AT/CVT coding: allowed torque rise per 10 ms in Path B's fast stage.

table.name: Maximum Torque (IAT)
table.description: Maximum target torque by rpm and intake air temperature. The ECU uses the lowest of this, Maximum Torque (DAM) and other limits, and the result drives the boost target.

table.name: Maximum Torque (Knock Event)
table.description: Torque ceiling while the knock-event detector has tripped, by engine speed.

table.name: Maximum Torque (Knock Event, Alternate)
table.description: The same ceiling, used instead when an ECU flag selects it (not identified).

table.name: Maximum Torque (Knock Cap, Margin)
table.description: Torque ceiling of the knock torque cap while its margin trigger is set and the selector flag is clear, by engine speed (no limit at the top of the scale).

table.name: Maximum Torque (Knock Cap, Margin, Selector)
table.description: Torque ceiling of the knock torque cap while its margin trigger is set and the selector flag is set, by engine speed (no limit at the top of the scale).

table.name: Maximum Torque (Knock Cap, Trigger A)
table.description: Torque ceiling of the knock torque cap while its trigger a trigger is set and the selector flag is clear, by engine speed (no limit at the top of the scale).

table.name: Maximum Torque (Knock Cap, Trigger A, Selector)
table.description: Torque ceiling of the knock torque cap while its trigger a trigger is set and the selector flag is set, by engine speed (no limit at the top of the scale).

table.name: Maximum Torque (Knock Cap, Trigger B)
table.description: Torque ceiling of the knock torque cap while its trigger b trigger is set and the selector flag is clear, by engine speed (no limit at the top of the scale).

table.name: Maximum Torque (Knock Cap, Trigger B, Selector)
table.description: Torque ceiling of the knock torque cap while its trigger b trigger is set and the selector flag is set, by engine speed (no limit at the top of the scale).

table.name: Knock Torque Cap Ramp Rate
table.description: How fast the margin torque ceiling moves toward its curve, and back up afterwards, per pass, by engine speed.

table.name: Rev/Boost Limit Torque Caps Enable
table.description: Lets the rev limiter and overboost cut close the throttle (the Rev/Boost Limit Torque tables).

table.name: Park/Neutral RPM Limit (AT/CVT)
table.description: Automatic/CVT only: with the selector in P or N, cylinders are cut once the engine reaches this speed, so a parked car cannot be revved past it. The cut stays on until the engine drops by the hysteresis. It does nothing on a manual-coded ECU. Separate from the normal rev limit.

table.name: Park/Neutral RPM Limit Hysteresis (AT/CVT)
table.description: How far below the Park/Neutral RPM Limit the engine has to fall before the cut ends.

table.name: Vehicle Speed Limit (Pedal)
table.description: The speed limiter in use: the share of the driver's pedal request allowed (100 % = no limit) by vehicle speed. It works above Vehicle Speed Limit (Pedal) Minimum RPM. The other three speed tables are variants for drive mode 3 (Intelligent) and for a VDC flag: to move or remove the limit, edit all four, or turn on Pedal Limits Disable. The fuel-cut Vehicle Speed Limit set is a separate limiter.

table.name: Vehicle Speed Limit (Pedal, Drive Mode 3, Intelligent)
table.description: As Vehicle Speed Limit (Pedal), in drive mode 3 (Intelligent). Edit it together with the other three.

table.name: Vehicle Speed Limit (Pedal, VDC Flag)
table.description: As Vehicle Speed Limit (Pedal), while a status flag from the VDC unit is set (its meaning is not decoded). Edit it together with the other three.

table.name: Vehicle Speed Limit (Pedal, VDC Flag, Drive Mode 3, Intelligent)
table.description: As Vehicle Speed Limit (Pedal, VDC Flag), in drive mode 3 (Intelligent). Edit it together with the other three.

table.name: Vehicle Speed Limit (Pedal) Speed Signal Fault RPM Limit
table.description: Takes over from the speed tables when the vehicle speed cannot be trusted (a speed sensor fault, or CAN messages from the transmission or VDC missing): the pedal request is then limited by engine speed. Leave it as it is unless you know you need to change it.

table.name: Vehicle Speed Limit (Pedal, VDC Flag) Speed Signal Fault RPM Limit
table.description: As Vehicle Speed Limit (Pedal) Speed Signal Fault RPM Limit, while the VDC flag is set.

table.name: Fail-Safe Rev Limit (Unused Fault Flag)
table.description: Fail-safe rev limit tied to a fault flag that nothing sets in this software.

table.name: External Torque Limit Baro Factor
table.description: Air-density correction (barometric part) applied to a torque limit received over CAN, probably from the transmission controller.

table.name: External Torque Limit IAT Factor
table.description: Air-density correction (intake temperature part) applied to a torque limit received over CAN, probably from the transmission controller.

table.name: Throttle Limit (Rail Pressure Deviation)
table.description: Throttle opening cap by rpm for a rail-pressure-deviation fault mode.

table.name: Throttle Offset Step IAT Factor
table.description: Intake-temperature factor on the step rate of a small throttle offset ramp.

table.name: Throttle Offset Step Baro Factor
table.description: Barometric factor on the step rate of a small throttle offset ramp.

table.name: Throttle Offset Limit IAT Factor
table.description: Intake-temperature factor on the lower limit of a small throttle offset ramp.

table.name: Throttle Offset Limit Baro Factor
table.description: Barometric factor on the lower limit of a small throttle offset ramp.

table.name: Throttle Offset RPM Threshold (Coolant)
table.description: Engine speed, by coolant temperature, below which a throttle offset ramp acts (probably a cold / low-speed throttle offset).

table.name: Throttle Command Rate Term

scaling.units: % per pass (change of throttle command, FFF8AF84 unit)

table.description: Has no effect: the ECU calculates a value from it that nothing reads.

table.name: Throttle Command Term
table.description: Has no effect: the ECU calculates a value from it that nothing reads.

table.name: Engine Torque from Load (DAM 1.0, TGV Closed)
table.description: Engine torque the ECU expects at a given rpm and load; probably shapes the estimated/reported torque, not throttle or boost. This is the full-DAM set, for TGVs closed, no EGR (blended by TGV position and EGR amount).

table.name: Engine Torque from Load (DAM 1.0, TGV Closed, EGR)
table.description: Engine torque the ECU expects at a given rpm and load; probably shapes the estimated/reported torque, not throttle or boost. This is the full-DAM set, for TGVs closed, EGR active (blended by TGV position and EGR amount).

table.name: Engine Torque from Load (DAM 1.0, TGV Open)
table.description: Engine torque the ECU expects at a given rpm and load; probably shapes the estimated/reported torque, not throttle or boost. This is the full-DAM set, for TGVs open, no EGR (blended by TGV position and EGR amount).

table.name: Engine Torque from Load (DAM 1.0, TGV Open, EGR)
table.description: Engine torque the ECU expects at a given rpm and load; probably shapes the estimated/reported torque, not throttle or boost. This is the full-DAM set, for TGVs open, EGR active (blended by TGV position and EGR amount).

table.name: Engine Torque from Load (DAM 0, TGV Closed)
table.description: Engine torque the ECU expects at a given rpm and load; probably shapes the estimated/reported torque, not throttle or boost. Zero-DAM set (blended with DAM 1.0 by DAM), TGVs closed, no EGR.

table.name: Engine Torque from Load (DAM 0, TGV Closed, EGR)
table.description: Engine torque the ECU expects at a given rpm and load; probably shapes the estimated/reported torque, not throttle or boost. This is the zero-DAM set (blended with DAM 1.0 by DAM), for TGVs closed, EGR active (blended by TGV position and EGR amount).

table.name: Engine Torque from Load (DAM 0, TGV Open)
table.description: Engine torque the ECU expects at a given rpm and load; probably shapes the estimated/reported torque, not throttle or boost. This is the zero-DAM set (blended with DAM 1.0 by DAM), for TGVs open, no EGR (blended by TGV position and EGR amount).

table.name: Engine Torque from Load (DAM 0, TGV Open, EGR)
table.description: Engine torque the ECU expects at a given rpm and load; probably shapes the estimated/reported torque, not throttle or boost. This is the zero-DAM set (blended with DAM 1.0 by DAM), for TGVs open, EGR active (blended by TGV position and EGR amount).

table.name: Torque Model Filter Multiplier B
table.description: Torque-model smoothing multiplier by coolant (1.0 = normal; very high values mean no smoothing), used in another phase after a combustion-mode change. Leave alone.

table.name: Torque Model Filter Multiplier A (Alt)
table.description: Alternate version of Torque Model Filter Multiplier A, used when an unidentified flag is set. Leave alone unless you know the model.

table.name: Torque Model Filter Multiplier C (Alt)
table.description: Alternate version of Torque Model Filter Multiplier C, used when an unidentified flag is set. Leave alone.

table.name: Spark Air Compensation Limiter
table.description: Limits, by requested amount and coolant, how much the throttle model may add air to make up for retarded spark (TGVs not closed). Large compensation is cut more when cold. Leave alone unless you know the model. On 2017+ ROMs edit the "(Alt)" version instead.

table.name: Spark Air Compensation Limiter Baro Factor
table.description: Barometric-pressure factor on Spark Air Compensation Limiter (later software versions).

table.name: Primary Ignition (TGV Closed, AVCS Active)
table.description: Knock-limited ignition timing by rpm and load for TGVs closed while the cams are under AVCS control. With the knock correction advance and fine learning added it forms one side of the timing limit: the ECU fires the lower of this sum and the Base Timing map.

table.name: Primary Ignition (TGV Closed, AVCS Inactive)
table.description: Knock-limited ignition timing by rpm and load for TGVs closed while AVCS is not controlling (start-up, hold or fault), blended in when AVCS drops out. With knock correction advance and fine learning added it forms one side of the timing limit; the ECU fires the lower of this sum and the Base Timing map.

table.name: Primary Ignition (TGV Open, AVCS Active)
table.description: Knock-limited ignition timing by rpm and load for TGVs open while the cams are under AVCS control. With the knock correction advance and fine learning added it forms one side of the timing limit: the ECU fires the lower of this sum and the Base Timing map.

table.name: Primary Ignition (TGV Open, AVCS Inactive)
table.description: Knock-limited ignition timing by rpm and load for TGVs open while AVCS is not controlling (start-up, hold or fault), blended in when AVCS drops out. With knock correction advance and fine learning added it forms one side of the timing limit; the ECU fires the lower of this sum and the Base Timing map.

table.name: Manifold Model Rising Transient Gain Multiplier
table.description: Gain multiplier of the manifold-pressure model during (and one pass after) a rising pressure transient, in gear.

table.name: Manifold Model Rising Transient Hysteresis
table.description: Hysteresis of the rising-transient detection, in gear.

table.name: Manifold Model Falling Transient Threshold
table.description: A falling transient starts when manifold pressure drops this far below its filtered value (negative), in gear.

table.name: Manifold Model Falling Transient Hysteresis
table.description: Hysteresis of the falling-transient detection, in gear.

table.name: Manifold Model Falling Transient Threshold (Neutral)
table.description: As the falling-transient threshold, in neutral.

table.name: Manifold Model Falling Transient Hysteresis (Neutral)
table.description: As the falling-transient hysteresis, in neutral.

table.name: Throttle Flow Coefficient (Reverse Flow)
table.description:
Coefficient of the throttle airflow model when the manifold is above the pre-throttle pressure. Leave alone.
Details: When used: every model pass while r > 1.0 (manifold above the pre-throttle pressure; the ratio is inverted). 0x11DD04 (read), enabled by FFF8A8FB bit 0 (0x11E43C): modelled throttle flow FFF8C24C [g/min] = (P_up/101325) x Throttle Flow Function(r) x FFF8ADEC (Throttle Area from Throttle Position, 0.05 mm^2) x Throttle Flow Temperature Correction x this x 60000 x 2.98e-15, which feeds the manifold/airflow observer 0x11DB50 / 0x11D938. Normally leave alone. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Map A (No Enrichment)
table.description: Exhaust temperature estimate (inferred) that decides when Primary Open Loop Fueling kicks in. Map A is the fast-reacting part, by rpm and load, used while no open loop enrichment is active. Raising it brings enrichment in earlier; lowering it delays it.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Map A (Standstill High Load)
table.description: Exhaust temperature estimate (inferred) that decides when Primary Open Loop Fueling kicks in. Map A is the fast-reacting part, by rpm and load, used instead of the other Map A tables while the car is at a standstill under high load (speed 5 km/h or less, pedal 80 % or more, load 40 % or more, for 1 s). Raising it brings enrichment in earlier; lowering it delays it.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Map B (Standstill High Load)
table.description: Exhaust temperature estimate (inferred) that decides when Primary Open Loop Fueling kicks in. Map B is the steady-state value the estimate settles to, by rpm and load, used while an unidentified speed/pedal/load flag is set. Raising it brings enrichment in earlier; lowering it delays it.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Retard Multiplier A (No Enrichment)
table.description: Exhaust temperature estimate (inferred) that decides when Primary Open Loop Fueling kicks in. Multiplies Exhaust Temperature Model Map A (No Enrichment) by timing retard. The Map A part only shapes how the estimate moves while conditions change: it is added through Filter A and taken off again through Filter B, so the settled value depends only on Map B x Retard Multiplier B.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Retard Multiplier A (Enriched)
table.description: Exhaust temperature estimate (inferred) that decides when Primary Open Loop Fueling kicks in. Multiplies Exhaust Temperature Model Map A (Enriched) by timing retard. The Map A part only shapes how the estimate moves while conditions change: it is added through Filter A and taken off again through Filter B, so the settled value depends only on Map B x Retard Multiplier B.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Retard Multiplier B (No Enrichment)
table.description: Exhaust temperature estimate (inferred) that decides when Primary Open Loop Fueling kicks in. Multiplies Exhaust Temperature Model Map B (No Enrichment) by timing retard: more retard, hotter estimate.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Retard Multiplier B (Enriched)
table.description: Exhaust temperature estimate (inferred) that decides when Primary Open Loop Fueling kicks in. Multiplies Exhaust Temperature Model Map B (Enriched) by timing retard: more retard, hotter estimate.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Filter A (Rising)
table.description: Exhaust temperature estimate (inferred) that decides when Primary Open Loop Fueling kicks in. How quickly the Map A part of the estimate follows a rising value (higher = faster).

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Filter A (Falling)
table.description: Exhaust temperature estimate (inferred) that decides when Primary Open Loop Fueling kicks in. How quickly the Map A part of the estimate follows a falling value (higher = faster).

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Filter B (Rising)
table.description: Exhaust temperature estimate (inferred) that decides when Primary Open Loop Fueling kicks in. How quickly the Map B part of the estimate follows a rising value (higher = faster).

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Filter B (Falling)
table.description: Exhaust temperature estimate (inferred) that decides when Primary Open Loop Fueling kicks in. How quickly the Map B part of the estimate follows a falling value (higher = faster).

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Fuel Cut Step
table.description: Exhaust temperature estimate (inferred): an amount added to the estimate at the start of each fuel cut, by air quantity, which then decays away by Exhaust Temperature Model Fuel Cut Decay.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Fuel Cut Decay
table.description: Exhaust temperature estimate (inferred): how fast the fuel-cut term from Exhaust Temperature Model Fuel Cut Step decays, by air quantity (1.0 = no decay).

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Estimate 2 Map (No Enrichment)
table.description: Second exhaust/catalyst temperature estimate (inferred), by rpm and load, with no enrichment active. When it gets high enough the ECU skips the delay before open loop fueling. Raising it brings open loop in sooner.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Estimate 2 Map (Enriched)
table.description: Second exhaust/catalyst temperature estimate (inferred), by rpm and load, while open loop enrichment is active. When it gets high enough the ECU skips the delay before open loop fueling.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Estimate 2 Map (Standstill High Load)
table.description: Version of Exhaust Temperature Estimate 2 Map used while an unidentified flag (based on vehicle speed, pedal and load) is set.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Estimate 2 Filter (Rising)
table.description: How quickly the second exhaust temperature estimate follows a rising value (higher = faster). Normally leave alone.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Estimate 2 Filter (Falling)
table.description: How quickly the second exhaust temperature estimate follows a falling value (higher = faster). Normally leave alone.

table.name: Exhaust Temperature Estimate 2 Second Filter
table.description: Extra smoothing stage on the second exhaust temperature estimate. Normally leave alone.

table.name: A/F Sensor Exhaust Temp Model Base
table.description: Base exhaust temperature by rpm and load for the A/F sensor's exhaust model, which probably decides when it is safe to heat the front A/F sensor fully (water condensation check). Does not affect fuel or timing.

table.name: A/F Sensor Exhaust Temp Model Hot Restart Factor (2D)
table.description: Later-software version of A/F Sensor Exhaust Temp Model Hot Restart Factor: on a hot restart the exhaust model starts from the stored pipe temperature times this factor, by stored temperature and coolant drop. Normally leave alone.

table.name: Exhaust Cam Target 1A (TGV Open, Normal, Altitude)
table.description: Exhaust cam retard target (degrees from the fully advanced rest position) by rpm and load for normal driving with the TGVs open, at altitude (near sea level 1B is used). Higher = later exhaust closing and more overlap. The normal vs high-pedal split is inferred.

table.name: Exhaust Cam Coolant Offset 2A (High Pedal, Altitude)
table.description: Extra exhaust cam retard (degrees, scaled by the exhaust coolant factor) added to the high-pedal (near wide-open) TGV-open target at altitude. Not present in the 2015/2016 builds.

table.name: Exhaust Cam Target Ceiling (Oil Temp Low, breakpoint 0x496C5)
table.description: Upper limit on the final exhaust cam target, interpolated by (probably) oil temperature between the Low / Mid / High ceiling tables.

table.name: Exhaust Cam Target Ceiling (Oil Temp Mid, breakpoint 0x496C6)
table.description: Upper limit on the final exhaust cam target, interpolated by (probably) oil temperature between the Low / Mid / High ceiling tables.

table.name: Exhaust Cam Target Ceiling (Oil Temp High, breakpoint 0x496C4)
table.description: Upper limit on the final exhaust cam target, interpolated by (probably) oil temperature between the Low / Mid / High ceiling tables.

table.name: AVCS Barometric Blend
table.description: Share (0-100 %) of the altitude (A) cam target tables versus the sea-level (B) tables, by barometric pressure.

table.name: AVCS Activation Delay After Start (Second)
table.description: A second start-delay table that can only shorten the AVCS hold after the hold has already ended, so it never changes anything. Edit AVCS Activation Delay After Start instead.

table.name: Intake AVCS OCV Current Integral Step
table.description: Integral step for the intake oil control valve current loop. a calibration setting forces the integral term to zero.

table.name: Exhaust AVCS OCV Current Integral Step
table.description: Integral step for the exhaust oil control valve current loop. a calibration setting forces the exhaust integral term to zero.

table.name: Idle Speed Target (Warm Idle, Mode 5)
table.description: Main idle speed target by coolant in normal running; this is the table to edit to change idle speed on a manual car. Automatic/CVT cars use Mode 6 instead.

table.name: Idle Speed Target (Warm Idle, AT/CVT, Mode 6)
table.description: Warm idle speed target by coolant for automatic/CVT cars only; a manual car never uses this table.

table.name: Idle Speed Target (Warm Start, Mode 3)
table.description: Idle speed target by coolant after a hot restart (coolant at or above 75 degC at start), until the car moves. Raise for a higher idle right after hot starts.

table.name: Idle Speed Target (In Drive, AT/CVT)
table.description: Idle speed target by coolant while an automatic/CVT car idles in Drive with the brake on (pedal released, slow). Never used on a manual car (inferred).

table.name: Idle Target Ramp Rate (Mode 1 to 2)
table.description: How fast the idle speed target moves (by coolant) when idle switches from mode 1 (engine stopped) to mode 2 (cold post-start). Larger = quicker change towards the new idle target; smaller = a gentler fade.

table.name: Idle Target Ramp Rate (Mode 1 to 3)
table.description: How fast the idle speed target moves (by coolant) when idle switches from mode 1 (engine stopped) to mode 3 (warm-start). Larger = quicker change towards the new idle target; smaller = a gentler fade.

table.name: Idle Target Ramp Rate (Mode 1 to 5)
table.description: How fast the idle speed target moves (by coolant) when idle switches from mode 1 (engine stopped) to mode 5 (warm idle). Larger = quicker change towards the new idle target; smaller = a gentler fade.

table.name: Idle Target Ramp Rate (AT/CVT, Mode 1 to 6)
table.description: How fast the idle speed target moves (by coolant) when idle switches from mode 1 (engine stopped) to mode 6 (AT/CVT warm idle). Larger = quicker change. Automatic/CVT only: these modes never occur on a manual car, so this table has no effect there.

table.name: Idle Target Ramp Rate (AT/CVT, Mode 2 to 6)
table.description: How fast the idle speed target moves (by coolant) when idle switches from mode 2 (cold post-start) to mode 6 (AT/CVT warm idle). Larger = quicker change. Automatic/CVT only: these modes never occur on a manual car, so this table has no effect there.

table.name: Idle Target Ramp Rate (AT/CVT, Mode 2 to 8)
table.description: How fast the idle speed target moves (by coolant) when idle switches from mode 2 (cold post-start) to mode 8 (AT/CVT warm-up drive-off). Larger = quicker change. Automatic/CVT only: these modes never occur on a manual car, so this table has no effect there.

table.name: Idle Target Ramp Rate (AT/CVT, Mode 3 to 6)
table.description: How fast the idle speed target moves (by coolant) when idle switches from mode 3 (warm-start) to mode 6 (AT/CVT warm idle). Larger = quicker change. Automatic/CVT only: these modes never occur on a manual car, so this table has no effect there.

table.name: Idle Target Ramp Rate (AT/CVT, Mode 3 to 8)
table.description: How fast the idle speed target moves (by coolant) when idle switches from mode 3 (warm-start) to mode 8 (AT/CVT warm-up drive-off). Larger = quicker change. Automatic/CVT only: these modes never occur on a manual car, so this table has no effect there.

table.name: Idle Target Ramp Rate (AT/CVT, Mode 4 to 6)
table.description: How fast the idle speed target moves (by coolant) when idle switches from mode 4 (cold idle) to mode 6 (AT/CVT warm idle). Larger = quicker change. Automatic/CVT only: these modes never occur on a manual car, so this table has no effect there.

table.name: Idle Target Ramp Rate (AT/CVT, Mode 5 to 6)
table.description: How fast the idle speed target moves (by coolant) when idle switches from mode 5 (warm idle) to mode 6 (AT/CVT warm idle). Larger = quicker change. Automatic/CVT only: these modes never occur on a manual car, so this table has no effect there.

table.name: Idle Target Ramp Rate (AT/CVT, Mode 6 to 4)
table.description: How fast the idle speed target moves (by coolant) when idle switches from mode 6 (AT/CVT warm idle) to mode 4 (cold idle). Larger = quicker change. Automatic/CVT only: these modes never occur on a manual car, so this table has no effect there.

table.name: Idle Target Ramp Rate (AT/CVT, Mode 6 to 5)
table.description: How fast the idle speed target moves (by coolant) when idle switches from mode 6 (AT/CVT warm idle) to mode 5 (warm idle). Larger = quicker change. Automatic/CVT only: these modes never occur on a manual car, so this table has no effect there.

table.name: Idle Target Ramp Rate (AT/CVT, Mode 7 to 6)
table.description: How fast the idle speed target moves (by coolant) when idle switches from mode 7 (warm-up drive-off) to mode 6 (AT/CVT warm idle). Larger = quicker change. Automatic/CVT only: these modes never occur on a manual car, so this table has no effect there.

table.name: Idle Target Ramp Rate (AT/CVT, Mode 7 to 8)
table.description: How fast the idle speed target moves (by coolant) when idle switches from mode 7 (warm-up drive-off) to mode 8 (AT/CVT warm-up drive-off). Larger = quicker change. Automatic/CVT only: these modes never occur on a manual car, so this table has no effect there.

table.name: Idle Target Ramp Rate (AT/CVT, Mode 8 to 5)
table.description: How fast the idle speed target moves (by coolant) when idle switches from mode 8 (AT/CVT warm-up drive-off) to mode 5 (warm idle). Larger = quicker change. Automatic/CVT only: these modes never occur on a manual car, so this table has no effect there.

table.name: Idle Target Ramp Rate (AT/CVT, Mode 8 to 6)
table.description: How fast the idle speed target moves (by coolant) when idle switches from mode 8 (AT/CVT warm-up drive-off) to mode 6 (AT/CVT warm idle). Larger = quicker change. Automatic/CVT only: these modes never occur on a manual car, so this table has no effect there.

table.name: Idle Target Ramp Rate (AT/CVT, Mode 8 to 7)
table.description: How fast the idle speed target moves (by coolant) when idle switches from mode 8 (AT/CVT warm-up drive-off) to mode 7 (warm-up drive-off). Larger = quicker change. Automatic/CVT only: these modes never occur on a manual car, so this table has no effect there.

table.name: Idle Speed Target (Cold Idle, Mode 4)
table.description: Idle speed target by coolant for a cold-idle mode used when stopped below a coolant threshold.

table.name: Idle Target Ramp Rate (Mode 4 to 5)
table.description: How fast the idle speed target moves (by coolant) when idle switches from mode 4 to mode 5.

table.name: Idle Target Ramp Rate (Mode 5 to 4)
table.description: How fast the idle speed target moves (by coolant) when idle switches from mode 5 to mode 4.

table.name: CAN Idle Speed Request (Alternate)
table.description: Minimum idle speed requested by another module over CAN, by request code.

table.name: CAN Idle Speed Request Remap (Alternate)
table.description: Remaps the CAN idle speed request before it is applied.

table.name: CAN Idle Speed Request Remap (Flag Set, Alternate)
table.description: Alternative remap of the CAN idle speed request, used when an unidentified CAN flag is set.

table.name: Idle Base Air (AT/CVT, Mode 6, TGV Closed)
table.description: Base (open-loop) idle air by coolant in warm idle on automatic/CVT cars only (never used on a manual car), used while the TGVs are commanded closed (the normal state at low torque, probably including warm idle). Change it together with the matching Idle Speed Target and the normal Idle Base Air table for this mode.

table.name: Post-Start Staged Air Level
table.description: Peak level of the staged post-start air, by start type and coolant. Part of a timed post-start air bump.

table.name: Post-Start Staged Air Ramp Step
table.description: Rise of the staged post-start air every 40 ms between Start Time and End Time, by start type and coolant. Part of a timed post-start air bump.

table.name: Post-Start Staged Air Ramp Step (TGV Closed)
table.description: Rise of the staged post-start air every 40 ms between Start Time and End Time, by start type and coolant. Part of a timed post-start air bump. TGVs-forced-closed copy; edit with the normal table.

table.name: Post-Start Staged Air Decay (TGV Closed)
table.description: Multiplier applied every 40 ms after End Time, by start type and coolant (smaller = faster fade). Part of a timed post-start air bump. TGVs-forced-closed copy; edit with the normal table.

table.name: Idle Air Reduction In Drive (AT/CVT, Coolant)
table.description: Idle air taken away, by coolant, while an automatic/CVT car idles in Drive (pedal released, slow) to offset the load of the transmission. Never used on a manual car.

table.name: Idle Air Reduction In Drive (AT/CVT, RPM Error)
table.description: Correction to Idle Air Reduction In Drive by rpm error (actual minus target) and coolant, for automatic/CVT cars idling in Drive. Never used on a manual car.

table.name: Idle Air Target-Change Feed-Forward (AT/CVT, State 0/5)
table.description: Automatic/CVT version of Idle Air Target-Change Feed-Forward, used in two transmission states only: extra or less idle air applied immediately when the idle speed target changes, by the size of the step.

table.name: Idle Base Air (Cold Idle, Mode 4)
table.description: Base idle air by coolant for the cold-idle mode 4.

table.name: Idle Base Air (Cold Idle, Mode 4, TGV Closed)
table.description: Base idle air by coolant for the cold-idle mode 4 with the TGVs commanded closed.

table.name: Post-Start Idle Air (Stop-Start Restart)
table.description: Post-start idle air for an automatic stop-start restart, by start type and coolant. the stop-start feature appears unable to activate in this calibration.

table.name: Post-Start Idle Air (Stop-Start Restart, TGV Closed)
table.description: Post-start idle air for an automatic stop-start restart with the TGVs closed. the stop-start feature appears unable to activate in this calibration.

table.name: A/C Idle Air (Alternate, Target RPM)
table.description: A/C idle air by an unidentified CAN load value and idle target rpm, for an alternate A/C idle-air path.

table.name: A/C Idle Air (Alternate, Engine Speed)
table.description: A/C idle air by an unidentified CAN load value and engine speed, for an alternate A/C idle-air path.

table.name: A/C Idle Air Initial Kick (Alternate)
table.description: Initial A/C idle air kick by an unidentified CAN code, for an alternate A/C idle-air path.

table.name: A/C Idle Air Kick Duration (Alternate)
table.description: How long the alternate A/C idle air kick is held, by an unidentified CAN code.

table.name: Low Voltage Idle Request Threshold (Alternator Command)
table.description: Battery voltage threshold, by alternator command, for a low-voltage idle-up request. Unused in this ROM: its result is never read, so editing it has no effect.

table.name: EGR Target Rate (TGV Open)
table.description: Main EGR rate target (% of intake charge, probably external EGR) by rpm and load while the TGVs are open. 0 = no EGR. Capped by EGR Target Rate Maximum.

table.name: EGR Target Rate (TGV Closed)
table.description: Main EGR rate target (% of intake charge, probably external EGR) by rpm and load while the TGVs are closed. 0 = no EGR. Raising it adds more exhaust gas at light load. Capped by EGR Target Rate Maximum.

table.name: EGR Target Rate Reduction Multiplier
table.description: Multiplier (255 = 1.0) by rpm and load that reduces the target EGR rate while an unidentified module requests it and EGR flow is present. When the request is active is not known.

table.name: EGR Enable Minimum Air after Start
table.description: Amount of air (probably the air drawn since start), by coolant at start, that must pass before EGR is enabled.

table.name: EGR Enable Load Minimum
table.description: EGR is only enabled when load is at or above this.

table.name: EGR Enable Load Maximum
table.description: EGR is only enabled when load is at or below this.

table.name: EGR Timing Advance (TGV Closed)
table.description: Extra timing advance requested while EGR is active with the TGVs closed, by rpm and load, scaled by how much EGR is flowing. It is added to the Primary Ignition request, so it reaches the spark only where that request (plus knock advance) is below the Base Timing (EGR Active) map, never above it.

table.name: EGR Timing Advance DAM Term (TGV Closed)
table.description: Extra EGR timing advance that is weighted in by DAM, TGVs closed.

table.name: EGR Timing Advance DAM Term (TGV Open)
table.description: Extra EGR timing advance that is weighted in by DAM, TGVs open.

table.name: EGR Timing Advance DAM Term Weight
table.description: How much of the DAM term applies, by DAM (128 = all of it; 0 = off, as on the 2.0 WRX).

table.name: EGR Timing Advance (TGV Open)
table.description: Extra timing advance requested while EGR is active with the TGVs open, by rpm and load, scaled by how much EGR is flowing. It is added to the Primary Ignition request, so it reaches the spark only where that request (plus knock advance) is below the Base Timing (EGR Active) map, never above it.

table.name: EGR Coolant Timing Adjustment (TGV Closed)
table.description: Timing adjustment by rpm and load while EGR is active and the TGVs are closed, scaled by EGR Coolant Timing Adjustment Coolant Multiplier so it acts only on a cooler engine. It is added to both base timing and the timing request, so it moves the fired timing directly.

table.name: EGR Coolant Timing Adjustment Coolant Multiplier
table.description: Multiplier (255 = 1.0) by coolant on the EGR timing adjustment tables.

table.name: EGR Target Flow Coolant Multiplier
table.description: Multiplier (128 = 1.0) by coolant and load on the target EGR flow that drives the valve.

table.name: EGR Upstream Pressure Baro Adder
table.description: Correction by rpm and load added to EGR Upstream Pressure Estimate, scaled by EGR Upstream Pressure Baro Adder Multiplier.

table.name: EGR Upstream Pressure Baro Adder Multiplier
table.description: Multiplier (128 = 1.0) by barometric pressure on EGR Upstream Pressure Baro Adder.

table.name: EGR Target Rate (TGV Open, Multi-Injection)
table.description:
EGR rate target by rpm and load with the TGVs open and multiple injections per cycle.
Details: When used: TGVs not closed and multi-injection active (FFF8A775 bit 1); cal 0x2F797 bit 5 clear. Base target EGR rate A818, looked up by 0x0FA10C with rpm FFF8CD54 x load FFF8A616 (read, disassembly). Target EGR rate (0x0FA260, read): FFF8A81A = base A817 x Coolant Multiplier 05CB04/255 x 255/255 (A816) x Reduction Multiplier A81C/255 x DAM Multiplier 05CB10/128, x 640 (1/640 units), capped at cal 0x2C4E6 (192 = 30 %) and forced to 0 unless the enable conditions FFF8A811 bit 0 hold (0x0FAAFC). A817 follows the base table A818 (0x0FA068). Multi-injection = FFF8A775 bit 1, set by 0x0FAABC when the multi-injection enable FFF8A775 bit 0 is set and all four per-injector strategy bytes FFF8A69F..A6A2 are 2 or 3 (read). TGVs closed = FFF8A881 bit 4 set (read: 0x10C948 drives the TGV open fraction FFF8B3E8 to 0 while the bit is set). EGR controller task 0x0F94A8 (read). That this is external EGR is inferred: its commanded output FFF8A81B is the OBD PID 0x2C (Commanded EGR) source and FFF88A1C (actual position) feeds PID 0x2D (EGR error) (0x1717C8, 0x1715F0, read). 0 = no EGR. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: EGR Target Rate (TGV Closed, Multi-Injection)
table.description:
EGR rate target by rpm and load with the TGVs closed and multiple injections per cycle.
Details: When used: TGVs closed and multi-injection active (FFF8A775 bit 1); cal 0x2F797 bit 5 clear. Base target EGR rate A818, looked up by 0x0FA10C with rpm FFF8CD54 x load FFF8A616 (read, disassembly). Target EGR rate (0x0FA260, read): FFF8A81A = base A817 x Coolant Multiplier 05CB04/255 x 255/255 (A816) x Reduction Multiplier A81C/255 x DAM Multiplier 05CB10/128, x 640 (1/640 units), capped at cal 0x2C4E6 (192 = 30 %) and forced to 0 unless the enable conditions FFF8A811 bit 0 hold (0x0FAAFC). A817 follows the base table A818 (0x0FA068). Multi-injection = FFF8A775 bit 1, set by 0x0FAABC when the multi-injection enable FFF8A775 bit 0 is set and all four per-injector strategy bytes FFF8A69F..A6A2 are 2 or 3 (read). TGVs closed = FFF8A881 bit 4 set (read: 0x10C948 drives the TGV open fraction FFF8B3E8 to 0 while the bit is set). EGR controller task 0x0F94A8 (read). That this is external EGR is inferred: its commanded output FFF8A81B is the OBD PID 0x2C (Commanded EGR) source and FFF88A1C (actual position) feeds PID 0x2D (EGR error) (0x1717C8, 0x1715F0, read). 0 = no EGR. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: EGR Target Rate Tip-Out Limit (TGV Open)
table.description: Cap on the target EGR rate for a short time after a pedal tip-out (inferred), by rpm and load, TGVs open.

table.name: EGR Target Rate Tip-Out Limit (TGV Closed)
table.description: Cap on the target EGR rate for a short time after a pedal tip-out (inferred), by rpm and load, TGVs closed.

table.name: EGR Target Rate Tip-Out Limit (TGV Open, Multi-Injection)
table.description: Multi-injection version of the TGV-open EGR tip-out cap.

table.name: EGR Target Rate Tip-Out Limit (TGV Closed, Multi-Injection)
table.description: Multi-injection version of the TGV-closed EGR tip-out cap.

table.name: EGR Tip-Out Limit Duration
table.description: How long, by manifold pressure, the EGR tip-out cap is held after a pedal tip-out.

table.name: EGR Timing Advance (Multi-Injection, TGV Closed)
table.description: Multi-injection copy of EGR Timing Advance (TGV Closed).

table.name: EGR Timing Advance (Multi-Injection, TGV Open)
table.description: Multi-injection copy of EGR Timing Advance (TGV Open).

table.name: EGR Timing Advance DAM Term (Multi-Injection, TGV Closed)
table.description:
As the EGR DAM term, with multiple injection.
Details: 0x0DD0DC (read), used while FFF8A775 bit 2 is set. Confidence: read.

table.name: EGR Timing Advance DAM Term (Multi-Injection, TGV Open)
table.description:
As the EGR DAM term, with multiple injection.
Details: 0x0DD0DC (read). Confidence: read.

table.name: TGV Coolant Minimum
table.description: Minimum coolant temperature for the TGVs to close (probably; part of the TGV close conditions).

table.name: TGV Air Quantity Maximum (Enter)
table.description: Air flow below which the TGVs may close (probably; part of the TGV close conditions together with torque and coolant). Raise it (with TGV Air Quantity Maximum (Exit)) to let the TGVs close at higher air flow; once closed they reopen above the Exit value.

table.name: TGV Air Quantity Maximum (Exit)
table.description: Air flow above which a TGV-close request clears again (probably reopening the TGVs); the upper end of the hysteresis with TGV Air Quantity Maximum (Enter). Keep it above the Enter value.

table.name: TGV Torque Threshold Enter (Start Modes)
table.description: Requested-torque threshold for TGV closing in a start combustion mode.

table.name: TGV Torque Threshold Exit (Start Modes)
table.description: Exit threshold paired with TGV Torque Threshold Enter (Start Modes).

table.name: Brake Booster Vacuum Model Maximum
table.description: Upper limit, by barometric pressure, of a modelled brake-booster vacuum.

table.name: Brake Booster Vacuum Model Manifold Threshold
table.description: Manifold-vacuum threshold, by barometric pressure, for a brake-booster vacuum model.

table.name: Radiator Fan Duty (Coolant)
table.description: Radiator fan duty by coolant for an alternate (duty-based) fan control path.

table.name: Battery Capacity
table.description: Battery capacity the ECU uses to turn charge and discharge current into state of charge.

table.name: Battery State of Charge Reset Value
table.description: The state of charge the ECU assumes when its estimate is reset.

table.name: Radiator Fan Duty (Coolant, Flag A807 Set)
table.description: Radiator fan duty by coolant, used when an unidentified driving-condition flag is set.

table.name: Radiator Fan Duty (Coolant, CAN 0x282 Value High)
table.description: Radiator fan duty by coolant, used when an unidentified CAN value is high.

table.name: Radiator Fan Duty (A/C, CAN 0x280 Value)
table.description: Radiator fan duty with the A/C requested, by an unidentified CAN value.

table.name: Engine Torque from Load (CAN, DAM 1.0)
table.description: Engine torque by rpm and load at DAM 1.0, blended with the DAM 0 table by DAM. Only affects the maximum-available torque value the ECU sends over CAN to other modules (inferred meaning); it does not change fuel, spark, throttle or boost. Mostly equal to Engine Torque from Load (DAM 1.0, TGV Open); keep consistent if you change the torque model.

table.name: Engine Torque from Load (CAN, DAM 0)
table.description: Engine torque by rpm and load at DAM 0, blended with the DAM 1.0 table by DAM. Only affects the maximum-available torque value the ECU sends over CAN to other modules (inferred meaning); it does not change fuel, spark, throttle or boost. Close to, but somewhat lower than, the Engine Torque from Load (DAM 0) tables.

table.name: Gear Road Speed per 1000 RPM
table.description: Road speed per 1000 rpm for each gear, used only by the gear advice function. The values do not match the 6MT and probably belong to another transmission.

table.name: Gear Road Speed per 1000 RPM (Alternate)
table.description: Alternate road speed per 1000 rpm for each gear, used only by the gear advice function. The values do not match the 6MT and probably belong to another transmission.

table.name: Gear Advice Consumption Map
table.description: Fuel consumption map by torque and rpm (probably g/kWh) for a gear-shift advice function that picks the most economical gear. One table edits all three copies.

table.name: Gear Advice Downshift Maximum RPM (Alternate)
table.description: Alternate rpm limit, by gear, below which a downshift may be advised by the gear advice function.

table.name: Gear Advice Upshift Minimum RPM
table.description: Minimum rpm in the next gear up, by pedal and gear, for an upshift to be advised by the gear advice function.

table.name: Gear Advice Upshift Minimum RPM (Alternate)
table.description: Alternate minimum rpm in the next gear up, by pedal and gear, for an upshift to be advised by the gear advice function.

table.name: A/F Sensor Scaling (Wide Range)
table.description: Converts the front wideband A/F sensor signal to lambda when the reading is outside about lambda 0.90-1.37. This is the measured lambda used by closed loop fueling.

table.name: A/F Sensor Scaling (Near Stoich)
table.description: Converts the front A/F sensor signal to lambda when it reads within about lambda 0.90-1.37, at a higher gain.

table.name: Battery Temperature Sensor Scaling
table.description: Converts the battery temperature sensor voltage to degrees for the charging-voltage control. It is probably the temperature half of the battery sensor, whose current signal the ECU also reads. Leave alone unless the battery sensor is changed.

table.name: Rear O2 Sensor Ready Heater Energy Threshold
table.description: How much heater energy, by coolant temperature at start, the rear O2 sensor must have received before it is treated as warmed up and ready. Raising it delays the rear O2 sensor (and its diagnostics) becoming active.

table.name: A/F Imbalance Monitor Swing Threshold 1
table.description: First reference for the P219A (A/F imbalance) monitor: how much the front A/F sensor reading may swing, by rpm and load, over the 25-second test window. Raising it makes P219A harder to set. A fault also needs A/F Imbalance Monitor Crank Roughness Threshold 1 to be exceeded. Above about 4000 rpm the reference climbs steeply (interpolating to the 4500 rpm row, which is effectively infinite), so running above about 4000 rpm during the window stops the test from failing.

table.name: A/F Imbalance Monitor Swing Threshold 2
table.description: Second, higher reference for the P219A (A/F imbalance) monitor, used with A/F Imbalance Monitor Crank Roughness Threshold 2 as confirmation. Raising it makes P219A harder to set. Above about 4000 rpm the reference climbs steeply (interpolating to the 4500 rpm row, which is effectively infinite), so running above about 4000 rpm during the window stops the test from failing.

table.name: Misfire Threshold A (Transmission Flag 6)
table.description: Misfire detection limit A by engine speed and load, used while the transmission sets bit 6 of byte 1 in its CAN message 368 (hex); higher = less sensitive, 65535 = no detection.

table.name: Misfire Threshold A (Transmission Flag 5)
table.description: Misfire detection limit A by engine speed and load, used while the transmission sets bit 5 of byte 1 in its CAN message 368 (hex); higher = less sensitive, 65535 = no detection.

table.name: Misfire Threshold A
table.description: Misfire detection limit A by engine speed and load (the normal map); higher = less sensitive, 65535 = no detection.

table.name: Misfire Threshold A (Alternate)
table.description: Misfire detection limit A by engine speed and load, used while detection is inhibited or at low vehicle speed; higher = less sensitive, 65535 = no detection.

table.name: Misfire Threshold A (Window)
table.description: Misfire detection limit A by engine speed and load, used in a particular engine speed and load window; higher = less sensitive, 65535 = no detection.

table.name: Misfire Threshold A Coolant Multiplier (Transmission Flag 6)
table.description: Coolant temperature multiplier on Misfire Threshold A (Transmission Flag 6).

table.name: Misfire Threshold A Coolant Multiplier (Transmission Flag 5)
table.description: Coolant temperature multiplier on Misfire Threshold A (Transmission Flag 5).

table.name: Misfire Threshold A Coolant Multiplier
table.description: Coolant temperature multiplier on Misfire Threshold A.

table.name: Misfire Threshold A Coolant Multiplier (Alternate)

table.name: Misfire Threshold A Coolant Multiplier (Window)

table.name: Misfire Threshold A Learned-Value Multiplier

table.name: Misfire Threshold B (Transmission Flag 6)

table.name: Misfire Threshold B Coolant Multiplier (Transmission Flag 6)

table.name: Cranking Fuel Coolant Multiplier (Special Start)
table.description: A first start (type 0) uses x1.0. Multiplier in the normal cranking pulse FFF8AFC6 when FFF8A6E7 = 3 (0x0C9038, coolant FFF8CD65 = degC + 50, read from the call at 0x0C6896); 255 (x1.0) for other values. LF9F000R: located from LF75404S 05A350 by the code that reads it (read). LF9K000D: same code as LF9F000R; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LT8F300C: same code as LF9K000D; address from the same instruction (similarity port (code)). LT8D800A: same code as LT8F300C; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 06BE6C. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Injection Angle Base (TGV Normal)
table.description: First-pulse (intake stroke) injection angle in catalyst-heating phase 2 and the start sequence, by rpm and coolant, limited to 180.5-360 BTDC. Used when the TGVs are not closed.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Injection Angle Base Adder (TGV Normal)
table.description: Rpm x load correction to Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Injection Angle Base (TGV Normal); positive = later. TGVs not closed.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Injection Angle Base Spark Adder (TGV Normal)
table.description: Correction by spark target and coolant to the phase 2 first-pulse angle, TGVs not closed; positive = later.

table.name: Purge Rate (Open-Loop Enrichment)
table.description: Purge rate by load while open-loop enrichment is active.

table.name: Knock Torque Cap Margin Threshold
table.description: Knock margin index at or below which the margin trigger of the knock torque cap sets, by engine speed and load. Lower values let the engine run with less margin before the cap comes in.

table.name: Knock Torque Cap Margin Hysteresis
table.description: Once the margin trigger is set, the threshold is raised by this much, so the margin index must climb clearly above it before the trigger releases.

table.name: Knock Margin Base
table.description: Starting value of the knock margin index by engine speed and load. The index is this, less intake air temperature 2 in degrees C, plus the spark and A/F terms; the knock torque cap's margin trigger sets when it falls to Knock Torque Cap Margin Threshold. Lower values bring the cap and the margin enrichment in sooner.

table.name: Knock Margin Spark Weight
table.description: How strongly Knock Margin Spark Factor moves the knock margin index, by engine speed and load.

table.name: Knock Margin Spark Factor
table.description: Knock margin term by how far the primary ignition request sits above the ignition timing ceiling; 50 is neutral, lower values take margin away. Scaled by Knock Margin Spark Weight.

table.name: Knock Margin A/F Weight
table.description: How strongly Knock Margin A/F Factor moves the knock margin index, by engine speed and load.

table.name: Knock Margin A/F Factor
table.description: Knock margin term by the measured air/fuel ratio; 50 is neutral and higher values add margin. Scaled by Knock Margin A/F Weight.

table.name: P0299 Underboost Error Threshold
table.description: Underboost (P0299) check: the fail count runs while boost is short of the target by at least this much (read).

table.name: P0299 Underboost Time
table.description: Underboost (P0299) check: the time setting of the check, the counterpart of the 2.0's P0299 Underboost Time (inferred from the code pairing).

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 2 (Path B, Drive Mode 2, Sport)
table.description: Path B tip-in smoothing for drive mode 2 with manual coding: allowed torque rise per 10 ms in Path B's fast stage.

table.name: Torque Model Filter Multiplier A (Below Idle Target)
table.description: Version of Torque Model Filter Multiplier A used while rpm is far below the idle target (later software versions).

table.name: Torque Model Filter Multiplier A (Alt, Below Idle Target)
table.description: Version of Torque Model Filter Multiplier A (Alt) used while rpm is far below the idle target (later software versions).

table.name: Manifold Model Gain Multiplier (Falling MAP, Initial)
Manifold Model Gain Multiplier (Falling MAP, Recovery)
Manifold Model Gain Multiplier (Falling MAP, Recovery, TGV Closed)
Manifold Model Gain Multiplier (Falling MAP, Recovery, Neutral)
Idle Converter Slip Threshold (In Gear, AT/CVT)
table.description: Automatic/CVT only: converter slip, by coolant, needed for the ECU to treat the car as stopped in gear for idle control (probably torque-converter slip). Never used on a manual car.

table.name: Idle Converter Slip Threshold (Neutral, AT/CVT)
table.description: Automatic/CVT only: converter slip, by coolant, needed for the ECU to treat the car as in neutral/park for idle control (probably torque-converter slip). Never used on a manual car.

table.name: EGR Upstream Pressure Estimate
table.description: Estimated pressure upstream of the EGR valve (probably exhaust side) by rpm and load. The difference to manifold pressure sets the modelled EGR flow and decides whether EGR may be enabled.

table.name: Charge Control Delay After Start (SOC, Battery Sensor)
table.description: After a start, charge control (the battery-charged decision and adaptive charging) may begin this long after the engine starts, by the estimated state of charge at start and the battery sensor value.

table.name: Charge Control Charge After Start (SOC)
table.description: Charge control may also begin once the battery has taken back this much charge since the start, by the estimated state of charge at start.

table.name: Charging Feedback Integral Gain
table.description:
Scales the feedback integral (100 = as is).
Details: Integral x this / 100 after the clamp (0x13866C, read). Address 03FE70. Confidence: read.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Coolant Multiplier (Special Start)
table.description: A first start (type 0) uses x1.0. Multiplier in the normal cranking pulse FFF8AFC6 when FFF8A6E7 = 3 (0x0C9038, coolant FFF8CD65 = degC + 50, read from the call at 0x0C6896); 255 (x1.0) for other values. LF9F000R: located from LF75404S 05A350 by the code that reads it (read). LF9K000D: same code as LF9F000R; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LT8F300C: same code as LF9K000D; address from the same instruction (similarity port (code)). Descriptor 06C81C. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Injection Angle Base (TGV Normal)
table.description: First-pulse (intake stroke) injection angle in catalyst-heating phase 2 and the start sequence, by rpm and coolant, limited to 180.5-360 BTDC. Used when the TGVs are not closed.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Injection Angle Base Adder (TGV Normal)
table.description: Rpm x load correction to Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Injection Angle Base (TGV Normal); positive = later. TGVs not closed.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Injection Angle Base Spark Adder (TGV Normal)
table.description: Correction by spark target and coolant to the phase 2 first-pulse angle, TGVs not closed; positive = later.

table.name: Knock Torque Cap Margin Threshold
table.description: Knock margin index at or below which the margin trigger of the knock torque cap sets, by engine speed and load. Lower values let the engine run with less margin before the cap comes in.

table.name: Knock Torque Cap Margin Hysteresis
table.description: Once the margin trigger is set, the threshold is raised by this much, so the margin index must climb clearly above it before the trigger releases.

table.name: Knock Margin Base
table.description: Starting value of the knock margin index by engine speed and load. The index is this, less intake air temperature 2 in degrees C, plus the spark and A/F terms; the knock torque cap's margin trigger sets when it falls to Knock Torque Cap Margin Threshold. Lower values bring the cap and the margin enrichment in sooner.

table.name: Knock Margin Spark Weight
table.description: How strongly Knock Margin Spark Factor moves the knock margin index, by engine speed and load.

table.name: Knock Margin Spark Factor
table.description: Knock margin term by how far the primary ignition request sits above the ignition timing ceiling; 50 is neutral, lower values take margin away. Scaled by Knock Margin Spark Weight.

table.name: Knock Margin A/F Weight
table.description: How strongly Knock Margin A/F Factor moves the knock margin index, by engine speed and load.

table.name: Knock Margin A/F Factor
table.description: Knock margin term by the measured air/fuel ratio; 50 is neutral and higher values add margin. Scaled by Knock Margin A/F Weight.

table.name: P0299 Underboost Error Threshold
table.description: Underboost (P0299) check: the fail count runs while boost is short of the target by at least this much (read).

table.name: P0299 Underboost Time
table.description: Underboost (P0299) check: the time setting of the check, the counterpart of the 2.0's P0299 Underboost Time (inferred from the code pairing).

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 2 (Path B, Drive Mode 2, Sport)
table.description: Path B tip-in smoothing for drive mode 2 with manual coding: allowed torque rise per 10 ms in Path B's fast stage.

table.name: Torque Model Filter Multiplier A (Below Idle Target)
table.description: Version of Torque Model Filter Multiplier A used while rpm is far below the idle target (later software versions).

table.name: Torque Model Filter Multiplier A (Alt, Below Idle Target)
table.description: Version of Torque Model Filter Multiplier A (Alt) used while rpm is far below the idle target (later software versions).

table.name: Manifold Model Gain Multiplier (Falling MAP, Initial)
Manifold Model Gain Multiplier (Falling MAP, Recovery)
Manifold Model Gain Multiplier (Falling MAP, Recovery, TGV Closed)
Manifold Model Gain Multiplier (Falling MAP, Recovery, Neutral)
Idle Converter Slip Threshold (In Gear, AT/CVT)
table.description: Automatic/CVT only: converter slip, by coolant, needed for the ECU to treat the car as stopped in gear for idle control (probably torque-converter slip). Never used on a manual car.

table.name: Idle Converter Slip Threshold (Neutral, AT/CVT)
table.description: Automatic/CVT only: converter slip, by coolant, needed for the ECU to treat the car as in neutral/park for idle control (probably torque-converter slip). Never used on a manual car.

table.name: EGR Upstream Pressure Estimate
table.description: Estimated pressure upstream of the EGR valve (probably exhaust side) by rpm and load. The difference to manifold pressure sets the modelled EGR flow and decides whether EGR may be enabled.

table.name: Charge Control Delay After Start (SOC, Battery Sensor)
table.description: After a start, charge control (the battery-charged decision and adaptive charging) may begin this long after the engine starts, by the estimated state of charge at start and the battery sensor value.

table.name: Charge Control Charge After Start (SOC)
table.description: Charge control may also begin once the battery has taken back this much charge since the start, by the estimated state of charge at start.

table.name: Charging Feedback Integral Gain
table.description:
Scales the feedback integral (100 = as is).
Details: Integral x this / 100 after the clamp (0x13866C, read). Address 0407F8. Confidence: read.

Additional Enrichment A
table.description:
Extra enrichment added to the open-loop enrichment at higher coolant and lower rpm.
Details: When used: A applies when coolant >= cal 0x13E18 and rpm < cal 0x13E0E, B when coolant < 0x13E1A or rpm >= 0x13E0C (in between the last value is held); the whole term needs FFF8A654 bit 1, whose thresholds (cal 0x13E08, 0x13E14) are 65535, and both tables are zero. Source of FFF8AFE8 (0x0CAF70, with B), a term of the commanded lambda and of the fuel factor FFF8AFBC, where it is added to the open-loop enrichment (0x0C558C, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Additional Enrichment B
table.description:
Second table of the additional enrichment, used at low coolant or high rpm.
Details: When used: see Additional Enrichment A: B applies when coolant < cal 0x13E1A or rpm >= cal 0x13E0C (A when coolant >= cal 0x13E18 and rpm < cal 0x13E0E; in between the last value is held), and the whole term needs FFF8A654 bit 1. Second source table of FFF8AFE8. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Additional Enrichment Throttle Threshold
table.description:
Throttle opening above idle, by rpm, needed to enable Additional Enrichment A/B.
0x0D3BFC (from 0x0C782C, args read) sets the Additional Enrichment enable FFF8A654 bit 1 only when, among others, FFF88A3C (throttle opening above the idle opening: FFF88A3A - FFF8AFB8, 0x08015C) >= this(rpm FFF8CD54) or FFF88EDA bit 0, and rpm >= cal 0x13E08 = 65535 and coolant >= cal 0x13E14 = 65535 (or FFF88E28 bit 1), so the enable never sets (read; my research notes section 3). Once met, the threshold becomes cal 0x13E12 itself (1049 = 2.4 %), not the table value minus 1049: the code computes threshold - (threshold - 0x13E12) (0x0D3C90-0x0D3CAE, read); the rpm and coolant hysteresis cals 0x13E0A/0x13E16 work the same way. Belongs to Additional Enrichment A/B. Confidence: inferred.
