Filtered RPM Rate Timing Term
table.description:
Timing added or removed according to how fast engine speed is changing, which looks like an rpm-oscillation (surge) damper.
0x0DB888 (called from 0x0DF0B8 with FFF8AA85 bit 1 and FFF8A8A1 bit 7, read): while FFF8AA85 bit 1 is set (set by 0x07FA1A when the surge damping trigger FFF8A7A1 bit 2 and FFF8A8A2 bit 6 are clear, the request is not being shaped (FFF8AEC2 <= FFF8AEBE), FFF8CEC1 bits 0-4 (rpm and load window flags) are set, speed >= cal 0x57576, gear FFF8A621 within cals 0x57577..0x57578, and FFF886AB bit 7 or FFF8A88F), FFF8A757 = clamp((this(FFF88CA4) + cal 0x2FEDE (s8 -3) x (rpm k passes ago - filtered rpm k passes ago) >> 7) x 100 >> 8, cal 0x2FEDD.. cal 0x2FEDC); k = 05B784/05B790(gear FFF8A621) + 1 (both all 0, so k = 1); rpm history FFF88CAC.. and the filtered-rpm history FFF88CC8.. (FFF8CE9A, a second lag of FFF8CEB2) (read). A757 is added to the base timing sum FFF8A74B (0x0DA600, read). Axis: FFF88CA4 = change of the lag-filtered rpm FFF8CEB2 between passes of 0x07E96C (read). Confidence: read.

FBKC Retard Step (Secondary Knock, State 0x0D)
table.description:
Timing pulled per event by feedback knock correction when the secondary knock detector fires.
Details: Feedback knock correction (0x0E2BE4, read): FFF8A79A is an s8 integrator kept at or below 0 and added directly to the fired timing (x 0.3516 degrees, 0x0D9E40): it is the only knock term of that sum, and FFF8A79A is one value for the whole engine, so a knock event on any cylinder retards all four (the fired timing FFF8A744 is recomputed per event for the next cylinder, but no per-cylinder knock retard exists; read). The state FFF8A79C (set once per combustion event by 0x0E2F94 from that event's knock results FFF8A7AD / FFF8A7B5; FFF8A7C1 is the knock-window-length flag (1 = extended window), used there only to reload per-cylinder hold counters FFF84920...FFF84930 from cal 0x27014 when it changes, purpose inferred) picks the action: states 0x0E, 0x0D, 7 and 6 subtract a step (floor = minus FBKC Maximum Retard); states 0x0C, 2, 0 (outside the rpm window) and the other non-knock states (0x0A outside the window, 0x0B) add the recovery step 0x1C271; 0x10 (inside the rpm window, no knock, fewer than cal 0x1C288 = 100 events since the last knock) holds the correction unchanged; 0x0F (inside the window, no knock, >= 100 events) adds 0x1C270, 8/9 add 0x1C272 (capped at 0); 5 = FFF8A79B x 0x1C26E / 128; 3 and 4 load the fixed values 0x1C26F / 0x1C278; 1 = 0. States (0x0E2F94, read, in priority order): 1 = knock control off (cal 0x56EE7 bit 7); 2 = FFF886AB bit 5 or load FFF8ADE4 <= cal 0x1C27E (0); 3 / 4 = FFF88E29 bit 3 / FFF88E2A bit 6 (fixed -14 counts = -4.9 degrees, inferred knock-sensor fault default); 5 = engine speed above FBKC Window RPM Maximum (hold); inside the rpm window: 6 / 0x0D = knock A with / without FFF8AA85 bit 0, 7 / 0x0E = knock B (FFF8A7B5, intensity > Knock Threshold, the active one); 0x0F = no knock and FFF8B130 (events since the last knock, 0x0E7C7C) >= cal 0x1C288 (100), 0x10 = no knock, fewer events; 8 / 9 hold; 0x0A / 0x0B / 0x0C other conditions (0x0B: A/F FFF88AF6 above a lambda threshold). Subtracted per pass in state 0x0D. p16 (read): the FBKC logic 0x0E2F94 (0x0E402C <- 0x07D0E0 <- 0x1E1CBC) is crank-synchronous: one pass per combustion event (180 deg CA, dispatched at tooth position 70 via the ATU-J0 software interrupt 0x0A7390), not per time. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: FBKC Retard Step (Secondary Knock, State 6)
table.description:
Timing pulled per event by feedback knock correction when the secondary knock detector fires (variant with an extra internal condition set).
Details: Feedback knock correction (0x0E2BE4, read): FFF8A79A is an s8 integrator kept at or below 0 and added directly to the fired timing (x 0.3516 degrees, 0x0D9E40): it is the only knock term of that sum, and FFF8A79A is one value for the whole engine, so a knock event on any cylinder retards all four (the fired timing FFF8A744 is recomputed per event for the next cylinder, but no per-cylinder knock retard exists; read). The state FFF8A79C (set once per combustion event by 0x0E2F94 from that event's knock results FFF8A7AD / FFF8A7B5; FFF8A7C1 is the knock-window-length flag (1 = extended window), used there only to reload per-cylinder hold counters FFF84920...FFF84930 from cal 0x27014 when it changes, purpose inferred) picks the action: states 0x0E, 0x0D, 7 and 6 subtract a step (floor = minus FBKC Maximum Retard); states 0x0C, 2, 0 (outside the rpm window) and the other non-knock states (0x0A outside the window, 0x0B) add the recovery step 0x1C271; 0x10 (inside the rpm window, no knock, fewer than cal 0x1C288 = 100 events since the last knock) holds the correction unchanged; 0x0F (inside the window, no knock, >= 100 events) adds 0x1C270, 8/9 add 0x1C272 (capped at 0); 5 = FFF8A79B x 0x1C26E / 128; 3 and 4 load the fixed values 0x1C26F / 0x1C278; 1 = 0. States (0x0E2F94, read, in priority order): 1 = knock control off (cal 0x56EE7 bit 7); 2 = FFF886AB bit 5 or load FFF8ADE4 <= cal 0x1C27E (0); 3 / 4 = FFF88E29 bit 3 / FFF88E2A bit 6 (fixed -14 counts = -4.9 degrees, inferred knock-sensor fault default); 5 = engine speed above FBKC Window RPM Maximum (hold); inside the rpm window: 6 / 0x0D = knock A with / without FFF8AA85 bit 0, 7 / 0x0E = knock B (FFF8A7B5, intensity > Knock Threshold, the active one); 0x0F = no knock and FFF8B130 (events since the last knock, 0x0E7C7C) >= cal 0x1C288 (100), 0x10 = no knock, fewer events; 8 / 9 hold; 0x0A / 0x0B / 0x0C other conditions (0x0B: A/F FFF88AF6 above a lambda threshold). Subtracted per pass in state 6. p16 (read): the FBKC logic 0x0E2F94 (0x0E402C <- 0x07D0E0 <- 0x1E1CBC) is crank-synchronous: one pass per combustion event (180 deg CA, dispatched at tooth position 70 via the ATU-J0 software interrupt 0x0A7390), not per time. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: FLKC Counted-Cell Learned Value Threshold
table.description:
By DAM: a fine-knock-learning cell is counted when its learned value is at or above this, and the count sets an internal flag.
0x0E7DF8 (read): one cell per pass, it counts the FLKC cells whose flag FFF811AF[cell] is 1 and whose learned value FFF81414[cell] is at or above this(DAM FFF811AE); after all 35 cells the count goes to FFF8A792 and FFF8A7A3 bit 1 = count >= cal 0x1C699 (4). 0x0E7D0C (read) uses that bit only together with DAM inside cal 0x1C698..0x1C697 (32..48 in DAM x 16 units), which DAM (0..16) never reaches. Confidence: read.

table.name: Base Timing DAM Blend Alternate (DAM 0)
table.description:
Alternate DAM-blended timing offset (DAM 0 side) for base timing. 32 = no change.
Weighted (16 - DAM)/16. 0x0D9BD4 (read): FFF8A73F = ((16 - DAM) x 05B54C + DAM x 05B560) / 16 in the 32-offset half-degree frame, DAM = FFF811AE (0..16), tables by rpm FFF8CD54 x load FFF8ADE4. 0x0D9CA0: FFF8A73E = (A73F + FFF8A73B - 32) x FFF8B0D2 / 256 + 32, and FFF8A740 = A73E when FFF8A8A5 bit 4 is set, else A73D (the 05B574/05B588 path) (read). FFF8A73E/A73F have no other readers. With cal 0x32DEA = 'Z' the base timing term FFF8A73C would ramp toward A740 (cal 0x32DEC per pass) and enter the base timing sum FFF8A74B (0x0DA600). Confidence: read.

table.name: Base Timing DAM Blend Alternate (DAM 1)
table.description:
Alternate DAM-blended timing offset (DAM 1 side) for base timing. 32 = no change.
Weighted DAM/16. 0x0D9BD4 (read): FFF8A73F = ((16 - DAM) x 05B54C + DAM x 05B560) / 16 in the 32-offset half-degree frame, DAM = FFF811AE (0..16), tables by rpm FFF8CD54 x load FFF8ADE4. 0x0D9CA0: FFF8A73E = (A73F + FFF8A73B - 32) x FFF8B0D2 / 256 + 32, and FFF8A740 = A73E when FFF8A8A5 bit 4 is set, else A73D (the 05B574/05B588 path) (read). FFF8A73E/A73F have no other readers. With cal 0x32DEA = 'Z' the base timing term FFF8A73C would ramp toward A740 (cal 0x32DEC per pass) and enter the base timing sum FFF8A74B (0x0DA600). Confidence: read.

table.description:
How fast the idle speed target moves (by coolant) when idle switches from mode 4 (cold idle) to mode 6 (AT/CVT warm idle). Larger = quicker change. Automatic/CVT only: these modes never occur on a manual car, so this table has no effect there.
Details: 0x0F1DD0 (read; selection checked in the disassembly 0x0F1DD0..0x0F2148): the target ramp step B23E is chosen on a change of idle mode FFF8A7F0 (previous -> new) and kept while the mode stays the same; the target B23C (4 x B238) moves toward the new mode's Idle Speed Target by this step every pass (0x0F1D00). Coolant FFF88A44 axis. Mode 1 -> 1 uses step 0. This table: mode 4 -> 6. Modes 6/8 only occur with the AT/CVT coding: 0x0F2BCC passes A7F6 through when FFF88ADA bit7 is set and 0x0F354C itself only yields 1-5/7, so this step is never used by this MT calibration; it also needs idle mode 4. p16 (read): 0x0F1D00 runs every 10 ms (module 0x0EE338), so rpm/s = shown rpm-per-pass x 100. Confidence: read.

Modes 6/8 only occur with the AT/CVT coding: 0x0F2BCC passes A7F6 through when FFF88ADA bit7 is set and 0x0F354C itself only yields 1-5/7, so this step is never used by this MT calibration; it also needs idle mode 4. p16 (read): 0x0F1D00 runs every 10 ms (module 0x0EE338), so rpm/s = shown rpm-per-pass x 100. table.description:
Base idle air by coolant for the cold-idle mode 4 with the TGVs commanded closed.
Details: When used: idle mode 4, entered from mode 5 when stopped with coolant below cal 0x24E94 for cal 0x24E96 passes. 0x0F0D24: base idle air B20C by idle mode FFF8A7F0 and coolant, this table while FFF8A881 bit 4 (TGV close command) is set (read). Scale as Idle Base Air (Mode 5). Raise it with this mode's idle speed target so the feedback need not cover the difference (inferred). Implicit coolant axis -40..110 C in 10 C steps (lookup 0x7414). FFF8A881 bit 4 is the normal TGV-close command (0x10DEFC, set mainly by the timed close request FFF8A883 bit 5 from 0x10E180 when requested torque, coolant and air flow are below the TGV thresholds; the same bit selects every TGV-closed table), not a forced or fault state (read). At a settled warm idle the request conditions hold, so the TGVs are normally commanded closed and the TGV Closed table is probably the one in use (inferred). Confidence: read.

Cranking Fuel Coolant Multiplier (Special Start)
table.description: A first start (type 0) uses x1.0. Multiplier in the normal cranking pulse FFF8AFC6 when FFF8A6E7 = 3 (0x0C9038, coolant FFF8CD65 = degC + 50, read from the call at 0x0C6896); 255 (x1.0) for other values. LF9F000R: located from LF75404S 05A350 by the code that reads it (read). LF9K000D: same code as LF9F000R; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LT8H300D: same code as LF9K000D; address from the same instruction (similarity port (code)). Descriptor 06D59C. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Injection Angle Base Spark Adder (TGV Closed)
table.description: Correction by spark target and coolant to the phase 2 first-pulse angle, TGVs closed; positive = later.

table.name: Knock Torque Cap: Margin Trigger
table.description: Switches on the margin trigger of the knock torque cap: when the knock margin index falls to Knock Torque Cap Margin Threshold, the torque ceiling ramps down to the Margin curve.

table.name: Knock Torque Cap: Coolant Condition Bypass
table.description: With this set, the margin trigger also works below Knock Torque Cap Coolant Minimum (unless an ECU flag blocks it).

table.name: Knock Torque Cap Margin Threshold
table.description: Knock margin index at or below which the margin trigger of the knock torque cap sets, by engine speed and load. Lower values let the engine run with less margin before the cap comes in.

table.name: Knock Torque Cap Margin Hysteresis
table.description: Once the margin trigger is set, the threshold is raised by this much, so the margin index must climb clearly above it before the trigger releases.

table.name: Knock Margin Base
table.description: Starting value of the knock margin index by engine speed and load. The index is this, less intake air temperature 2 in degrees C, plus the spark and A/F terms; the knock torque cap's margin trigger sets when it falls to Knock Torque Cap Margin Threshold. Lower values bring the cap and the margin enrichment in sooner.

table.name: Knock Margin Spark Weight
table.description: How strongly Knock Margin Spark Factor moves the knock margin index, by engine speed and load.

table.name: Knock Margin Spark Factor
table.description: Knock margin term by how far the primary ignition request sits above the ignition timing ceiling; 50 is neutral, lower values take margin away. Scaled by Knock Margin Spark Weight.

table.name: Knock Margin A/F Weight
table.description: How strongly Knock Margin A/F Factor moves the knock margin index, by engine speed and load.

table.name: Knock Margin A/F Factor
table.description: Knock margin term by the measured air/fuel ratio; 50 is neutral and higher values add margin. Scaled by Knock Margin A/F Weight.

table.name: P0299 Underboost Error Threshold (IAT, Baro)
table.description: P0299 (underboost) counts while actual boost is below target by more than this, by intake air temperature and barometric pressure.

table.name: P0299 Underboost Time (Baro)
table.description: How long underboost must last before P0299 sets (passes), by barometric pressure.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 2 (Path B, Drive Mode 2, Sport)
table.description: Path B tip-in smoothing for drive mode 2 with manual coding: allowed torque rise per 10 ms in Path B's fast stage.

table.name: Manifold Model Gain Multiplier (Falling MAP, Initial)
Manifold Model Gain Multiplier (Falling MAP, Recovery)
Manifold Model Gain Multiplier (Falling MAP, Recovery, TGV Closed)
Manifold Model Gain Multiplier (Falling MAP, Recovery, Neutral)
Idle Converter Slip Threshold (In Gear, AT/CVT)
table.description: Automatic/CVT only: converter slip, by coolant, needed for the ECU to treat the car as stopped in gear for idle control (probably torque-converter slip). Never used on a manual car.

table.name: Idle Converter Slip Threshold (Neutral, AT/CVT)
table.description: Automatic/CVT only: converter slip, by coolant, needed for the ECU to treat the car as in neutral/park for idle control (probably torque-converter slip). Never used on a manual car.

table.name: EGR Upstream Pressure Estimate
table.description: Estimated pressure upstream of the EGR valve (probably exhaust side) by rpm and load. The difference to manifold pressure sets the modelled EGR flow and decides whether EGR may be enabled.

table.name: Charge Control Delay After Start (SOC, Battery Sensor)
table.description: After a start, charge control (the battery-charged decision and adaptive charging) may begin this long after the engine starts, by the estimated state of charge at start and the battery sensor value.

table.name: Charge Control Charge After Start (SOC)
table.description: Charge control may also begin once the battery has taken back this much charge since the start, by the estimated state of charge at start.

table.description: Correction by spark target and coolant to the phase 2 first-pulse angle, TGVs closed; positive = later.

table.name: P0299 Underboost Error Threshold
table.description: Underboost (P0299) check: the fail count runs while boost is short of the target by at least this much (read).

table.name: P0299 Underboost Time
table.description: Underboost (P0299) check: the time setting of the check, the counterpart of the 2.0's P0299 Underboost Time (inferred from the code pairing).

table.name: Charge Control Delay After Start (SOC, Battery Sensor)
table.description: After a start, charge control (the battery-charged decision and adaptive charging) may begin this long after the engine starts, by the estimated state of charge at start and the battery sensor value.

table.name: Charge Control Charge After Start (SOC)
table.description: Charge control may also begin once the battery has taken back this much charge since the start, by the estimated state of charge at start.

table.name: Charging Feedback Integral Gain
table.description:
Scales the feedback integral (100 = as is).
Details: Integral x this / 100 after the clamp (0x13866C, read). Address 0432F4. Confidence: read.

table.name: (P000A) Intake Camshaft Position Slow Response (Bank 1)
table.description: Left cell, Enabled: 1 = this code can set and report, 0 = it never sets (its monitor still runs and other logic that reads the raw result may still react). Right cell, Fail-Safe: 1 = a failed test of this code raises the fail-safe request (what that request limits is not yet decoded). Needs RomRaider 1.0.0 or later.

table.name: Adaptive Charging Integral Deadband Below
table.description:
Battery current may be this far below the target before the adaptive integral steps up.
Details: 0x137E7C, mode 5 only (read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Adaptive Charging Integral Step Down
table.description:
Integral step each 40 ms pass while the battery current is above the target.
Details: 0x137E7C (read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Adaptive Charging Integral Step Up
table.description:
Integral step each 40 ms pass while the battery current is below the target.
Details: 0x137E7C (read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Adaptive Charging Integral Gain
table.description:
Converts the adaptive integral into a voltage correction (mV per count x 1000).
Details: B6FA = integral x this / 1000 mV (0x137E7C, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Adaptive Charging Integral Maximum
table.description:
Upper clamp of the adaptive integral (counts).
Details: 0x137E7C (read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Adaptive Charging Integral Minimum
table.description:
Lower clamp of the adaptive integral (counts).
Details: 0x137E7C (read). Confidence: inferred.

table.description: Correction by spark target and coolant to the phase 2 first-pulse angle, TGVs closed; positive = later.

table.name: Knock Torque Cap: Margin Trigger
table.description: Switches on the margin trigger of the knock torque cap: when the knock margin index falls to Knock Torque Cap Margin Threshold, the torque ceiling ramps down to the Margin curve.

table.name: Knock Torque Cap: Coolant Condition Bypass
table.description: With this set, the margin trigger also works below Knock Torque Cap Coolant Minimum (unless an ECU flag blocks it).

table.name: Knock Torque Cap Margin Threshold
table.description: Knock margin index at or below which the margin trigger of the knock torque cap sets, by engine speed and load. Lower values let the engine run with less margin before the cap comes in.

table.name: Knock Torque Cap Margin Hysteresis
table.description: Once the margin trigger is set, the threshold is raised by this much, so the margin index must climb clearly above it before the trigger releases.

table.name: Knock Margin Base
table.description: Starting value of the knock margin index by engine speed and load. The index is this, less intake air temperature 2 in degrees C, plus the spark and A/F terms; the knock torque cap's margin trigger sets when it falls to Knock Torque Cap Margin Threshold. Lower values bring the cap and the margin enrichment in sooner.

table.name: Knock Margin Spark Weight
table.description: How strongly Knock Margin Spark Factor moves the knock margin index, by engine speed and load.

table.name: Knock Margin Spark Factor
table.description: Knock margin term by how far the primary ignition request sits above the ignition timing ceiling; 50 is neutral, lower values take margin away. Scaled by Knock Margin Spark Weight.

table.name: Knock Margin A/F Weight
table.description: How strongly Knock Margin A/F Factor moves the knock margin index, by engine speed and load.

table.name: Knock Margin A/F Factor
table.description: Knock margin term by the measured air/fuel ratio; 50 is neutral and higher values add margin. Scaled by Knock Margin A/F Weight.

table.name: P0299 Underboost Error Threshold (IAT, Baro)
table.description: P0299 (underboost) counts while actual boost is below target by more than this, by intake air temperature and barometric pressure.

table.name: P0299 Underboost Time (Baro)
table.description: How long underboost must last before P0299 sets (passes), by barometric pressure.

table.name: EGR Upstream Pressure Estimate
table.description: Estimated pressure upstream of the EGR valve (probably exhaust side) by rpm and load. The difference to manifold pressure sets the modelled EGR flow and decides whether EGR may be enabled.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Coolant Multiplier (Special Start)
table.description: A first start (type 0) uses x1.0. Multiplier in the normal cranking pulse FFF8AFC6 when FFF8A6E7 = 3 (0x0C9038, coolant FFF8CD65 = degC + 50, read from the call at 0x0C6896); 255 (x1.0) for other values. LF9F000R: located from LF75404S 05A350 by the code that reads it (read). LF9K000D: same code as LF9F000R; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LT8F300C: same code as LF9K000D; address from the same instruction (similarity port (code)). LT8D800A: same code as LT8F300C; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LT8D700A: same code as LT8D800A; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 06BE6C. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Injection Angle Base (TGV Normal)
table.description: First-pulse (intake stroke) injection angle in catalyst-heating phase 2 and the start sequence, by rpm and coolant, limited to 180.5-360 BTDC. Used when the TGVs are not closed.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Injection Angle Base Adder (TGV Normal)
table.description: Rpm x load correction to Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Injection Angle Base (TGV Normal); positive = later. TGVs not closed.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Injection Angle Base Spark Adder (TGV Normal)
table.description: Correction by spark target and coolant to the phase 2 first-pulse angle, TGVs not closed; positive = later.

table.name: Purge Rate (Open-Loop Enrichment)
table.description: Purge rate by load while open-loop enrichment is active.

table.name: Knock Torque Cap Margin Threshold
table.description: Knock margin index at or below which the margin trigger of the knock torque cap sets, by engine speed and load. Lower values let the engine run with less margin before the cap comes in.

table.name: Knock Torque Cap Margin Hysteresis
table.description: Once the margin trigger is set, the threshold is raised by this much, so the margin index must climb clearly above it before the trigger releases.

table.name: Knock Margin Base
table.description: Starting value of the knock margin index by engine speed and load. The index is this, less intake air temperature 2 in degrees C, plus the spark and A/F terms; the knock torque cap's margin trigger sets when it falls to Knock Torque Cap Margin Threshold. Lower values bring the cap and the margin enrichment in sooner.

table.name: Knock Margin Spark Weight
table.description: How strongly Knock Margin Spark Factor moves the knock margin index, by engine speed and load.

table.name: Knock Margin Spark Factor
table.description: Knock margin term by how far the primary ignition request sits above the ignition timing ceiling; 50 is neutral, lower values take margin away. Scaled by Knock Margin Spark Weight.

table.name: Knock Margin A/F Weight
table.description: How strongly Knock Margin A/F Factor moves the knock margin index, by engine speed and load.

table.name: Knock Margin A/F Factor
table.description: Knock margin term by the measured air/fuel ratio; 50 is neutral and higher values add margin. Scaled by Knock Margin A/F Weight.

table.name: P0299 Underboost Error Threshold
table.description: Underboost (P0299) check: the fail count runs while boost is short of the target by at least this much (read).

table.name: P0299 Underboost Time
table.description: Underboost (P0299) check: the time setting of the check, the counterpart of the 2.0's P0299 Underboost Time (inferred from the code pairing).

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 2 (Path B, Drive Mode 2, Sport)
table.description: Path B tip-in smoothing for drive mode 2 with manual coding: allowed torque rise per 10 ms in Path B's fast stage.

table.name: Torque Model Filter Multiplier A (Below Idle Target)
table.description: Version of Torque Model Filter Multiplier A used while rpm is far below the idle target (later software versions).

table.name: Torque Model Filter Multiplier A (Alt, Below Idle Target)
table.description: Version of Torque Model Filter Multiplier A (Alt) used while rpm is far below the idle target (later software versions).

Idle Converter Slip Threshold (In Gear, AT/CVT)
table.description: Automatic/CVT only: converter slip, by coolant, needed for the ECU to treat the car as stopped in gear for idle control (probably torque-converter slip). Never used on a manual car.

table.name: Idle Converter Slip Threshold (Neutral, AT/CVT)
table.description: Automatic/CVT only: converter slip, by coolant, needed for the ECU to treat the car as in neutral/park for idle control (probably torque-converter slip). Never used on a manual car.

table.name: EGR Upstream Pressure Estimate
table.description: Estimated pressure upstream of the EGR valve (probably exhaust side) by rpm and load. The difference to manifold pressure sets the modelled EGR flow and decides whether EGR may be enabled.

table.name: Charge Control Delay After Start (SOC, Battery Sensor)
table.description: After a start, charge control (the battery-charged decision and adaptive charging) may begin this long after the engine starts, by the estimated state of charge at start and the battery sensor value.

table.name: Charge Control Charge After Start (SOC)
table.description: Charge control may also begin once the battery has taken back this much charge since the start, by the estimated state of charge at start.

table.name: Charging Feedback Integral Gain
table.description:
Scales the feedback integral (100 = as is).
Details: Integral x this / 100 after the clamp (0x13866C, read). Address 03FE6C. Confidence: read.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Coolant Multiplier (Special Start)
table.description: A first start (type 0) uses x1.0. Multiplier in the normal cranking pulse FFF8AFC6 when FFF8A6E7 = 3 (0x0C9038, coolant FFF8CD65 = degC + 50, read from the call at 0x0C6896); 255 (x1.0) for other values. LF9F000R: located from LF75404S 05A350 by the code that reads it (read). LF9K000D: same code as LF9F000R; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). LT8F300C: same code as LF9K000D; address from the same instruction (similarity port (code)). LT8F200C: same code as LT8F300C; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 06C81C. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Injection Angle Base (TGV Normal)
table.description: First-pulse (intake stroke) injection angle in catalyst-heating phase 2 and the start sequence, by rpm and coolant, limited to 180.5-360 BTDC. Used when the TGVs are not closed.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Injection Angle Base Adder (TGV Normal)
table.description: Rpm x load correction to Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Injection Angle Base (TGV Normal); positive = later. TGVs not closed.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Injection Angle Base Spark Adder (TGV Normal)
table.description: Correction by spark target and coolant to the phase 2 first-pulse angle, TGVs not closed; positive = later.

table.name: Knock Torque Cap Margin Threshold
table.description: Knock margin index at or below which the margin trigger of the knock torque cap sets, by engine speed and load. Lower values let the engine run with less margin before the cap comes in.

table.name: Knock Torque Cap Margin Hysteresis
table.description: Once the margin trigger is set, the threshold is raised by this much, so the margin index must climb clearly above it before the trigger releases.

table.name: Knock Margin Base
table.description: Starting value of the knock margin index by engine speed and load. The index is this, less intake air temperature 2 in degrees C, plus the spark and A/F terms; the knock torque cap's margin trigger sets when it falls to Knock Torque Cap Margin Threshold. Lower values bring the cap and the margin enrichment in sooner.

table.name: Knock Margin Spark Weight
table.description: How strongly Knock Margin Spark Factor moves the knock margin index, by engine speed and load.

table.name: Knock Margin Spark Factor
table.description: Knock margin term by how far the primary ignition request sits above the ignition timing ceiling; 50 is neutral, lower values take margin away. Scaled by Knock Margin Spark Weight.

table.name: Knock Margin A/F Weight
table.description: How strongly Knock Margin A/F Factor moves the knock margin index, by engine speed and load.

table.name: Knock Margin A/F Factor
table.description: Knock margin term by the measured air/fuel ratio; 50 is neutral and higher values add margin. Scaled by Knock Margin A/F Weight.

table.name: P0299 Underboost Error Threshold
table.description: Underboost (P0299) check: the fail count runs while boost is short of the target by at least this much (read).

table.name: P0299 Underboost Time
table.description: Underboost (P0299) check: the time setting of the check, the counterpart of the 2.0's P0299 Underboost Time (inferred from the code pairing).

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 2 (Path B, Drive Mode 2, Sport)
table.description: Path B tip-in smoothing for drive mode 2 with manual coding: allowed torque rise per 10 ms in Path B's fast stage.

table.name: Torque Model Filter Multiplier A (Below Idle Target)
table.description: Version of Torque Model Filter Multiplier A used while rpm is far below the idle target (later software versions).

table.name: Torque Model Filter Multiplier A (Alt, Below Idle Target)
table.description: Version of Torque Model Filter Multiplier A (Alt) used while rpm is far below the idle target (later software versions).

table.description: Automatic/CVT only: converter slip, by coolant, needed for the ECU to treat the car as stopped in gear for idle control (probably torque-converter slip). Never used on a manual car.

table.name: Idle Converter Slip Threshold (Neutral, AT/CVT)
table.description: Automatic/CVT only: converter slip, by coolant, needed for the ECU to treat the car as in neutral/park for idle control (probably torque-converter slip). Never used on a manual car.

table.name: EGR Upstream Pressure Estimate
table.description: Estimated pressure upstream of the EGR valve (probably exhaust side) by rpm and load. The difference to manifold pressure sets the modelled EGR flow and decides whether EGR may be enabled.

table.name: Charge Control Delay After Start (SOC, Battery Sensor)
table.description: After a start, charge control (the battery-charged decision and adaptive charging) may begin this long after the engine starts, by the estimated state of charge at start and the battery sensor value.

table.name: Charge Control Charge After Start (SOC)
table.description: Charge control may also begin once the battery has taken back this much charge since the start, by the estimated state of charge at start.

table.name: Charging Feedback Integral Gain
table.description:
Scales the feedback integral (100 = as is).
Details: Integral x this / 100 after the clamp (0x13866C, read). Address 0407F4. Confidence: read.

table.name: (P000A) Intake Camshaft Position Slow Response (Bank 1)

table.description: Correction by spark target and coolant to the phase 2 first-pulse angle, TGVs closed; positive = later.

table.name: Knock Torque Cap: Margin Trigger
table.description: Switches on the margin trigger of the knock torque cap: when the knock margin index falls to Knock Torque Cap Margin Threshold, the torque ceiling ramps down to the Margin curve.

table.name: Knock Torque Cap: Coolant Condition Bypass
table.description: With this set, the margin trigger also works below Knock Torque Cap Coolant Minimum (unless an ECU flag blocks it).

table.name: Knock Torque Cap Margin Threshold
table.description: Knock margin index at or below which the margin trigger of the knock torque cap sets, by engine speed and load. Lower values let the engine run with less margin before the cap comes in.

table.name: Knock Torque Cap Margin Hysteresis
table.description: Once the margin trigger is set, the threshold is raised by this much, so the margin index must climb clearly above it before the trigger releases.

table.name: Knock Margin Base
table.description: Starting value of the knock margin index by engine speed and load. The index is this, less intake air temperature 2 in degrees C, plus the spark and A/F terms; the knock torque cap's margin trigger sets when it falls to Knock Torque Cap Margin Threshold. Lower values bring the cap and the margin enrichment in sooner.

table.name: Knock Margin Spark Weight
table.description: How strongly Knock Margin Spark Factor moves the knock margin index, by engine speed and load.

table.name: Knock Margin Spark Factor
table.description: Knock margin term by how far the primary ignition request sits above the ignition timing ceiling; 50 is neutral, lower values take margin away. Scaled by Knock Margin Spark Weight.

table.name: Knock Margin A/F Weight
table.description: How strongly Knock Margin A/F Factor moves the knock margin index, by engine speed and load.

table.name: Knock Margin A/F Factor
table.description: Knock margin term by the measured air/fuel ratio; 50 is neutral and higher values add margin. Scaled by Knock Margin A/F Weight.

table.name: P0299 Underboost Error Threshold
table.description: Underboost (P0299) check: the fail count runs while boost is short of the target by at least this much (read).

table.name: P0299 Underboost Time
table.description: Underboost (P0299) check: the time setting of the check, the counterpart of the 2.0's P0299 Underboost Time (inferred from the code pairing).

table.name: EGR Upstream Pressure Estimate
table.description: Estimated pressure upstream of the EGR valve (probably exhaust side) by rpm and load. The difference to manifold pressure sets the modelled EGR flow and decides whether EGR may be enabled.

table.name: Charge Control Delay After Start (SOC, Battery Sensor)
table.description: After a start, charge control (the battery-charged decision and adaptive charging) may begin this long after the engine starts, by the estimated state of charge at start and the battery sensor value.

table.name: Charge Control Charge After Start (SOC)
table.description: Charge control may also begin once the battery has taken back this much charge since the start, by the estimated state of charge at start.

table.name: Charging Feedback Integral Gain
table.description:
Scales the feedback integral (100 = as is).
Details: Integral x this / 100 after the clamp (0x13866C, read). Address 0432F0. Confidence: read.
